A record belongs together in memory. It does for one thread; a warp is 32 threads, and they all want the same field.
column2: “一条记录就该放在一起。”对一个线程是这样；可一个 warp 有 32 个线程，它们要的是同一个字段。

column1: Any padding fixes bank conflicts. Only a pitch that shares no factor with the bank count does; 36 or 48 words still pile lanes up.
column2: “随便补几个字就能消除 bank 冲突。”只有与 bank 数互质的行距才行；补到 36 或 48 个字，车道照样堆在一起。

column1: Make the loop faster. The loop is not the cost. The bill is the lines touched, and a faster loop touches the same 16.
column2: “把循环写快一点。”代价不在循环里。账是按摸到的行算的，循环再快，摸到的还是那 16 条。

column1: More warps is always faster. More warps hide waiting, but on one hot counter they only make the queue longer.
column2: “warp 越多越快。”多一些 warp 能盖住等待，可全挤在一个热点计数器上，只会让队更长。

column1: One thread per row is natural, and fewer readers means fewer reads. The bill is per line touched: a thread that strides pays a whole line for every word.
column2: “一个线程一行最自然，读的人少，读取就少。”账是按摸到的行算的：跨着步子读的线程，每个字都要付一整条行。

column1: Shared memory is always fast. It is fast when the lanes of a warp spread over the banks, and 32 times slower when they pile onto one.
column2: “共享内存永远很快。”车道散在各个 bank 上时它才快；全挤进同一个 bank，就慢 32 倍。

column1: The hardware does atomics, so they are free. They are correct for free; the waiting is paid for in cycles.
column2: “原子操作是硬件做的，所以不花钱。”正确性是白送的，排队的时间要用周期来付。

column1: The threads run side by side, so a neighbour has surely written by now. Warps drift apart; only BAR makes them wait.
column2: “线程是并肩跑的，邻居肯定已经写完了。”各个 warp 会错开；只有 BAR 能让它们等。

column2: 6.0 × 127 = 762，远在 ±127 之外，转换把它钳成 127：这个激活被当成了 1.0，点积于是偏小。

column1: 64 numbers need 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1 additions per round: six rounds. Keep them in shared memory (DMA 0, 0, 2048 brings in the whole list), one row of 32 per index.
column2: 64 个数每轮做 32、16、8、4、2、1 次加法，共六轮。放在共享内存里（DMA 0, 0, 2048 把整个列表搬进来），每个下标一行 32 个。

column1: 8192 / 4900 = 1.67, and a block cannot be cut in pieces, so only one fits. The other blocks wait in the queue until it ends, even though the SM has warps and registers to spare.

column1: 9 for the row pass plus 9 for the column pass is 18, against 81 for the full 2D kernel. The saving grows with the kernel: 2n instead of n².
column2: 横向 9 次加纵向 9 次，一共 18 次，而完整二维核要 81 次。核越大省得越多：是 2n 而不是 n²。

column2: 一张图 90% 的像素灰度都在 100 到 120 之间。均衡之后，这些像素会怎样？

column1: A 16-wide texture is stretched over 32 output columns. Which texture column does output column 5 show?
column2: 16 宽的纹理拉伸铺满 32 列输出。输出第 5 列显示纹理的第几列？

column1: A 16-wide texture is stretched to 32 columns, but the sample position is taken at the pixel's left edge, x·T/32, instead of its centre. Which way does the picture seem to move?
column2: 16 宽的纹理拉伸到 32 列，但取样位置取在像素的左边缘 x·T/32，而不是中心。画面看上去往哪边移？

column1: A 4-stage pipeline processes 16 samples. Sent as one batch, versus as 8 micro-batches of 2: roughly what share of the time is an average SM idle in each case?
column2: 4 级流水线处理 16 个样本。整批一起送，与分成 8 个微批（每批 2 个）送，SM 平均空闲的时间占比各约是多少？

column1: A 50x50 matrix is cut into 16x16 tiles. How many tile columns are there, and how many columns of the last one hold real data?
column2: 50x50 的矩阵切成 16x16 的小块。一共有几列块？最后一列块里有几列是真数据？

column1: A 64x64 matrix product, one thread per output and no tiling. How many times is each element of A read from global memory?
column2: 64x64 矩阵乘，每个输出一个线程、不分块。A 的每个元素会被全局读取几次？

column1: A 9×9 kernel is split into a row pass and a column pass of 9 taps each. How many multiply-adds does each output pixel need now?
column2: 9×9 的核拆成一遍横向、一遍纵向，每遍 9 个抽头。现在每个输出像素要做多少次乘加？

column1: A BAR must separate each layer from the next, and every warp has to reach it, so put it outside the IF that keeps the extra threads out of the small layers.
column2: 每一层和下一层之间要放 BAR，而且每个 warp 都必须执行到它，所以把它放在那个让多余线程退出小层的 IF 外面。

column2: 各有各的拍

column1: A GPU keeps tens of resident warps per SM so there is almost always one ready to issue. Occupancy is the name for how many.
column2: GPU 的每个 SM 会同时驻留几十个 warp，几乎总有一个可以发射。驻留了多少，叫占用率（occupancy）。

column1: A Q8 reading times a Q8 gain (0.75 is stored as 192). In what format is the product?
column2: Q8 的读数乘以 Q8 的增益（0.75 存成 192）。乘积是什么格式？

column2: 译注有误

column1: A bag where nearly every letter goes to the same pigeonhole. The 256 counters move from global to shared memory. How long does the count take?
column2: 一袋信几乎全寄往同一个格口。把 256 个计数器从全局内存搬到共享内存，数完要多久？

column1: A barrier makes the group as slow as its slowest member.
column2: 栅栏让整个小组和最慢的成员一样慢。

column1: A barrier releases when the last SM arrives. The step takes as long as the slowest one, and the other three idle for the difference.
column2: 栅栏在最后一个 SM 到达时才放行。一步和最慢的那个一样长，另外三个把差值全部空等掉。

column1: A big product is a loop of small tensor products whose accumulators never leave the registers.
column2: 大矩阵乘是一串小张量乘，累加器始终不离开寄存器。

column1: A bigger buffer does not help: the RECV is stuck because nothing was ever sent. Make sure somebody speaks first.
column2: 加大缓冲没用：RECV 卡住是因为根本没人发过东西。要让某一方先开口。

column1: A block books its shared words when it lands and keeps them until it ends. Booking less lets more blocks live together, and their waiting overlaps.
column2: 块一落地就订下它的共享字，直到结束才还。订得少，就有更多块能同时住下，它们的等待也就能叠在一起。

column1: A block has eight tiles. Copying one takes about 400 cycles and computing it about 400 more. If the copy of the next tile runs while the current tile is computed, the block's time is closest to:
column2: 一个块有八个小块。搬一块约 400 拍，算一块约 400 拍。如果下一块的搬运和当前块的计算同时进行，这个块的总时间最接近：

column1: A block needs its 256 readings plus R extra on each side: 256 + 2R words, at most 272. The readings can sit side by side, one word each.
column2: 一块需要自己的 256 个读数，再加两边各 R 个：256 + 2R 个字，最多 272。读数可以一个挨一个地放，每个只占一个字。

column1: A blocking receive waits for a send that may be stuck behind another receive. If the waits form a loop, nothing ever moves.
column2: 阻塞的接收要等一次发送，而那次发送可能卡在另一个接收后面。等待连成环，就谁也动不了。

column1: A butterfly: for d = 16, 8, 4, 2, 1 do r0 += SHFL(r0, lane XOR d). Afterwards every lane holds its warp's sum. Then combine the 16 warps of a block in shared memory (ATOMS is fine) behind a BAR.
column2: 蝶形求和：对 d = 16、8、4、2、1，做 r0 += SHFL(r0, lane XOR d)。之后每条车道都持有本 warp 的和。再把一个块的 16 个 warp 在共享内存里合并（用 ATOMS 即可），中间隔一个 BAR。

column1: A cache is split into sets and each line may only live in one of them. Addresses a power of two apart pile into one set, however empty the rest of the cache is.
column2: 缓存分成若干组，每一行只能住进其中一组。地址相隔 2 的幂次的数据会挤进同一组，不管缓存其余部分有多空。

column1: A cache only helps while the data you keep reusing fits in it. When it does not, shrink the piece you work on until it does, then move to the next piece.
column2: 缓存只有在你反复用的数据装得下时才有用。装不下，就把手头这一块缩小到装得下，做完再换下一块。

column1: A cell is read by its four neighbours while it is being rewritten. Reads and writes of one step must never touch the same buffer.
column2: 一个格子在被改写的同时，还要被它的四个邻居读取。同一步里的读和写不能用同一块缓冲。

column1: A cell only reads its four neighbours, so a strip needs one row from above and one from below, nothing else. Keep two spare rows (ghost rows) in the tile for them.
column2: 格子只读四个邻居，所以一条只需要上面一行和下面一行，别的都不要。在本地块里留两条备用行（幽灵行）存放它们。

column1: A chip cannot make memory faster, so it keeps many warps in flight. While one waits, another issues; the wait is paid once, not once per warp.
column2: 芯片没法让内存变快，就让很多 warp 同时在路上。一个在等，另一个在发射；这次等待只付一遍，不是每个 warp 各付一遍。

column1: A copy engine works while the warps compute. With two buffers, the copy of the next piece hides behind the compute of this one.
column2: 搬运引擎可以在 warp 计算的同时工作。有了两个缓冲，下一块的搬运就能藏在这一块的计算后面。

column1: A document can be wrong about a machine; a clock cannot. The bank count is a fact you can measure from the timing of one strided read.
column2: 文档可能把机器写错，时钟不会。bank 数是一个事实，量一次跨步读的耗时就能知道。

column1: A dry cell can only get wet from a wet neighbour, so only the rim can grow. On open ground the rim is a diamond, and a diamond of radius r has 4r cells. On a narrow channel it is a single cell.
column2: 干格只会被湿的邻格淹到，所以只有水边会扩张。在开阔地上，水边是一个菱形，半径 r 的菱形只有 4r 格。在窄水渠里，它只有一格。

column1: A few cycles, an L1 hit
column2: 几个周期，L1 命中

column1: A few cycles: the line is already in L1
column2: 几个周期：这一行已经在 L1 里

column1: A fixed scale is a bet on the range. A scale taken from the data cannot lose that bet.
column2: 写死的缩放是对数据范围的一次赌注。从数据里取的缩放不会输。

column1: A fixed split is only as fast as its unluckiest part. A shared counter lets each SM take the next job when it is free, so the work balances itself.
column2: 固定分法的速度取决于最倒霉的那一份。共用计数器让每个 SM 空下来就取下一个活，负载自己就平衡了。

column1: A fixed-point number is a whole number with an agreed scale. A product carries both scales, so shift one back out.
column2: 定点数就是约定了比例的整数。乘积带着两个比例，所以要把其中一个移出去。

column1: A flip hides in one message but shows in the total. Before the transfer, ring-exchange the four vector sums (short messages are safe); afterwards each SM compares the sum of its result with it.
column2: 翻转藏在一条消息里，却会在总和上露出来。传输前先用环交换四个向量各自的和（短消息安全）；传完后每个 SM 拿结果的和去对。

column1: A flip while the sums are still being built is added into a chunk that every SM then receives: all four wrong. A flip in the last gather step lands in one SM only. Checking one SM is not enough.
column2: 归约阶段的翻转会被加进一个块，之后每个 SM 都会收到它：四个全错。最后一步收集时的翻转只落在一个 SM 上。只查一个 SM 不够。

column1: A flipped bit is silent. A cheap total computed before the transfer and compared after turns it into a retry.
column2: 翻转一位悄无声息。传输前算一个便宜的总和，传完再比，错误就变成一次重试。

column1: A grid 16 rows tall and 64 columns wide goes to 4 SMs as 4 strips. Cut by rows (4 rows of 64) or by columns (16 columns of 16 rows): which moves fewer words per step?
column2: 一张 16 行 64 列的网格切成 4 条分给 4 个 SM。按行切（每条 4 行 x 64 列）和按列切（每条 16 行 x 16 列），哪个每步传的字少？

column1: A grid is made of whole blocks, so the thread count is rounded up. The threads past the end must check before they write.
column2: 网格由整块组成，所以线程数是向上取整的。越过末尾的线程在写之前必须先检查。

column1: A grid of H rows and W columns (W is 16, 32 or 64) spreads like sand: for T steps every cell becomes (4 c + north + south + east + west) >> 3, with zeros outside the grid. rom[0] is H, rom[1] is W, rom[2] is T, and from rom[32] comes the grid with a border of zeros, (H + 2) x (W + 2) values. Write the final grid to out, row after row.\nThe four SMs each take a strip of H / 4 rows and may only meet over the links. Cut a strip's cells by hand and every step needs the row just outside it from the neighbour. SM 0 has nobody above, SM 3 nobody below. The links are slow: 1 word per cycle.
column2: H 行 W 列的网格（W 为 16、32 或 64）像沙一样扩散：做 T 步，每步每个格子变成 (4 c + 北 + 南 + 东 + 西) >> 3，格子外面按 0 算。rom[0] 是 H，rom[1] 是 W，rom[2] 是 T，从 rom[32] 起是带一圈 0 边框的网格，共 (H + 2) x (W + 2) 个值。把最终网格逐行写进 out。\n4 个 SM 各取 H / 4 行的一条，只能通过链路互通。每一步都需要邻居那条紧挨在自己外面的一行。SM 0 上面没人，SM 3 下面没人。链路很慢：每拍 1 个字。

column1: A grid-stride loop, two maps, a grid barrier per step and a shared tile with a rim: together they are the skeleton of every iterative grid solver.
column2: 网格步长循环、两张图、每步一次全网格栅栏、带边的共享块：合在一起，就是所有迭代网格求解器的骨架。

column1: A grid-wide barrier only works while every block is resident at once. Registers decide how many warps fit, so a greedy kernel can make the barrier impossible.
column2: 全网格栅栏只在所有块同时驻留时才管用。寄存器决定能装下多少 warp，所以一个贪心的内核会让栅栏无法完成。

column1: A half float has a 10-bit mantissa. Between 1024 and 2048, how far apart are neighbouring halves?
column2: 半精度浮点的尾数有 10 位。在 1024 到 2048 之间，相邻的两个半精度数相差多少？

column1: A half float is scientific notation in 16 bits: a sign, a power of two and a short mantissa.
column2: 半精度浮点就是 16 位的科学计数法：一个符号、一个 2 的幂、一小段尾数。

column1: A hidden unit sums 64 white pixels (255 each) with weights near 4.4. The sum is 71800. What does it become after CVT.H.F?
column2: 一个隐藏单元把 64 个白像素（各 255）乘上约 4.4 的权重再求和，和是 71800。CVT.H.F 之后它变成什么？

column1: A job's three matrices are 12288 words. DMA brings in A and C together (8192 words fill the shared memory), then B reuses A's place. Each lane owns columns l and l + 32, so LDS reads are conflict-free and no lane needs a reduction.
column2: 一份任务的三个矩阵共 12288 个字。DMA 先把 A 和 C 一起搬来（8192 个字正好占满共享内存），然后 B 用 A 腾出的位置。每个车道负责第 l 和第 l + 32 列，LDS 读取没有冲突，也不需要任何车道间的归约。

column1: A kernel that is a product of two 1D kernels can be applied as two 1D passes, turning n² multiplies into 2n.
column2: 如果一个核是两个一维核的乘积，就能拆成两遍一维处理，把 n² 次乘法变成 2n 次。

column1: A key's place = the start of its pile + how many keys of the same pile come before it. Count them with a scan, one pile at a time.
column2: 键的位置 = 它所在堆的起点 + 同一堆里排在它前面的键数。一次扫描一堆，把它们数出来。

column1: A lane has read rom[i] and now reads rom[i + 1] from the same line. How long does that second read take?
column2: 一条车道刚读了 rom[i]，接着读同一行里的 rom[i + 1]。第二次读要多久？

column1: A latency for every unit
column2: 每个单元各有延迟

column1: A line goes to set (line number mod 4). Rows 128 words apart are 4 lines apart, so all eight land in set 0, which holds only 4. The other 3 sets sit empty while set 0 thrashes.
column2: 一行放进第（行号 mod 4）组。相隔 128 个字的行，行号相差 4，所以八行全落在第 0 组，而它只能装 4 行。其余 3 组空着，第 0 组却在反复被换出。

column1: A line holds 32 words and a read costs one transaction per line it touches. 32 neighbours sit in one line, or in two if they straddle a boundary.
column2: 一条缓存行装 32 个字，一次读摸到几条行就付几次事务。32 个相邻的字在同一行里，跨了边界也只是两行。

column1: A line is 32 words, so words 32 apart are in different lines. The 32 lanes cover 16 rows of the picture, and each row is its own line.
column2: 一条行是 32 个字，相距 32 的字就落在不同的行里。32 条车道覆盖图的 16 行，每一行都是单独的一条。

column1: A line is fetched whole, so use what you fetched. Reading neighbours back to back turns one miss into many hits; hopping makes every read a miss.
column2: 一行是整行取来的，取来了就要用上。紧挨着读相邻的字，一次缺失换来许多次命中；跳着读，每次都是缺失。

column1: A link has a fixed cost per message, a rate per word, and a delay before anything lands. Big messages pay the fixed cost once and then run at the rate.
column2: 链路有每条消息的固定开销、每个字的速率，以及落地前的延迟。大消息只付一次固定开销，之后按速率走。

column1: A load waits 400 cycles. Issue eight loads of W and eight of x before you use any, then do the eight multiply-adds: 32 passes instead of 256.
column2: 一次取数要等 400 个周期。先发八个 W 和八个 x 的取数，再做这八次乘加：32 趟而不是 256 趟。

column1: A loop body loads one reading, then waits 3 beats for it. Unrolled, what can sit between two neighbouring loads?
column2: 循环体读一个数，然后要等它 3 拍。展开之后，相邻两次读取之间可以放什么？

column1: A loop waits for itself every round. Unrolled, the wait of one round is covered by the work of the next.
column2: 循环每一圈都在等自己。展开之后，一圈的等待被下一圈的工作盖住。

column1: A negative number, so the vertex lands mirrored on the screen
column2: 一个负数，于是顶点被镜像着落到屏幕上

column1: A perspective divide only makes sense in front of the eye. Behind it, w changes sign and the picture folds over itself.
column2: 透视除法只在眼睛前方才有意义。到了身后，w 变号，画面会翻折到自己身上。

column1: A picture of black and white stripes, each one pixel wide, is shrunk 8× by keeping one pixel in eight. What does the 8×8 result look like?
column2: 一张黑白条纹的画，每条 1 个像素宽，缩小 8 倍，办法是每 8 个像素只留 1 个。8×8 的结果是什么样？

column1: A pixel is a small square, and it samples the world at its middle. Take the corner instead and the whole picture slides by a part of a texel.
column2: 像素是一个小方块，它在自己的中央对世界取样。改取角点，整幅图就会滑开一小段纹素。

column1: A pixel near the right border of a 16-wide texture blends column 15 with a neighbour one step to the right, which is outside the picture. With clamping, what colour does that neighbour have?
column2: 16 宽纹理右边界附近的像素，要把第 15 列和它右边一格的邻居混合，而那一格在图外。用钳位的话，这个邻居是什么颜色？

column1: A plain integer
column2: 普通整数

column1: A position's K and V never change once computed. Store them in shared memory at row t and read rows 0..t later.
column2: 一个位置的 K、V 算出来就不再变。把它们存进共享内存的第 t 行，以后读 0..t 行。

column1: A producer must FENCE after storing its chart and BAR before it sets the region's flag, or a stitcher may see the flag before the chart. A stitcher that polls too briefly fails on a slow day: the hidden days have different weather, so poll with a generous bound and stitch each region once its flag is seen.
column2: 生产者写完图后要先 FENCE，再 BAR，才能置该区域的标志，否则拼总览的块可能先看到标志、后看到图。轮询太短的拼接者，在慢的天气里会失败：隐藏的几天天气不同，所以轮询的次数要给足，看到某个区域的标志后再拼它。

column1: A product needs twice the bits of its factors. Make room before multiplying, not after.
column2: 乘积需要因子两倍的位数。要在乘之前腾出空间，而不是乘完再说。

column1: A program has just read rom[0], which took 400 cycles. Next it reads rom[1], in the same 32-word line. How long does that second read take?
column2: 程序刚读完 rom[0]，用了 400 周期。接着读 rom[1]，它在同一行 32 个字里。第二次读要多久？

column1: A program holds at most 40 instructions, NOPs included, and the vertex route costs 11 per triangle. The edge coefficients already are edge vectors, scaled by ±2: b0·a2 - a0·b2 (edges 0 and 2) has the sign of the area, and flipping every sign cancels in a product. Four loads, one SUB and one DOT.
column2: 程序最多 40 条指令（NOP 也算），而走顶点这条路每个三角形要 11 条。其实边的系数本身就是边向量，只差一个 ±2 的倍数：边 0 和边 2 的 b0·a2 - a0·b2 与面积同号，而整体翻转符号在乘积里会抵消。四次 LD、一次 SUB、一次 DOT。

column1: A quarter
column2: 降为四分之一

column1: A read whose result you do not use yet still starts the fill. Touch all four lines first, then the four 400-cycle waits overlap into one.
column2: 一次暂时不用结果的读，照样会让内存开始取整行。先把四行各碰一下，四个 400 周期的等待就叠成了一个。

column1: A real GPU merges the loads of a warp into 32, 64 or 128-byte memory transactions; 32 consecutive 4-byte reads fit one 128-byte segment.
column2: 真实的 GPU 会把一个 warp 的读合并成 32、64 或 128 字节的内存事务；32 个连续的 4 字节读正好装进一个 128 字节的段。

column1: A real GPU picks from many independent warps in hardware. Here you do the picking by hand, inside a single warp.
column2: 真实的 GPU 在硬件里从许多互不相干的 warp 里挑选。这里你在单个 warp 里亲手挑。

column1: A real SM has a 64K-register file shared by all resident threads; the compiler's register count per thread sets occupancy directly. Tools such as the CUDA occupancy calculator exist because this arithmetic matters so often.
column2: 真实的 SM 有一个 64K 个寄存器的寄存器堆，由所有驻留线程分享；编译器给每线程分配的寄存器数直接决定占用率。CUDA 有专门的占用率计算器，就因为这笔账太常用。

column1: A real SM has about 48 to 228 KB of shared memory depending on the generation. Kernels that stage big tiles often trade occupancy for reuse, and the best tile size is found by measuring.
column2: 真实的 SM 依代际不同有大约 48 到 228 KB 的共享内存。搬大块数据的内核常常拿占用率换复用，最佳的块大小要靠实测。

column1: A real compiler picks the unroll factor from a size and speed model. Here you feel the trade directly: cycles and size pull against each other.
column2: 真实的编译器靠体积与速度模型选展开倍数。这里你能直接感觉到这个权衡：周期和指令数互相拉扯。

column1: A real ripple solves a wave equation over time. This one is a distance function through two tables, cheap enough for a classroom.
column2: 真实的水波要随时间求解波动方程。这里只是把距离函数过两张表，便宜得足够在教室里跑。

column1: A record never straddles a line, so the first read fetches all of it. The other fields cost the L1 latency, 4 cycles, or simply wait for the same fill already on its way.
column2: 一条病历不会跨行，所以第一次读就把它整个取来了。其余字段只付 L1 的延迟 4 周期，或者干脆等同一次正在路上的取行。

column1: A ring all-reduce over 4 SMs moves a vector of n words. Over the whole run, how many words does each directed link carry?
column2: 用四个 SM 的环做 all-reduce，向量长 n。整个过程中，每条有向链路一共传多少字？

column1: A row belongs to one warp, and a warp walks its row in order, 32 entries at a time. Bigger blocks bring more warps, but none of them is given a piece of this row.
column2: 一行只属于一个 warp，而一个 warp 是按顺序、一次 32 个条目地走完它的行。块更大只是多来了几个 warp，但没有一个会分到这一行的一部分。

column1: A row strip has to send rows of 64 words. A column strip sends columns of 16. Each strip holds the same 256 cells, so the cut that makes the edge shorter wins.
column2: 按行切的条要发 64 字的整行；按列切的条发 16 字的整列。每条都是 256 格，所以让边更短的切法更省。

column1: A running half-precision sum has reached 1000. You add 0.2. What is the sum afterwards?
column2: 一个半精度的累加和已经到了 1000。再加 0.2，和变成多少？

column1: A sample between texel centres is a weighted mix of its four neighbours; the weights are the distances, and the blend is two LERPs and one more.
column2: 落在纹素中心之间的取样，是四个邻居的加权混合；权重就是距离，混合就是两次横向 LERP 加一次纵向 LERP。

column1: A segment is 256 entries: s0 = rowptr[row] + 256 * seg, s1 = min(rowptr[row + 1], s0 + 256). A warp whose s0 is not below the row's end has nothing to do and should skip everything. Otherwise it sums its segment as in the last level, a butterfly adds the lanes, and lane 0 does ATOM into out[row].
column2: 一段是 256 个条目：s0 = rowptr[row] + 256 * seg，s1 = min(rowptr[row + 1], s0 + 256)。如果 s0 不小于该行末尾，这个 warp 无事可做，应当整个跳过。否则它像上一关那样累加自己的这一段，用蝶形把各车道加起来，再由 0 号车道对 out[row] 做 ATOM。

column1: A sequence of 16 tokens goes through attention. How many entries does the score matrix Q·Kᵀ have?
column2: 长度 16 的序列做注意力，得分矩阵 Q·Kᵀ 有多少项？

column1: A source belongs to one tile only; inject it there and let the exchange carry it to the neighbours. Test the tile with (y - oy) | (x - ox) in 0..32, and point the store at a spare cell when it fails. Frames must not be written twice or skipped: out rows come from the tile's own offset.
column2: 沙源只属于一块屏：在那里注入，让交换把它带给邻居。用 (y - oy) | (x - ox) 是否在 0..32 来判断，不属于就把写入指向一个备用格。帧不能重复写或漏写：out 的行号由这块屏自己的偏移决定。

column1: A stable sort on a few bits is just flags, scans and one scatter. No comparisons needed.
column2: 对少数几位做稳定排序，不过是标志、扫描加一次散布。完全不需要比较。

column1: A stall belongs to one warp only. The scheduler issues from whichever warp is ready, so sixteen warps put sixteen requests in flight and share one 400-cycle wait.
column2: 停顿只属于那一个 warp。调度器从任何一个就绪的 warp 发射，所以十六个 warp 同时发出十六个请求，共用同一次 400 周期的等待。

column1: A stencil only reads one cell beyond its tile, so what must cross the link is the border, not the tile.
column2: 模板只会读到块外一格，所以要过链路的是边界一圈，不是整块。

column1: A stencil reads the same cells many times over. Loading a tile and its halo once into shared memory turns five global reads per cell into about one.
column2: 模板会把同样的格子读很多遍。把一块格子连同光环一次装进共享内存，每格五次全局读取就降到约一次。

column1: A store leaves its block and becomes visible to others after a delay that grows with the number of lanes and has some jitter. A one-lane flag store is quick; a full warp of data takes longer. So the flag can arrive first.
column2: 一次写入离开本块后，要过一段延迟才对别的块可见，延迟随参与的车道数增长，还带一点抖动。单车道的标志写得快，整个 warp 的数据写得慢。所以标志可能先到。

column1: A texture lookup turns a position into an index: scale the coordinate, drop the fraction, read one word.
column2: 纹理查找就是把位置变成下标：缩放坐标，去掉小数，读一个字。

column1: A thread computes 4x4 outputs instead of 1. On average, how many values must each multiply-add read from shared memory?
column2: 每个线程算 4x4 个输出，而不是 1 个。平均每次乘加要从共享内存读几个值？

column1: A thread may hold 8 registers and its code needs a 9th live value. Where can that value go?
column2: 一个线程只能用 8 个寄存器，而代码需要同时保留第 9 个值。这个值能放到哪里？

column1: A tile kernel that is right for multiples of 16 is not yet a kernel.
column2: 只对 16 的倍数正确的分块内核，还算不上内核。

column1: A toy hidden state of four numbers and a 128-entry vocabulary; real models pick among tens of thousands of tokens.
column2: 玩具隐状态只有四个数，词表 128 项；真实模型要在几万个字里挑。

column1: A transfer is only as fast as its busiest link. Splitting the load across both neighbours brings the busiest link from 2n words down to 1.5n.
column2: 传输的快慢取决于最忙的那条链路。把负载分给两个邻居，最忙链路从 2n 个字降到 1.5n。

column1: A triangle's corner A is very near (w = 16) and corner B is very far (w = 128). On screen, the pixel exactly halfway between A and B is closer in colour to which corner?
column2: 三角形的角 A 很近（w = 16），角 B 很远（w = 128）。在屏幕上正好位于 A 和 B 中点的像素，颜色更接近哪个角？

column1: A vertex sits behind the eye at w = -4. What does RCP of it give, 65536 / -4?
column2: 一个顶点在眼睛后面，w = -4。对它做 RCP，也就是 65536 / -4，会得到什么？

column1: A warp does not stall on LD itself, only on the first instruction that reads the loaded register. Which instruction in the starter is the first to wait?
column2: warp 不会因为 LD 本身停下，只会在第一条读到该寄存器的指令上停下。旧内核里是哪一条最先在等？

column1: A warp only stalls on the register it needs. While one warp waits, the others issue their loads, so all eight misses are in flight together. The memory channel starts a new fill every 4 cycles, hence 400 plus a few dozen, not 3200.
column2: warp 只会在它要用的那个寄存器上停下。一个 warp 在等的时候，别的 warp 照样发出自己的读，八次未命中是同时在途的。内存通道每 4 拍开始一次新的填充，所以是 400 再多几十，而不是 3200。

column1: A warp per row
column2: 一行一个 warp

column1: A warp's read costs one transaction per line its lanes touch, not one per lane. Neighbours on neighbouring words touch one line.
column2: 一次 warp 读的代价，是它的车道摸到几条缓存行，而不是几条车道在读。相邻车道读相邻的字，只摸一条。

column1: A wrapped-around value: here 0
column2: 回绕之后的值：这里是 0

column1: ADD r1, tid, 2048 / ADD r2, tid, 3072 / LD r3, [r1] / LD r4, [r2] / ADD / ST [tid]. Issue both loads before you use either.
column2: ADD r1, tid, 2048 / ADD r2, tid, 3072 / LD r3, [r1] / LD r4, [r2] / ADD / ST [tid]。两次读都发出之后，再去用它们。

column1: APIs call these clamp-to-edge, repeat and mirror. Skyboxes need clamp, brick walls need repeat, and a wrong choice shows as a seam along the border.
column2: 各种 API 把它们叫作 clamp-to-edge、repeat 和 mirror。天空盒需要钳位，砖墙需要平铺，选错了就会在边上出现接缝。

column1: ATOM d, [addr], v — add v to the output cell atomically; d gets the old value.
column2: ATOM d, [addr], v —— 原子地给输出单元加 v，d 得到旧值。

column1: ATOMS d, [addr], v — the same on shared memory.
column2: ATOMS d, [addr], v —— 同上，作用于共享内存。

column1: ATOMS r2, [r0], 1 for each of the four pixels; BAR; then threads 0..15 do LDS r12, [tid] and ST [tid], r12.
column2: 四个像素各做一次 ATOMS r2, [r0], 1；BAR；然后线程 0..15 做 LDS r12, [tid] 和 ST [tid], r12。

column1: A[i][k] is used by every output in row i, and there are 64 of them. Each of those 64 threads fetches it for itself. With 16x16 tiles the 16 columns of a tile share one fetch, and 4 column blocks still read it once each: 4 times.
column2: A[i][k] 被第 i 行的每个输出用到，一共 64 个，这 64 个线程各取一次。用 16x16 的块，一个块里的 16 列共用一次读取，四个列块各读一次：共 4 次。

column2: 约 0.5 个

column2: 约 1 个

column2: 约 1.25 次：每格一次，加上薄薄一圈边

column2: 两者都约一半

column2: 约少 20 倍，1.2 万次

About 3/4 versus about 1/4
column2: 约四分之三 对 约四分之一

column2: 约少 4 倍，6.5 万次

column1: About 400 cycles again
column2: 大约又是 400 周期

column1: About 400 plus a few dozen
column2: 约 400 再多几十

About 90%
About half as long
column2: 大约一半

column2: 约差一块的时间

column2: 差不多

column2: 差不多，约 26 万次

column2: 慢约两倍

column1: Above 2048 neighbouring halves are 2 apart. 2048 + 1 is exactly halfway, and ties go to the even neighbour, 2048. Every one of the 63 ones is swallowed the same way.
column2: 2048 以上相邻的半精度数相隔 2。2048 + 1 恰在正中，平局取偶数一侧，也就是 2048。63 个 1.0 每一个都这样被吞掉。

column1: Absorbed
column2: 吞没

column1: Add one 2048 and sixty-three 1.0s in half precision, in that order. Which value is the result closest to?
column2: 用半精度把一个 2048 和 63 个 1.0 按这个顺序逐个相加，结果最接近哪个？

column1: Add the three edge values e0 + e1 + e2 at two different pixels inside the same triangle. How do the two sums compare?
column2: 在同一个三角形内部的两个不同像素上，各把三条边的值 e0 + e1 + e2 加起来。两个和有什么关系？

column1: Addresses, then the loads for b, e, d and a, MUL d×e and a×b, then the loads for c and f. The two last MULs come right behind, and one ADD joins them.
column2: 先算地址，再加载 b、e、d、a，然后做 d×e 和 a×b 两次乘法，再加载 c 和 f。最后两次乘法紧随其后，一个 ADD 把它们合起来。

column1: After BAR, threads 0..255 each do LDS r6, [tid] and ST [tid], r6. Row-major order means the table comes out already in place.
column2: BAR 之后，线程 0..255 各做一次 LDS r6, [tid] 和 ST [tid], r6。行主序的写出，格口表本身就摆好了。

column1: After a MUL, leave three beats of other work before using its result. After an ADD, one is enough. The address sums and the other loads fit the gaps exactly.
column2: MUL 之后，隔三拍的别的工作再用它的结果；ADD 之后，隔一拍就够了。地址计算和其余的加载正好填满这些空拍。

column1: After the BAR each thread adds 16 products, As[ty][k] times Bs[k][tx], to its register. Put a second BAR before the next tile overwrites shared memory.
column2: BAR 之后每个线程把 16 个乘积 As[ty][k]·Bs[k][tx] 累加进寄存器。下一块覆盖共享内存之前，还要再放一个 BAR。

column1: After the butterfly, lane 0 of each warp does ATOMS [0] += r0. BAR. Then only thread tx = 0 reads LDS [0] and does one ATOM into out[0]: 8 global atomics for the whole grid.
column2: 蝶形之后，每个 warp 的 0 号车道做 ATOMS [0] += r0。BAR。然后只让 tx = 0 的线程读 LDS [0]，对 out[0] 做一次 ATOM：整个网格一共 8 次全局原子操作。

column1: All 16
column2: 全部 16 步

column1: All 32 cells must be dry for the warp to skip f: 0.9^32 is about 3%. So about 97% of the warps run f anyway, and the IF saves almost nothing.
column2: 要想让 warp 跳过 f，32 格必须全干：0.9 的 32 次方约 3%。所以大约 97% 的 warp 照样要算 f，IF 几乎什么也没省下。

column1: All 32 lanes of one warp read 32 neighbouring words at the same moment. How many global memory transactions is that?
column2: 同一个 warp 的 32 条车道同时读 32 个相邻的字，要几次全局内存事务？

column1: All 32 lanes step along their own rows together, so each round touches 32 different lines plus the x line, twice what the L1 holds. What fraction of those reads hit in L1?
column2: 32 条车道一起沿各自的行往前走，每一轮要碰 32 个不同的行，外加 x 那一行，是 L1 容量的两倍。这些读取里有多大比例命中 L1？

column1: All done at once, as fast as for a random picture
column2: 同时完成，和随机图一样快

column1: All eight lines map to the same set of 4 ways
column2: 八行全都映射到同一组，那一组只有 4 路

column1: All four take the same time
column2: 四个 SM 一样久

column1: All three
column2: 三次都要

column1: All-Reduce
column2: 汇总

column1: Almost all of them
column2: 几乎全部

column1: Almost none of them
column2: 几乎一个也没有

column2: 总是四个

column2: 总是新值

column1: An SM has 256 registers per lane to hand out: 256 / 8 = 32 warps, but 256 / 9 = 28. With 28 warps only three 8-warp blocks fit, so the fourth block of a wave waits for a seat. The Regs star is exactly this line.
column2: 每个 SM 每条车道有 256 个寄存器可分：256 / 8 = 32 个 warp，256 / 9 却只有 28。28 个 warp 只装得下三个 8 warp 的块，同一波里的第四个块要等座位。寄存器那颗星，说的正是这条线。

column1: An SM has 8192 shared words. The old kernel declares .smem 4900 for each block. How many of its blocks can sit on one SM at the same time?
column2: 一个 SM 有 8192 个共享字。旧内核每块声明 .smem 4900。同一时刻一个 SM 上能放几个它的块？

column1: An SM holds 256 register slots per lane. A kernel using 8 registers per thread keeps 32 warps resident. If it grows to 16 registers per thread, how many warps stay resident?
column2: 一个 SM 每条车道有 256 个寄存器槽。每线程用 8 个寄存器的内核能留住 32 个 warp。如果涨到每线程 16 个寄存器，还能留住几个 warp？

column1: An atomic counter only promises each caller a different number, never an order. Where a cell goes must depend on its index alone.
column2: 原子计数器只保证每个调用者拿到不同的数，从不保证顺序。一个格子该去哪儿，只能取决于它自己的下标。

column1: Another block may see your later store before your earlier one. A fence makes the earlier stores visible before anything after it is written.
column2: 别的块可能先看到你较晚的写入，后看到较早的。栅栏保证它之前的写入先变得可见，之后的才写。

column1: Anything past 65504 rounds to infinity in half precision, and the largest input that survives is about 11.09. Infinity in the sum turns the reciprocal into 0 and every p into NaN.
column2: 半精度里超过 65504 的数都舍成无穷大，能幸存的最大输入约为 11.09。和里一出现无穷大，倒数就成了 0，每个 p 都变成 NaN。

column1: At each position the wind tower has pairs of sensors: pressure and area, tension and length. rom[0] is n, rom[1] the stride between consecutive arrays, rom[2] the number of pairs P (2 or 3). Array k starts at rom[32 + k·stride]; arrays 2j and 2j+1 form pair j.\nFor every position i < n: out[i] = a₀[i]·a₁[i] + a₂[i]·a₃[i] (+ a₄[i]·a₅[i] when P is 3). Blocks have 64 threads.\nThe old kernel asks for one pair, waits for it, then asks for the next. Yinpo says the tower spends its life waiting.
column2: 风塔每个位置上有几对传感器：压强和面积，张力和长度。rom[0] 是 n，rom[1] 是相邻两个数组的间隔，rom[2] 是对数 P（2 或 3）。第 k 个数组从 rom[32 + k·stride] 开始；数组 2j 与 2j+1 组成第 j 对。\n对每个位置 i < n：out[i] = a₀[i]·a₁[i] + a₂[i]·a₃[i]（P 为 3 时再加 a₄[i]·a₅[i]）。每块 64 个线程。\n旧内核问一对、等一对，再问下一对。银婆说风塔一辈子都花在等上了。

column1: At the same time
column2: 一样

column1: Atomic appends are fast and everywhere, but their output order changes from run to run. Deterministic builds use scans, then scatter.
column2: 原子追加又快又随处可见，但输出顺序每次运行都会变。要得到确定的结果，就用扫描再散布。

column1: Atomics keep the total right by taking turns: lanes on one address are served one after another. A flat picture puts all 32 lanes of every warp on the same word.
column2: 原子操作靠轮流来保证总数正确：同一个地址上的车道一个接一个地被服务。一幅单色的图，让每个 warp 的 32 条车道都落在同一个字上。

column1: Atomics on one address are serial. Count in a fast place and merge once; the fewer lanes share a counter, the shorter the queue.
column2: 同一个地址上的原子操作是串行的。在快的地方数，最后只合并一次；共用一个计数器的车道越少，队就越短。

column1: Attention
column2: 注意力

column1: BAR — wait until every warp of the block has arrived.
column2: BAR —— 等本块所有 warp 都到齐再往下走。

column1: Back to back, so both are in flight together
column2: 紧挨着发出，让两个同时在途

column1: Bank = address mod 32, and every one of these addresses is a multiple of 32: all bank 0. Thirty-two different words from one bank are served one per pass, 32 passes.
column2: bank = 地址对 32 取余，这些地址全是 32 的倍数：全在 bank 0。同一个 bank 里的 32 个不同的字一次只服务一个，要 32 趟。

column1: Before the loop, one thread issues the DMA of tile 0. In each round: BAR, then (unless it is the last tile) one thread issues the DMA of the next tile into the other buffer, then compute the current tile, then swap the buffers. One huge DMA of all 1024 words also beats the old kernel, but it needs 1024 words of shared memory against 256.
column2: 进循环前，由一个线程发出第 0 块的 DMA。每一轮：先 BAR，然后（如果不是最后一块）由一个线程把下一块的 DMA 发进另一个缓冲，再计算当前块，最后交换缓冲。一次性把 1024 个字全搬进来也能胜过旧内核，但要用 1024 个共享字，而不是 256 个。

column1: Behind You
column2: 身后

column1: Between 512 and 1024 neighbouring halves are 0.5 apart. 0.2 is less than half a step, so the add rounds back to 1000. Do that 200 times and the sum has not moved.
column2: 512 到 1024 之间相邻的半精度数相隔 0.5。0.2 不到半格，所以这次加法又舍回 1000。这样加 200 次，和一点没动。

column1: Beyond a texture's edge you must say what exists: the edge repeated, the picture tiled, or a mirror. Each is a different line of index maths.
column2: 纹理的边缘之外有什么，必须你来规定：重复边缘、平铺整幅图，或是镜像。每一种都是不同的一行下标运算。

column1: Big swallows small
column2: 大数吞小数

column1: Bilinear filtering
column2: 双线性滤波

column1: Block 0 stores the data, then stores the flag. Can block 1 see the flag set and still read the old data?
column2: 0 号块先存数据，再存标志。1 号块能不能看到标志已置位，却仍读到旧数据？

column1: Block 3 and block 4 both write the cell between them. Which write lands last?
column2: 块 3 和块 4 都往它们之间的那个格子写。哪一次写入落在最后？

column1: Block 3, it has the lower number
column2: 块 3，它的编号小

column1: Block 4, it has the higher number
column2: 块 4，它的编号大

column1: Blocks and threads both have an x and a y, and each direction has its own ragged edge to guard.
column2: 块和线程都有 x 和 y 两个方向，每个方向都有自己参差的边要守。

column1: Blocks are dealt to the SMs in queue order but start at different moments, and no rule orders them. Whoever happens to write last wins, and the next seed may change who that is.
column2: 块按队列顺序分给各个 SM，但开始的时刻不同，没有任何规则排定它们的先后。谁碰巧最后写谁赢，换一个种子可能就换了人。

column1: Blocks of a grid may run in any order and in parallel, and CUDA gives no ordering between them. Two blocks writing the same address is a data race: the result can change from run to run.
column2: 网格里的块可以任意顺序、并行运行，CUDA 不保证它们之间的先后。两个块写同一个地址就是数据竞争：结果每次运行都可能不同。

column1: Blocks race, so partition the output
column2: 块之间会抢跑，所以要划分输出

column1: Blocks that are too small repeat the per-block work; blocks that are too large cannot be spread evenly across the SMs. The best size sits between.
column2: 块太小，每块的固定工作要重复很多次；块太大，又没法均匀分给各个 SM。最合适的大小在两者之间。

column1:
Bohe hangs a 64×64 picture far down the hall, where it must be drawn only 8×8. rom[y*64 + x] is the picture (rows are 64 apart here).
Do not just pick one pixel in eight: shrink it by halves. Three times, replace every 2×2 block by its average, (a+b+c+d) >> 2, rounding down: 64 → 32 → 16 → 8. Write the 8×8 result to out[y*32 + x] (x, y < 8); the other cells of out are scratch.
Each result may be off by at most 2 (rounding down at every layer loses a little).
Shared memory is 8192 words, 32 banks, and BAR makes every warp wait for the others.
column2:
薄荷把一幅 64×64 的画挂在走廊尽头，只需要画成 8×8。rom[y*64 + x] 是这幅画（这里行距是 64）。
不要每 8 个像素只挑 1 个：一半一半地缩。连做三次，把每个 2×2 的块换成它们的平均值 (a+b+c+d) >> 2，向下取整：64 → 32 → 16 → 8。把 8×8 的结果写到 out[y*32 + x]（x、y < 8）；out 的其余单元是草稿区。
每个结果允许差 2（每层都向下取整，会各丢一点）。
共享内存有 8192 个字、32 个 bank，BAR 让所有 warp 等齐。

column1: Bohe has two columns of morning readings and needs them added up. rom[0..512] holds the first column, rom[512..1024] the second; write out[i] = rom[i] + rom[512 + i] for i in 0..512.\nThe program below starts one warp and walks all 512 cells in 16 rounds, waiting on memory every round. Put the first line `.warps N` (1..16) at the top of your program to choose how many warps run. Memory still takes 400 cycles. What can the others do meanwhile?
column2: 薄荷有两列早上的读数，要加起来。rom[0..512] 是第一列，rom[512..1024] 是第二列；对 i 在 0..512 写出 out[i] = rom[i] + rom[512 + i]。\n下面的程序只启动一个 warp，分 16 轮走完 512 个格子，每一轮都要等内存。在程序第一行写 `.warps N`（1..16）可以选择启动多少个 warp。内存仍然要 400 周期，其他 warp 在这段时间里能做什么？

column1: Bohe keeps a short tally sheet: 128 numbers in rom[0..128]. Add them all up and write the total to out[0]. One warp runs; every lane reads the same address, so the lanes agree.\nA global read takes 400 cycles, but memory hands back a whole 32-word line at once and keeps it in the small L1. The program below reads the sheet one number at a time and stops dead at the start of every line. Make it faster.
column2: 薄荷有一张小统计单：rom[0..128] 里 128 个数。把它们全部加起来，总数写到 out[0]。只有一个 warp，所有车道读同一个地址，所以大家结果一致。\n一次全局读要 400 周期，但内存一次会交回整整一行 32 个字，放进小小的 L1。下面的程序一个数一个数地读，每到一行的开头就停下来干等。让它更快。

column1: Bohe needs today's ledger tallied before closing. rom[0..4096] is 512 patient records of 8 words each: age, dose, ward, flag, then four spare words. The clinic's age line for today is in rom[4096] (usually 60); the flag is 0 or 1.\nWrite out[0] = how many patients are at or above the age line and flagged, and out[1] = the sum of their doses. Choose how many warps with `.warps N` if you like.\nEvery record sits in a 32-word line with three others, and every line costs 400 cycles to fetch. Fewer trips and fewer instructions both count.
column2: 薄荷想在关门前把今天的台账结清。rom[0..4096] 是 512 条病历，每条 8 个字：年龄、剂量、病房、标志，后面四个字备用。今天的年龄线在 rom[4096]（通常是 60）；标志是 0 或 1。\n写出 out[0] = 年龄不低于年龄线且打了标志的病人数，out[1] = 他们的剂量之和。想用几个 warp，可以用 `.warps N` 选。\n每条病历和另外三条同住一个 32 字的行，每取一行要 400 周期。少跑几趟、少写几条指令，都算数。

column1: Bohe runs the clinic's viewer. rom[y*128 + x] is a 128×128 scan, grey 0..255. After it: rom[16384] = log2 of the zoom (0, 1, 2 for ×1, ×2, ×4), rom[16385] and rom[16386] = the pan, the scan texel under the viewport's top-left corner (it may be negative or past the edge).\nThe viewport is 64×64: out[Y*64 + X] = LUT[v]. v is the scan sampled bilinearly at s = ((2X+1) << (15 − zoom)) − 32768 + (pan << 16) in Q16 texels, for x with X and pan x, for y with Y and pan y; the edge texel repeats outside the scan, and every blend rounds down as in 9-2. LUT is the equalisation of the whole scan, as in 9-6: LUT[g] = (cdf[g] − cdf_min) · 255 / (16384 − cdf_min). Each result may be off by at most 1, but v itself must be exact: one grey off can move the LUT by more than 1.\nThe machine is yours: 16 warps, 8192 shared words. The clinic pays by the frame, and reads from the scan are what the memory bus bills.
column2: 薄荷在管诊所的观片机。rom[y*128 + x] 是 128×128 的片子，灰度 0..255。其后：rom[16384] = 缩放的对数（0、1、2 对应 ×1、×2、×4），rom[16385] 和 rom[16386] = 平移，即视口左上角下面的那个纹素（可以是负数，也可以越出片子边缘）。\n视口是 64×64：out[Y*64 + X] = LUT[v]。v 是对片子的双线性取样，位置 s = ((2X+1) << (15 − 缩放)) − 32768 + (平移 << 16)（Q16 纹素），横向用 X 和横向平移，纵向用 Y 和纵向平移；片子之外重复边缘纹素，每次混合都向下取整，和 9-2 一样。LUT 是对整张片子的均衡，和 9-6 一样：LUT[g] = (cdf[g] − cdf_min) · 255 / (16384 − cdf_min)。每个结果允许差 1，但 v 本身必须精确：灰度差一级，LUT 的结果可能就差得更多。\n机器随你组装：16 个线程束，8192 个共享字。诊所按帧付钱，而内存总线按读取片子的次数收费。

column1: Bohe smooths a row of 256 readings by blending each with its two right-hand neighbours: out[i] = rom[i] + 2 * rom[i + 1] + rom[i + 2]. The sheet is rom[0..258].\nOne warp runs; lane l handles i = l + 32j for j = 0..7. Each i needs three reads and neighbouring cells share lines, so most reads should be cheap. The program below is correct but spends the whole time waiting, one new line at a time. Cut the cycles.
column2: 薄荷要把一排 256 个读数抹平：每个读数和它右边的两个邻居混合，out[i] = rom[i] + 2 * rom[i + 1] + rom[i + 2]。读数单是 rom[0..258]。\n一个 warp，车道 l 负责 i = l + 32j（j = 0..7）。每个 i 要读三个字，相邻的格子共用同一行，所以大多数读取应该很便宜。下面的程序结果是对的，但时间全花在等上了，一次只等一个新行。把周期降下来。

column1:
Bohe wants the gallery pictures softened. rom[y*64 + x] is a grey picture of width W = rom[4096] and height H = rom[4097] (each at most 64); out[y*64 + x] gets the blurred one.
The blur is a 9×9 binomial kernel: the weight of tap (i, j) is w[i]·w[j], with w = 1 8 28 56 70 56 28 8 1 (they add up to 256, so both together 65536). Taps outside the picture repeat the edge pixel (clamp).
The kernel splits: blur every row with w, keeping the sums as they are, then every column of that with w, and shift right by 16 once at the end. The result matches the 2D kernel exactly. Cells outside the W×H picture are not checked.
Shared memory is 8192 words; BAR waits for every warp.
column2:
薄荷想把画廊里的画变柔和。rom[y*64 + x] 是一幅灰度图，宽 W = rom[4096]，高 H = rom[4097]（都不超过 64）；模糊后的图写到 out[y*64 + x]。
模糊用 9×9 的二项式核：第 (i, j) 个抽头的权重是 w[i]·w[j]，w = 1 8 28 56 70 56 28 8 1（和为 256，两个方向合起来是 65536）。图外的抽头重复边缘像素（钳位）。
这个核可以拆开：先把每一行用 w 卷一遍，和不要移位；再把得到的每一列用 w 卷一遍，最后只右移 16 位一次。结果与二维核逐像素一致。W×H 之外的单元不检查。
共享内存有 8192 个字；BAR 让所有 warp 等齐。

column1: Bohe's clinic chart room runs three tiny kernels over the day's readings, one after another. Each reads every cell from global memory and writes it back: 3x + 1, then squared, then ×5 + 7.\nrom[0..512] holds the readings x (0..9), one per thread; write out[i] = (3x + 1)² × 5 + 7 for all 512 threads (16 warps). The out buffer can be read back with LDO.\nThe three passes below are right but slow. Make the same sums in fewer cycles.
column2: 薄荷诊所的病历室每天对读数跑三个小内核，一个接一个：每个都把每个格子从全局内存读出来、再写回去。第一个算 3x + 1，第二个平方，第三个 ×5 + 7。\nrom[0..512] 是读数 x（0..9），每个线程一个；对全部 512 个线程（16 个 warp）写出 out[i] = (3x + 1)² × 5 + 7。out 缓冲区可以用 LDO 读回来。\n下面的三趟程序结果是对的，但很慢。用更少的周期算出同样的数。

column1: Bohe's eight wards each keep a 32-word daily sheet, but the sheets sit 128 words apart: ward k starts at rom[128k]. Lane c adds up column c over the eight wards, then weights the four shifts of the day by 1, 2, 3 and 4: out[c] = sum over passes p = 0..3 of (p + 1) * (sum over wards k of rom[128k + c]).\nThe program below does it pass by pass, walking all eight wards four times. Eight lines is only half of the 16-line L1, yet every read misses. Find out why and fix it.
column2: 薄荷的八个病房各有一张 32 个字的日报，但这些日报相隔 128 个字：病房 k 从 rom[128k] 开始。车道 c 把第 c 列在八个病房里加起来，再按一天四个班次的权重 1、2、3、4 加权：out[c] = 对第 p = 0..3 遍求和 (p + 1) * (对病房 k 求和 rom[128k + c])。\n下面的程序一遍一遍地做，把八个病房走了四遍。八行只占 16 行 L1 的一半，可每次读都缺失。找出原因，改掉它。

column1: Bohe's enlarged pictures hang a little off: everything seems nudged toward the top left, and the edges look wrong. The kernel is the bilinear stretch of the last levels (32×32 output, texture side T = 8, 16 or 32 from rom[1024], layout as before, each result may be off by at most 1), but someone changed how the sample position is worked out.\nFind the first wrong pixel being written. Point at it in the Warp River, then fix the kernel.
column2: 薄荷放大的画总是挂歪了：整幅图像被推向左上角，边缘也不对。这个内核就是前几关的双线性拉伸（输出 32×32，纹理边长 T = 8、16 或 32，取自 rom[1024]，布局同前，每个结果允许差 1），但有人改了取样位置的算法。\n找到第一个写错的像素，在 Warp River 里指出它，再修好内核。

column1: Bohe's enlarged pictures have grown bright lines along their borders: a bright right edge leaks onto the left edge, and the bottom onto the top. The kernel is the bilinear stretch again (32×32 output, texture side T = 8, 16 or 32 from rom[1024], layout as before, each result may be off by at most 1), but now it picks the four neighbours by index, and something is wrong at the picture's edge.\nFind the first pixel written with the wrong colour. Point at it in the Warp River, then fix the kernel so that the edge texel repeats beyond the picture (clamp).
column2: 薄荷放大的画沿边出现了亮线：右边缘的亮色漏到了左边缘，下边缘漏到了上边缘。这个内核还是双线性拉伸（输出 32×32，纹理边长 T = 8、16 或 32，取自 rom[1024]，布局同前，每个结果允许差 1），不过这回是按下标挑四个邻居的，图的边缘处出了问题。\n找到第一个写错颜色的像素，在 Warp River 里指出它，再修好内核：图外的部分要重复边缘纹素（钳位）。

column1: Bohe's gallery keeps its pictures as small textures. rom[y*32 + x] is the texel in column x of row y (one row per cache line), and rom[1024] is log2 of the texture's side T, which is 8, 16 or 32.\nStretch the texture over the 32×32 output, out[y*32 + x]. Each output pixel shows the texel under its centre: column ((2x+1)·T) >> 6, row ((2y+1)·T) >> 6. Read T from rom; do not hard-code 16.
column2: 薄荷的画廊把画存成小纹理。rom[y*32 + x] 是第 y 行第 x 列的纹素（一行正好一个缓存行），rom[1024] 是纹理边长 T 的 log2，T 为 8、16 或 32。\n把纹理拉伸铺满 32×32 的输出 out[y*32 + x]。每个输出像素显示它中心下面的那个纹素：列 ((2x+1)·T) >> 6，行 ((2y+1)·T) >> 6。T 要从 rom 里读，不能写死 16。

column1: Bohe's long tally sheet has 1024 numbers in rom[0..1024]: 32 lines of 32 words. Add them up into out[0]. One warp, every lane reading the same address.\nThe program below is correct, but it takes ages. It walks with a stride of 32: the first word of every line, then the second word of every line, and so on. The L1 holds only 16 lines. Find out why every read pays the full wait, and fix it.
column2: 薄荷的长统计单有 1024 个数，在 rom[0..1024]：32 行，每行 32 个字。加起来写到 out[0]。一个 warp，所有车道读同一个地址。\n下面的程序结果是对的，但慢得离谱。它每次跨 32 步：先读每一行的第一个字，再读每一行的第二个字，如此往下。L1 只装得下 16 行。找出为什么每次读都要付满额的等待，然后改掉。

column1: Bohe's scans are too flat: nearly every pixel is the same dull grey. rom[y*64 + x] is a 64×64 picture, grey levels 0..255. Spread them out: out[y*64 + x] = (cdf[v] − cdf_min) · 255 / (4096 − cdf_min), where v is the pixel, cdf[v] counts the pixels with grey ≤ v, and cdf_min is cdf at the darkest grey that occurs. Divide rounding down.\nIf every pixel is alike, the denominator is 0 and the answer is 0, not garbage. Each result may be off by at most 1, so RCP (65536 / x, and i32::MAX for 0) can stand in for the division.\nATOMS d, [a], v adds v to shared word a and gives back the old value. Counting takes a barrier; the running total over 256 buckets can be done by one lane.
column2: 薄荷的扫描片太平了：几乎每个像素都是同一种灰。rom[y*64 + x] 是 64×64 的图，灰度 0..255。把它们拉开：out[y*64 + x] = (cdf[v] − cdf_min) · 255 / (4096 − cdf_min)，其中 v 是像素值，cdf[v] 是灰度 ≤ v 的像素个数，cdf_min 是出现过的最暗灰度处的 cdf。除法向下取整。\n如果全图所有像素都一样，分母为 0，答案应是 0，而不是乱值。每个结果允许差 1，所以可以用 RCP（65536 / x，0 时给 i32::MAX）来代替除法。\nATOMS d, [a], v 把 v 加到共享内存的字 a 上，并返回旧值。计数要靠屏障；256 个桶的累计可以由一个车道完成。

column1: Bohe's ward-by-test table is a 32 x 32 grid of weights in rom[0..1024], one row per cache line, followed by a weight vector x in rom[1024..1056]. Write out[r] = sum over c of A[r][c] * x[c] for the 32 rows.\nOne warp; lane r owns row r. The program below sets all 32 lanes walking along their rows at once. It is right, but 32 rows plus the x line is twice what the 16-line L1 can hold. Rearrange the work so the cache can keep up.
column2: 薄荷的病房检测对照表是 rom[0..1024] 里一张 32 x 32 的权重表，一行一个缓存行，后面 rom[1024..1056] 是权重向量 x。对 32 行写出 out[r] = 对 c 求和 A[r][c] * x[c]。\n一个 warp；车道 r 负责第 r 行。下面的程序让 32 条车道同时沿各自的行往前走。结果是对的，但 32 行加上 x 那一行，是 16 行 L1 容量的两倍多。重新安排一下工作，让缓存跟得上。

column1: C = A·B for FP16 matrices, now with the tensor unit. rom[0..3] are M, N, K (M and N multiples of 16, K a multiple of 4). A (M x K, row-major FP16 bits) starts at rom[32], B (K x N) follows it. C goes to out[i·N + j] as integers; every other cell stays 0. All values are small integers, so FP32 accumulation is exact.\nThe grid is one warp per 16x16 block of C: bx is the block column, by the block row. Half warp h of that warp takes the 8 rows 8h..8h+7, that is two tile rows by four tile columns, eight 4x4 accumulators in total. Walk along K in steps of 4 with MMA acc, a, b, acc and keep the accumulators in registers between steps.\nThe starter is correct but issues one MMA per tile pair and reloads both fragments for each of them.
column2: 用张量单元算 FP16 矩阵的 C = A·B。rom[0..3] 是 M、N、K（M、N 是 16 的倍数，K 是 4 的倍数）。A（M x K，行主序，FP16 位型）从 rom[32] 开始，B（K x N）紧随其后。C 以整数写到 out[i·N + j]，其余格子保持 0。所有数值都是小整数，FP32 累加是精确的。\n网格是每个 warp 负责 C 的一块 16x16：bx 是块列，by 是块行。该 warp 的第 h 个半 warp 取 8 行 8h..8h+7，也就是两行 tile、四列 tile，共八个 4x4 累加器。沿 K 方向每次走 4，用 MMA acc, a, b, acc，并在各步之间把累加器留在寄存器里。\n起始方案是对的，但每个 tile 对各发一条 MMA，每次都重新装两个片段。

column1: Cenli wants C = A·B for two 64x64 matrices. A is row-major from rom[0], B is row-major from rom[4096]. Thread t owns output cell t of C (row t >> 6, column t AND 63) and writes it to out[t]. The grid is 16 blocks of 256 threads. All values are small integers.\nThe starter is the textbook triple loop: it is right, but every thread fetches its whole row of A and column of B from global memory. Stage 16x16 tiles through shared memory instead. There is no tensor unit yet: this is the scalar path.
column2: 岑理要两个 64x64 矩阵的乘积 C = A·B。A 行主序，从 rom[0] 开始；B 行主序，从 rom[4096] 开始。线程 t 负责 C 的第 t 个格子（行 t >> 6，列 t AND 63），写到 out[t]。网格是 16 个块、每块 256 个线程。所有数值都是小整数。\n起始方案是教科书式的三重循环：结果对，但每个线程都从全局内存取整行 A 和整列 B。改成把 16x16 的小块经共享内存装入。这里还没有张量单元：走的是标量路径。

column1: Cenli's bench checks one thing at a time: y = A·x. rom[0] is M, rom[1] is N, A (M rows of N, row-major) starts at rom[32] and the N values of x follow it. Write the M sums y[i] = A[i][0]·x[0] + ... into out[i]; the other cells stay 0.\nThe starter gives each row to one thread. It is right, but neighbouring threads read addresses N words apart. This level lets you pick the block size with .block. Every element of A is read exactly once, so the only thing left to win is how fast the reads arrive.
column2: 岑理的审查台一次只核一件事：y = A·x。rom[0] 是 M，rom[1] 是 N，A（M 行、每行 N 个，行主序）从 rom[32] 开始，后面紧跟 x 的 N 个值。把 M 个和 y[i] = A[i][0]·x[0] + ... 写进 out[i]，其余格子保持 0。\n起始方案让每个线程算一行：结果是对的，但相邻线程读的地址相隔 N 个字。这一关可以用 .block 选块大小。A 的每个元素只读一次，剩下能赢的只有读数据到达的快慢。

column1: Cenli's bench receives batches of 16 jobs. Each job is a 64x64 matrix A, a 64x64 matrix B and a claimed product C, one after another: job t starts at rom[128 + 12288·t] and holds A, then B, then C, each row-major. rom[32..96) is a fixed vector r with entries 1..7. For every job write out[t] = 1 if C = A·B and 0 if it is not, and write the ledger copy out[16 + t] = 4 · out[t]. Launched as 16 blocks of 32 threads.\nHalf of an ordinary batch is wrong: one cell changed, two cells swapped inside a row, two swapped inside a column, the whole C transposed, or zeroed. Every ordinary verdict must be right, false alarms included. The hidden batches also hold forged claims built against r itself: the forger changes four cells so that C·r and rᵀ·C both still agree with A·B. A forged claim you accept is a miss. It does not fail the batch, but it costs the third star. Recomputing every product is slow, so find a cheaper test. There is no starter.
column2: 岑理的审查台每次收到一批 16 份任务。每份是一个 64x64 的矩阵 A、一个 64x64 的矩阵 B 和声称的乘积 C，依次排列：第 t 份从 rom[128 + 12288·t] 开始，先 A，再 B，再 C，都按行主序。rom[32..96) 是固定的向量 r，元素为 1..7。对每一份写 out[t]：C = A·B 写 1，不等写 0；再写账本副本 out[16 + t] = 4 · out[t]。启动是 16 个块、每块 32 个线程。\n普通批里有一半是错的：改了一个格、同一行内互换两格、同一列内互换两格、整块 C 转置，或者清零。每个普通判定都必须对，误报也不行。隐藏批里还有针对 r 伪造的声称：伪造者改四个格，让 C·r 与 rᵀ·C 都仍然和 A·B 的结果一致。接受了一份伪造的声称算一次漏检。它不会让整批失败，但会丢掉第三颗星。每份都重算乘积太慢，想一个更便宜的检验。没有初始方案。

column1: Cenli's deep-well probe mixes 256 readings per lane: y[lane] = sum over k of W[k][lane] · x[k]. Everything is stored as halves: W[k][lane] at rom[32 + 32k + lane], x[k] at rom[8224 + k].\nrom[0] is a scale s (FP32). Write out[lane] = round(y · s). The host picked s so the largest |y| of each case lands near 4096, so an error of 4 in out is about 0.1% of full scale.\nHalves are cheap to fetch but carry only 11 significant bits. Decide where each product and each sum is allowed to live.
column2: 岑理的深井探头每条车道要混合 256 个读数：y[lane] = 对 k 求和 W[k][lane] · x[k]。全部以半精度存放：W[k][lane] 在 rom[32 + 32k + lane]，x[k] 在 rom[8224 + k]。\nrom[0] 是缩放 s（FP32）。写出 out[lane] = round(y · s)。主机挑 s，让每组数据里最大的 |y| 落在 4096 附近，所以 out 差 4 大约是满量程的 0.1%。\n半精度取数便宜，但只有 11 位有效数字。想清楚每个乘积、每个和该放在哪种精度里。

column1: Cenli's echo stones keep every reading as a half float: 16 bits, sign s (bit 15), exponent e (bits 10..14), mantissa m (bits 0..9). For e = 1..30 the value is (-1)^s · (1 + m/1024) · 2^(e-15). With e = 0 the value is tiny (a subnormal), well under 1/256.\nrom[0..32] holds one half per lane, in the low 16 bits of the word. Write out[lane] = value × 256, cut toward zero to an integer.\nThe FP units are still locked: decode it with integer instructions.
column2: 岑理的回响石把每个读数存成半精度浮点：16 位，符号 s（第 15 位）、指数 e（第 10..14 位）、尾数 m（第 0..9 位）。e = 1..30 时值为 (-1)^s · (1 + m/1024) · 2^(e-15)。e = 0 时值极小（次正规数），远小于 1/256。\nrom[0..32] 每条车道一个半精度数，放在字的低 16 位。写出 out[lane] = 值 × 256，向零取整。\n浮点单元还没解锁：用整数指令把它拆开。

column1: Cenli's listening array scores 32 echoes at once. rom[0..32] holds one half-precision score per lane. Turn the row into weights, p[i] = exp(s[i]) / sum of exp(s[j]), and write out[lane] = round(1000 · p).\nThe old kernel does exactly that formula in half precision, and some rows come back as garbage. Run it on the second public row and find the first exp that goes wrong.
column2: 岑理的聆听阵列一次给 32 个回声打分。rom[0..32] 每条车道一个半精度分数。把这一行变成权重：p[i] = exp(s[i]) / 所有 exp(s[j]) 之和，写出 out[lane] = round(1000 · p)。\n旧内核恰好是按这个公式在半精度里算的，有些行出来是乱码。在第二个公开行上跑一遍，找出第一个出错的 exp。

column1: Cenli's relay stone is short on bandwidth, so the probe now works on 8-bit integers. Each lane takes a 64-term dot product: y[lane] = sum over k of W[k][lane] · x[k], with W at rom[32 + 32k + lane] and x at rom[2080 + k], both halves.\nThe host gives three FP32 constants: rom[0] = 1/s_w and rom[1] = 1/s_x (each s is the largest |value| divided by 127), and rom[2] = s_w · s_x · S, where S puts the largest |y| of the case at 1000.\nWrite out[lane] = round(S · y). Quantize both operands to INT8 (CVT.B.F rounds and clamps to ±127), multiply the integers, and keep the sum somewhere that cannot wrap. The FP adders are off this bench.
column2: 岑理的中继石带宽不够，探头改用 8 位整数。每条车道做一个 64 项点积：y[lane] = 对 k 求和 W[k][lane] · x[k]，W 在 rom[32 + 32k + lane]，x 在 rom[2080 + k]，都是半精度。\n主机给出三个 FP32 常数：rom[0] = 1/s_w，rom[1] = 1/s_x（s 是各自最大 |值| 除以 127），rom[2] = s_w · s_x · S，S 把每组数据里最大的 |y| 放到 1000。\n写出 out[lane] = round(S · y)。把两个操作数量化成 INT8（CVT.B.F 四舍五入并钳在 ±127），按整数相乘，把和放在不会回绕的地方。这张工作台上没有浮点加法器。

column1: Cenli's relay stone sends each lane 16 activations, halves at rom[32 + 32k + lane], to be dotted with 16 shared INT8 weights, plain integers at rom[0..16]. The weight scale is already folded in: rom[16] is an FP32 constant, and out[lane] = round(rom[16] · sum of a[k] · w[k]). The host chose it so the largest |out| of a case is about 1000.\nThe old kernel turns the activations into INT8 with a scale it learned on the calibration set, where everything stayed within ±1. Run it on the second public case and find the first activation it has to clamp.
column2: 岑理的中继石给每条车道送来 16 个激活，半精度，在 rom[32 + 32k + lane]，要和 16 个共享的 INT8 权重（普通整数，rom[0..16]）做点积。权重的缩放已经折进去了：rom[16] 是一个 FP32 常数，out[lane] = round(rom[16] · 对 k 求和 a[k] · w[k])。主机选它是为了让每组数据里最大的 |out| 约为 1000。\n旧内核用在校准集上学到的缩放把激活变成 INT8，那批数据全在 ±1 以内。在第二个公开用例上跑一遍，找出它第一个被迫钳住的激活。

column1: Cenli's tally stone adds 64 readings per lane in half precision. Reading k of lane l is the half at rom[32k + l]; only FP16 addition is on the bench (HADD), the FP32 accumulator is not.\nWrite out[lane] = the sum, converted to an integer (CVT.I.H). Most readings are small, but each lane also holds a big one, somewhere. The same 64 numbers always have the same true sum. Make the half-precision answer land near it.
column2: 岑理的计数石要对每条车道的 64 个读数做半精度求和。第 l 条车道的第 k 个读数是 rom[32k + l] 处的半精度数；工作台上只开放 FP16 加法（HADD），没有 FP32 累加器。\n写出 out[lane] = 总和，转成整数（CVT.I.H）。大多数读数很小，但每条车道里还藏着一个大的，位置不定。同样的 64 个数，真实的和只有一个。让半精度的答案落在它附近。

column1: Clamp means the edge texel goes on forever, so the blend is column 15 with itself: nothing changes. Wrapping would mix in column 0 and paint the opposite edge's colour onto the border.
column2: 钳位的意思是边缘纹素一直延伸下去，所以混合的是第 15 列和它自己：什么也不变。回绕则会混进第 0 列，把对面边缘的颜色涂到边上。

column1: Clamp s itself between 0 and (T−1) << 16 with MAX and MIN. Then the right and lower neighbours can only be read with weight 0 at the edge.
column2: 用 MAX 和 MIN 把 s 本身夹在 0 与 (T−1) << 16 之间。这样在边缘处，右边和下边的邻居只会带着 0 权重被读到。

column1: Clear the accumulators once, before the loop. Inside the loop the C input of MMA must be the previous step's result. Registers start at zero, so no clear is needed at all.
column2: 累加器只在循环之前清一次。循环里 MMA 的 C 输入必须是上一步的结果。寄存器本来就从 0 开始，所以根本不用清。

column1: Column 5's centre is at 5.5 of 32, which is 2.75 of 16: it lies inside texel 2. Using the pixel number as the texel number would give 5 and show the picture at the wrong scale.

column1: Column sum = LDS above + own + LDS below. Then add SHFL of lane - 1 and lane + 1 (clamped). Without BAR, a warp that started early reads rows its neighbours have not written yet.
column2: 列和 = 上方 LDS + 自己 + 下方 LDS。再加上车道 lane - 1 与 lane + 1（夹住）的 SHFL。没有 BAR，先开始的 warp 会读到邻居还没写的行。

column1: Compact first: every wet cell takes the next free slot in a list in shared memory (ATOMS on a counter works; a scan would too) and stores its index and value there. After a BAR, thread tx takes list entry tx.
column2: 先压紧：每个湿格在共享内存的列表里领下一个空位（对计数器做 ATOMS 即可，用扫描也行），把自己的下标和数值存进去。BAR 之后，线程 tx 取列表的第 tx 项。

column1: Compare a wrong entry with the true sum: it is off by a power of two. Open the trace at the flagged read and see which message that word came in.
column2: 把出错的项和真正的和比：差的是 2 的幂。在标出的读取处打开轨迹，看那个字是随哪条消息来的。

column1: Compared with an ADD's result, a MUL's result lands…
column2: 和 ADD 的结果相比，MUL 的结果落地得……

column1: Compilers unroll loops for exactly this reason, trading code size for fewer stalls and less loop overhead. GPU compilers do it too.
column2: 编译器展开循环就是出于这个原因：用代码体积换更少的停顿和更少的循环开销。GPU 编译器也这么做。

column1: Compute While It Travels
column2: 边算边传

column1: Compute the addresses early and keep two partial sums: the early readings go into one, the late ones into the other. Merge them at the very end.
column2: 地址早点算好，并维护两个部分和：先到的读数加进一个，后到的加进另一个，最后才合并。

column1: Compute the six-or-four addresses with a running register (ADD r0, r0, stride), put the third pair's two LDs inside IF p0 (P = 3) right after the others, and do all MULs and ADDs after the last LD.
column2: 用一个往前走的寄存器算地址（ADD r0, r0, stride）；第三对的两条 LD 放在 IF p0（P = 3）里，紧跟在其他 LD 之后；所有 MUL 和 ADD 都放到最后一条 LD 之后。

column1: Computing grows with the area of a piece, talking grows with its edge. Choose the cut with the shortest edges.
column2: 计算量跟着一块的面积走，通信量跟着它的边走。选边最短的切法。

column1: Contention
column2: 争用

column1: Copy the patch the viewport can touch into shared memory once, then read from there
column2: 把视口可能碰到的那块一次抄进共享内存，之后都从那里读

column1: Count how many pixels are at or below each grey, and use that running share as the new grey: crowded levels get spread out.
column2: 数出每个灰度及以下有多少像素，再把这个累计占比当作新的灰度：挤在一起的灰度就被拉开了。

column1: Count in a 16-word histogram in shared memory instead, where an atomic is served faster. Wait for every warp at BAR, then copy the 16 counters to out once.
column2: 改在共享内存的 16 个字里数，那里的原子操作服务得更快。在 BAR 处等所有 warp，再把 16 个计数一次写到 out。

column1: Count operations per word moved. When that ratio is low, memory sets the speed and extra arithmetic is nearly free.
column2: 数一数每搬一个字能做几次运算。比值低的时候，速度由内存决定，多做的运算几乎不要钱。

column1: Count registers. Keep the values you need in as few registers as you can: the direction and speed can be reloaded when needed, and a loaded register can be reused as soon as its value has been consumed. Eight or fewer is the goal. Prefetching the next region into spare registers is faster to write and costs the star.
column2: 数一数寄存器。尽量让需要的值占用最少的寄存器：风向和风速要用时再读一遍，读来的寄存器用完立刻可以复用。目标是 8 个或更少。把下一个区域预取到多余的寄存器里写起来快，却会丢掉那颗星。

column1: Count the LDS instructions per multiply-add in the starter. Shared memory is faster than global memory, but every LDS still costs an issue slot.
column2: 数一数起始方案里每次乘加有几条 LDS。共享内存比全局内存快，但每条 LDS 仍然占一个发射槽。

column1: Count the NOPs in the starter. Each one is a beat where the other chain could have done real work.
column2: 数一数 starter 里的 NOP。每一个都是另一条链本可以做正事的一拍。

column1: Count the loads and the MMAs per K step in the starter. Eight MMAs need only 2 A fragments and 4 B fragments, not 16.
column2: 数一数起始方案每个 K 步的读取与 MMA。八条 MMA 只需要 2 个 A 片段和 4 个 B 片段，而不是 16 个。

column1: Count the loads of the starter in the Analyzer and compare with the 64x64x64 = 262144 multiply-adds. Almost every multiply-add pays for two global reads.
column2: 在 Analyzer 里数起始方案的读取次数，和 64x64x64 = 262144 次乘加比一比。几乎每次乘加都付了两次全局读取。

column1: Count the long waits in the memory view: one per line, four in a row, because each read finishes before the next line's read starts.
column2: 在内存视图里数长等待：每行一次，一共四次，而且一个接一个，因为上一行读完才轮到下一行。

column1: Counting sort by scan
column2: 用扫描做计数排序

column1: Culling by winding
column2: 按绕向剔除

column1: Cut so the seam is short
column2: 让接缝短一点

column1: Cut the model by layers and the batch into pieces: once the pipe is full, every chip has work.
column2: 按层切模型、把批次切成小块：管道一旦灌满，每块芯片都有活干。

column1: Cut the vector into 4 chunks. In step u, SM k sends chunk (k − u) mod 4 to SM k+1 and receives chunk (k − u − 1) mod 4 from SM k−1.
column2: 把向量切成 4 块。第 u 步 SM k 把第 (k − u) mod 4 块发给 SM k+1，并从 SM k−1 收第 (k − u − 1) mod 4 块。

column1: Cut the weights by columns: each chip multiplies its own share, and only small summaries cross the links.
column2: 把权重按列切开：每块芯片乘自己那份，跨链路的只有小小的摘要。

column1: Cut, swap, overlap
column2: 切开、交换、重叠

column1: DMA dst, src, n — copy n input words into shared memory in the background. BAR waits for it.
column2: DMA dst, src, n —— 在后台把输入的 n 个字拷进共享内存。BAR 会等它完成。

column1: DOT d, a, b — d = r[a]·r[b] + r[a+1]·r[b+1]: a dot product of two register pairs.
column2: DOT d, a, b —— d = r[a]·r[b] + r[a+1]·r[b+1]：两对相邻寄存器的点积。

column1: DOT multiplies two pairs and adds them. With dx1 = x1-x0, dx2 = x0-x2, dy2 = y2-y0, dy1 = y1-y0 the area is DOT((dx1, dx2), (dy2, dy1)). Each pair must sit in consecutive registers. The MIN of the three edges and the area is positive only for covered front faces.
column2: DOT 把两对数相乘再相加。令 dx1 = x1-x0，dx2 = x0-x2，dy2 = y2-y0，dy1 = y1-y0，面积就是 DOT((dx1, dx2), (dy2, dy1))。每一对必须放在连续的寄存器里。三条边和面积四者取最小，只有被盖住的正面才为正。

column1: DRAG THE SAND SOURCE
column2: 拖动沙源

column1: Data you touched a moment ago is still in the cache. Reuse it while it is there, and start the lines you will need before you need them.
column2: 刚碰过的数据还在缓存里。趁它在就复用它，并在需要之前先把将要用的行启动起来。

column1: Database scans and analytics kernels live here: columnar layouts, fused filters and batched loads all exist to cut trips to memory.
column2: 数据库扫描和分析型内核就活在这里：列式存储、融合过滤、批量读取，都是为了减少去内存的趟数。

column1: Deleting arithmetic changes nothing, and the warps are already full. Look at which addresses the 32 lanes of one warp read at the same instant.
column2: 删算术没有用，warp 也已经是满的。看看同一个 warp 的 32 个车道在同一时刻读的是哪些地址。

column1: Direct3D 9 sampled at pixel corners and shifted every picture by half a pixel; D3D10 and later, OpenGL and Vulkan use centres. Old shaders carried a −0.5 patch for years.
column2: Direct3D 9 在像素角点取样，每张图都偏半个像素；D3D10 之后、OpenGL 和 Vulkan 都用中心。老着色器带着一句 −0.5 的补丁用了很多年。

column1: Do fewer rows at a time. Eight rows plus the x line is 9 lines, which fit. Work through the 32 rows as 4 groups of 8, and let the other lanes sit out with IF.
column2: 一次少做几行。八行加上 x 那一行是 9 行，装得下。把 32 行分成 4 组、每组 8 行来做，其余车道用 IF 歇着。

column1: Do not let 4096 lanes meet at one counter. Add inside each warp first: SHFL can bring a neighbour's value to you.
column2: 别让 4096 条车道都挤到同一个计数器前。先在每个 warp 内部相加：SHFL 能把邻居的值取过来。

column1: Do not recompute A·B. Multiply a vector v by A, then by B, and by C: if C = A·B then vᵀ·A·B = vᵀ·C. Reading each matrix once and keeping v·A in registers costs O(n²) per job.
column2: 不要重算 A·B。把一个向量 v 依次乘 A、B 和 C：若 C = A·B，则 vᵀ·A·B = vᵀ·C。每个矩阵读一遍、把 v·A 留在寄存器里，每份只要 O(n²)。

column1: Do not trust the note. Time one column read with CLOCK before and after it, once for each row pitch you try.
column2: 别信译注。用 CLOCK 包住一次按列读，每试一种行距就量一次。

column1: Domain decomposition with ghost cells (a halo) is how weather and fluid codes run on many machines.
column2: 带幽灵格（光晕）的区域分解，是气象和流体程序在许多机器上运行的办法。

column1: Double buffering is how real programs hide copies and network transfers behind computation. It costs a second buffer and a careful rule about when each one may be reused.
column2: 双缓冲是真实程序把拷贝和网络传输藏在计算后面的办法。代价是多一块缓冲，以及每块何时能复用的严格规则。

column1: Douya keeps a ledger: 32 rows of 64 numbers at rom[0..2048]. Row r starts at rom[64r]. out[r] is the sum of row r.\nThe Vault launches 16 warps. Give each warp two rows. Read a row the way it is stored, neighbouring lanes on neighbouring words, then add the lanes' partial sums together with SHFL.\nA transaction is one 32-word line touched by one warp's read. Stay within 80 of them.
column2: 豆芽有一本账：32 行，每行 64 个数，放在 rom[0..2048]。第 r 行从 rom[64r] 开始。out[r] 是第 r 行的和。\nVault 一次发出 16 个 warp。每个 warp 管两行。按它存放的样子去读，相邻车道取相邻的字，再用 SHFL 把各车道的部分和加起来。\n一个事务，就是一个 warp 的一次读摸到的一条 32 字的缓存行。别超过 80 个。

column1:
Douya wants the post office's pigeonhole table. rom[0..4096] holds 2048 letters of two words each: destination 0..31, then weight class 0..7.
Write out[g * 32 + d] = how many letters of weight class g go to destination d. 8 rows of 32 cells.
You choose how many warps to launch: write .warps N (1 to 16) as the first line. Counting in shared memory, reading the letters side by side, and the queues of the atomics are all yours to weigh.
The hard budget is what a plain global-atomic kernel needs. Every cell must match on every mail bag.
column2:
豆芽要一张邮局的格口表。rom[0..4096] 里是 2048 封信，每封两个字：目的地 0..31，然后是重量级 0..7。
写出 out[g * 32 + d] = 重量级为 g、寄往 d 的信有几封。8 行 × 32 格。
启动多少个 warp 由你定：第一行写 .warps N（1 到 16）。在共享内存里数、让相邻车道读相邻的信、原子操作的排队，都由你自己权衡。
硬预算是只用全局原子操作的朴素内核所需的周期。每一袋邮件的每一个格口都必须对。

column1: Douya's brightening machine turns every number of a 32 by 16 picture into twice itself plus one: out[i] = 2 * in[i] + 1, the picture at rom[0..512] in row-major order. 16 warps, one thread per number.\nThe answers come out right, yet the Vault says it spends 16 times the memory traffic it should. Find the read that scatters, then fix the kernel.\nStay within 16 read transactions: one per warp.
column2: 豆芽的增亮机把一幅 32×16 的图里每个数变成两倍加一：out[i] = 2 * in[i] + 1，图按行主序放在 rom[0..512]。16 个 warp，每个数一个线程。\n答案是对的，可 Vault 说它花了应有的 16 倍内存流量。找出那次散开的读，再把内核修好。\n读事务数别超过 16：每个 warp 一次。

column1: Douya's film has 2048 pixels at rom[0..2048], each one of 16 grey levels, 0 to 15. Count them: out[v] is how many pixels have level v.\n16 warps, 512 threads, four pixels each: thread t takes pixels t, t + 512, t + 1024 and t + 1536.\nATOM d, [a], v adds v to the word at out[a] and hands back the old value; ATOMS does the same in shared memory. Lanes that add to the same word wait their turn, one after another. Finish within 3000 cycles.
column2: 豆芽的胶片有 2048 个像素，放在 rom[0..2048]，每个是 16 级灰度之一，0 到 15。数一数：out[v] 是灰度为 v 的像素个数。\n16 个 warp，512 个线程，每个线程四个像素：线程 t 取第 t、t + 512、t + 1024、t + 1536 个。\nATOM d, [a], v 把 v 加到 out[a] 这个字上，并交回旧值；ATOMS 在共享内存里做同样的事。往同一个字上加的车道要排队，一个接一个。在 3000 个周期内完成。

column1: Douya's sorting room has a 32 by 32 table at rom[0..1024]. Turn it on its side: out[c * 32 + r] = in[r * 32 + c]. One warp, a loop of 32 rounds.\nRead the table by rows from global memory, neighbours on neighbours, park it in shared memory, then read it back by columns. Shared memory has 32 banks: word a lives in bank a mod 32, and lanes that want different words of one bank are served one after another.\nShared memory is big enough for 32 by 33. A load takes 400 cycles to come back, so issue several before you use any. Finish within 3800 cycles.
column2: 豆芽的分拣室里有一张 32×32 的表，放在 rom[0..1024]。把它翻个身：out[c * 32 + r] = in[r * 32 + c]。一个 warp，循环 32 圈。\n从全局内存按行读表，相邻车道读相邻的字，存进共享内存，再按列读回来。共享内存有 32 个 bank：第 a 个字住在 bank a 对 32 取余，想要同一个 bank 里不同字的车道，只能一个接一个地被服务。\n共享内存放得下 32×33。一次读要 400 个周期才回来，所以先发出几次再去用。在 3800 个周期内完成。

column1: Douya's window shows a grey picture, 32 wide and 16 tall, at rom[0..512]: pixel (x, y) is rom[32y + x], 0 to 255. Make it soft. out[32y + x] is the sum of the 3 by 3 pixels around (x, y), divided by 9 and rounded down. Past an edge, use the nearest edge pixel.\nOne thread per pixel, 16 warps in one block: x = lane, y = warp. There is no divide; for these sums, s / 9 rounded down is (s * 7282) >> 16.\nRead every pixel from global memory once and share it. BAR makes each warp wait until all of them have written. Stay within 32 read transactions.
column2: 豆芽的窗上有一幅灰度图，32 宽 16 高，放在 rom[0..512]：像素 (x, y) 是 rom[32y + x]，值 0 到 255。把它变柔和。out[32y + x] 是 (x, y) 周围 3×3 个像素之和除以 9，向下取整。越过图边的地方，用最近的边缘像素。\n每个线程一个像素，16 个 warp 在同一个块里：x = lane，y = warp。没有除法；对这些和来说，s ÷ 9 向下取整就是 (s * 7282) >> 16。\n每个像素只从全局内存读一次，再共享出去。BAR 让每个 warp 等到所有 warp 都写完。读事务数别超过 32。

column1: Douya's workshop tracks 512 sparks. rom[0..2048] stores them as records of 4 words: x, y, vx, vy, spark i at rom[4i].\nrom[2048..4096] holds the same data field by field: every x, then every y, vx, vy. So x_i is at rom[2048 + i] and vx_i at rom[3072 + i].\nOne thread per spark, 16 warps: out[i] = x_i + vx_i. Which copy you read decides how many lines each read touches. Stay within 64 read transactions.
column2: 豆芽的作坊里有 512 颗火星。rom[0..2048] 把它们存成结构数组，每颗 4 个字：x、y、vx、vy，第 i 颗从 rom[4i] 起。\nrom[2048..4096] 是同一份数据按字段连续存放：先是全部的 x，再是 y、vx、vy。所以 x_i 在 rom[2048 + i]，vx_i 在 rom[3072 + i]。\n每个线程一颗火星，16 个 warp：out[i] = x_i + vx_i。读哪一份，决定了每次读摸到几条行。读事务数别超过 64。

column1: Down and to the right
column2: 向右下

column1: Down the Columns
column2: 按列走

column1: Dry cells store their copy at once. Wet cells: ATOMS r2, [0], 1 gives the slot; STS the index at slot+1 and the value at slot+513. After BAR, threads with tx below the count (LDS [0]) run f and ST to the stored index.
column2: 干格立刻写出拷贝。湿格：ATOMS r2, [0], 1 得到位次；把下标存在 slot+1，数值存在 slot+513。BAR 之后，tx 小于计数（LDS [0]）的线程计算 f，并 ST 到存下的下标。

column1: Each ATOM waits behind the others on its word. Run a one-colour picture and watch the queue in the memory view.
column2: 每个 ATOM 都要排在同一个字上的别人后面。跑一幅单色图，在内存视图里看那条队。

column1: Each MMA consumes 4 steps of K. Twice the K means twice the steps, and every step issues the same number of MMAs per output block.
column2: 每条 MMA 吃掉 K 方向的 4 步。K 翻倍，步数翻倍，每一步里每个输出块发的 MMA 条数不变。

column1: Each RECV waits for a message the other SM has not sent yet, because the other SM is stuck in its own RECV. Nothing is in flight, so nothing can ever arrive.
column2: 每个 RECV 都在等对方还没发的消息，而对方正卡在自己的 RECV 上。链路里什么都没有，也就永远不会有东西到达。

column1: Each SM can finish its own columns for every input by itself. Keep the products in shared memory and take the local max with a butterfly of SHFL.
column2: 每个 SM 自己就能把自己那几列对所有输入算完。乘积留在共享内存里，用 SHFL 蝶形取局部 max。

column1: Each SM holds 128 × 32 of the weights and has multiplied its own columns. The max over all columns is still missing. What has to cross the ring?
column2: 每个 SM 存着 128 × 32 的权重，也算完了自己的列。跨全部列的 max 还没有。环上要传什么？

column1: Each SM holds 16 rows of 64 columns and only has to send its top and bottom row. What part of its block does an inner SM send each step?
column2: 每个 SM 有 16 行 64 列，只需发出上、下各一行。内部的 SM 每步传出的字数是整块的多少？

column1: Each SM keeps its best key (score << 7 | 127 - v), then the same ring all-gather you used for the fragments brings all four keys to everyone. Take the maximum; the token is 127 - (key & 127).
column2: 每个 SM 留下自己的最佳键（score << 7 | 127 - v），再用和片段相同的环形 all-gather 把四个键送到每个 SM。取最大值，字 = 127 - (key & 127)。

column1: Each clear throws away everything accumulated so far. After the last clear only the last step is added.
column2: 每次清零都扔掉之前累加的全部。最后一次清零之后，只加了最后一步。

column1: Each element of A is used for exactly one multiply-add and then never again. The kernel spends its time waiting for A to arrive from global memory, so a faster multiplier waits just as long.
column2: A 的每个元素只做一次乘加，之后再也用不到。内核的时间花在等 A 从全局内存送来上，乘法器再快，等的时间一样长。

column1: Each factor carries a factor of 256, so the product carries 256 × 256 = 65536. Shift right by 8 to get back to Q8.
column2: 每个因子都带着一个 256，乘积就带着 256 × 256 = 65536。右移 8 位才回到 Q8。

column1: Each half-warp is its own 4 x 4 tile: give half-warp h the pictures 8i + 4h .. 8i + 4h + 3 and the same weight tile. The result D has the layout the next layer wants as its A tile.
column2: 每个半 warp 是独立的 4 × 4 块：半 warp h 负责第 8i + 4h .. 8i + 4h + 3 张图，两边用同一块权重。结果 D 的排布，正好是下一层要的 A 块。

column1: Each lane holds a partial sum. Fold the 32 sums with five SHFL steps (XOR the lane with 16, 8, 4, 2, 1) and let lane 0 write y[row]. Rows past M must write nothing, and so must lanes past N.
column2: 每个车道各持一个部分和。用五步 SHFL（车道号依次与 16、8、4、2、1 异或）把 32 个和折叠起来，由车道 0 写 y[行]。超过 M 的行什么都不写，超过 N 的车道也不参与。

column1: Each lane keeps a private partial sum over its entries; a loop of 8 rounds covers rows up to 256 entries, with an IF that skips k beyond the row's end. At the end a SHFL butterfly adds the 32 partial sums.
column2: 每条车道对自己负责的条目保存一个私有部分和；循环 8 轮可覆盖最长 256 项的行，用 IF 跳过超出行尾的 k。最后用 SHFL 蝶形把 32 个部分和加起来。

column1: Each line is used once per round, and by the time the next round comes round to it, 32 other lines have pushed it out. The cache throws away exactly what is needed next, so nearly every read misses.
column2: 每一行每轮只用一次，等下一轮回来时，已经有 32 个别的行把它挤走了。缓存总是把下一步马上要用的丢掉，所以几乎每次读都缺失。

column1: Each load makes the 32 lanes fetch 32 different cache lines, and every line is a 400-cycle miss queued behind the others. The arithmetic takes a few cycles; almost everything else is waiting.
column2: 每次读取，32 个车道要取 32 条不同的缓存行，每条都是 400 周期的未命中，还要排在别人后面。算术只要几个周期，剩下几乎全是在等。

column1: Each of the 16 outputs is a sum of 4 products: 16 · 4 = 64 multiply-adds, in a single instruction.
column2: 16 个输出里每个都是 4 个乘积之和：16 · 4 = 64 次乘加，一条指令完成。

column1: Each pass stores a value only for the next pass to load it back. A register can carry it instead.
column2: 每一趟存下一个值，只是为了让下一趟再读回来。寄存器完全可以代劳。

column1: Each record is 4 words, so x repeats every 4. A warp reading x spans 128 words, which is 4 lines, and uses one word in four of each.
column2: 每条记录 4 个字，x 每隔 4 个字出现一次。一个 warp 读 x 要跨 128 个字，也就是 4 条行，每条行里只用了四分之一。

column1: Each record's age, dose and flag are words 0, 1 and 3 of the same 8-word record. If you read the age first and then the dose and flag of the same record, which of those reads pay the 400-cycle wait?
column2: 每条病历的年龄、剂量、标志是同一条 8 字记录里的第 0、1、3 个字。先读年龄，再读同一条的剂量和标志，这几次读里哪些要付 400 周期？

column1: Each step, a thread needs its own cell and its four neighbours. If every thread reads them straight from the map, that is 5 global reads per cell. With a 16 × 16 tile plus a one-cell rim in shared memory, how many global reads per cell?
column2: 每一步，线程需要自己的格子和四个邻居。如果每个线程都直接从图里读，就是每格 5 次全局读取。换成共享内存里 16 × 16 的块外加一圈边，每格要读几次全局内存？

column1: Each step: SEND your first row up and your last row down, then RECV into the ghost rows, then compute. SM 0 and SM 3 skip the missing side with IF, because a RECV from nobody waits forever. Use two buffers and swap them.
column2: 每一步：先把本条第一行 SEND 给上邻、最后一行 SEND 给下邻，再 RECV 进幽灵行，然后计算。SM 0 和 SM 3 用 IF 跳过不存在的一侧，因为向无人 RECV 会永远等。用两块缓冲交替。

column1: Each thread has 64 private words of local memory. STL parks a value there and LDL brings it back after 80 cycles, with no cache in between. It works, but every trip is a wait the other warps must cover.
column2: 每个线程有 64 个私有的本地内存字。STL 把值放进去，LDL 过 80 拍把它取回，中间没有缓存。能用，但每一趟都是要别的 warp 去盖的等待。

column1: Each thread loads its own pixel once, STS-es it to shared memory at the same index, and waits at BAR. After BAR the neighbours are one LDS away.
column2: 每个线程只读自己的像素一次，用 STS 放进共享内存的同一个下标，然后在 BAR 处等。BAR 之后，邻居只隔一次 LDS。

column1: Each thread must know where it sits in the whole array, not just in its block. Which two specials give that?
column2: 每个线程要知道自己在整个数组里的位置，而不只是在块里的位置。哪两个特殊寄存器能给出它？

column1: Each thread starts at its own global index and steps forward by the total number of threads, gdx · bdx, until it runs past n.
column2: 每个线程从自己的全局下标出发，每次前进线程总数 gdx · bdx，直到越过 n。

column1: Each tile is 32 x 32. How many words does one SM send over the ring per step, if it only ships what its neighbours need?
column2: 每块屏是 32 x 32。只寄邻居用得到的东西，一个 SM 每步经过环发出多少个字？

column1: Early 3D consoles and DSPs had no floating-point unit and did all their maths this way. Fixed point is still common in audio and embedded chips.
column2: 早期的 3D 游戏机和 DSP 没有浮点单元，所有运算都这样做。定点数在音频和嵌入式芯片里至今常见。

column1: Edge Rule
column2: 边界模式

column1: Edge rules
column2: 边界规则

column1: Edges are part of the algorithm
column2: 边缘也是算法的一部分

column1: Eight Bits
column2: 八位整数

column1: Eight banks of 32 readings, each 0 to 99, at rom[0..32], rom[32..64], and so on up to rom[224..256]. out[lane] is the sum of the eight readings of that lane.\nThe starter loops eight times. Each round loads one reading and then waits three beats for it, so the NOPs add up. The frame budget is ≤ 30 cycles.\nLOOP's count is a plain number, so unrolling needs no new kind of instruction: just write the rounds out.
column2: 八组读数，每组 32 个，取值 0 到 99，依次在 rom[0..32]、rom[32..64]，一直到 rom[224..256]。out[lane] 是这条车道八个读数之和。\nstarter 用循环转八圈。每圈读一个数，然后等它三拍，NOP 就这样一圈圈累积起来。一帧的预算是 ≤ 30 个周期。\nLOOP 的圈数是个普通的数，所以展开不需要新的指令种类：把每一圈直接写出来就行。

column1: Eight lines are far fewer than the 16 the L1 holds, yet the program re-fetches them every pass. What could make lines collide when there is plenty of room?
column2: 八行远少于 L1 能装的 16 行，程序却每一遍都重新取它们。空间明明很富余，是什么让这些行互相冲突？

column1: Eight warps each issue one LD to a different line (a 400-cycle miss) and then one ADD that uses the result. About how many cycles until all eight are done?
column2: 八个 warp 各发一条读不同行的 LD（未命中要 400 拍），再各做一条用到结果的 ADD。大约多少拍后八个都做完？

column1: Either, depending on who got there first
column2: 两种都可能，看谁先到

column1: Even Out
column2: 均衡

column1: Every CUDA kernel starts with `i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if (i < n)`. Forgetting the check corrupts whatever memory lies after the array.
column2: 每个 CUDA 内核都以 `i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if (i < n)` 开头。漏掉检查，数组后面的内存就被写坏了。

column1: Every GPU sum, dot product and histogram is built this way: warp shuffles, shared memory, one atomic per block.
column2: GPU 上的求和、点积和直方图都是这样搭起来的：warp 内洗牌、共享内存、每块一次原子操作。

column1: Every SM's 32 outputs per input
column2: 每个 SM 对每个输入的 32 个输出

column1: Every active cell still gets exactly one slot, so the set is the same. But blocks and warps start in a different order under each seed, so who takes slot 0, 1, 2 ... changes.
column2: 每个活跃格仍然恰好领到一个位次，所以集合不变。但在不同的种子下，块和 warp 的起跑顺序不同，谁拿到 0、1、2 号位次也就变了。

column1: Every eighth row has the same parity, so every picked pixel is on a black stripe or every one is on a white stripe. The real picture averages to grey; averaging before shrinking is what gets that right.
column2: 每隔 8 行的奇偶性相同，所以挑中的像素要么全在黑条上，要么全在白条上。这幅画真实的平均是灰色；先平均再缩小才能得到它。

column1: Every fast GEMM is tiled: global memory feeds shared memory tile by tile, and the arithmetic reads the tile from there. The tile size trades reuse against shared memory and occupancy.
column2: 每个快的 GEMM 都分块：全局内存一块一块喂给共享内存，运算从那里读。块的大小是在复用、共享内存和占用率之间做取舍。

column1: Every message pays 6 cycles on the link before any word moves. 512 single-word messages cost 512 x 7 = 3584 cycles; 8 full messages cost 8 x (6 + 16) = 176. The 40-cycle delay is paid once, in both cases.
column2: 每条消息在字开始走之前先占链路 6 拍。512 条单字消息要 512 x 7 = 3584 拍；8 条满载消息只要 8 x (6 + 16) = 176 拍。40 拍的延迟两种做法都只付一次。

column1: Every multiply and add is still done. What disappears are two full trips to memory, 400 cycles each; the arithmetic hides inside the one wait that is left.
column2: 每个乘法和加法都还在做。消失的是两趟完整的内存往返，每趟 400 周期；运算藏进了剩下的那一次等待里。

column1: Every pixel reads its four texels from global memory
column2: 每个像素从全局内存读自己的四个纹素

column1: Every resident warp holds its registers for its whole life. The fewer a thread uses, the more warps fit on an SM, and the more waiting one warp can hide behind another.
column2: 每个驻留的 warp 在整个生命周期里都占着自己的寄存器。线程用得越少，SM 上装得下的 warp 越多，一个 warp 的等待就越有别的 warp 来遮住。

column1: Every softmax in a deep-learning library does this, and attention kernels carry a running maximum for the same reason.
column2: 深度学习库里的每个 softmax 都这么做，注意力内核带着一个滚动的最大值，也是这个原因。

column1: Every token scores against every token: 16 × 16 = 256. The causal mask hides the upper triangle, so only 136 are needed.
column2: 每个字对每个字都要打分：16 × 16 = 256。因果掩码盖住上三角，真正要用的只有 136 项。

column1: Every unit has its own latency, so every result needs its own gap. Schedule against the slowest link of the chain, not the average.
column2: 每个单元有各自的延迟，每个结果就需要各自的空档。要按链上最慢的一环来排，而不是按平均值。

column1: Every value a GPU interpolates across a triangle is a barycentric blend, and the weights come straight from the edge functions the rasteriser already evaluates. Gouraud shading in 1971 was the first use.
column2: GPU 在三角形上插值的每一个量都是重心混合，权重直接来自光栅器本来就在算的边函数。1971 年的 Gouraud 着色是最早的应用。

column1: Everyone sends a quarter, every step, in the same direction: no link ever sits idle, no link carries a word twice.
column2: 每个人每一步都沿同一方向发四分之一：没有链路闲着，也没有哪个字被同一条链路传两遍。

column1: Exactly one
column2: 恰好一格

column1: FADD d, a, b — FP32 add.
column2: FADD d, a, b —— FP32 加法。
