column1: Only the last
column2: 只有最后一次

column1: Only the last one
column2: 只有最后一步

column1: Only the max needs the other panels, and a max of maxima is the max. One word per input per SM is enough; weights and outputs stay where they are.
column2: 只有 max 需要别的份，而「各份 max 的 max」就是总 max。每个 SM 每个输入一个字就够了；权重和输出都留在原处。

column1: Only the rim grows. Keep the rim as a queue in shared memory: each step, one thread per rim cell tries to claim its neighbours with ATOMS, and a winner appends the new cell with a tail counter. One block is enough, and the other warps can simply leave early. Two BARs per step: one after everybody has read the tail, one after the appends.
column2: 只有水边会扩张。把水边存成共享内存里的队列：每一步，每个水边格用一个线程，试着用 ATOMS 抢占它的邻格，抢到的线程用队尾计数器把新格追加进去。一个块就够了，其余的 warp 可以直接提前退出。每一步两个 BAR：全员读完队尾后一个，追加完之后一个。

column1: Only two of the four sides touch another tile; the other two are the edge of the wall. Each shared side is 32 words, so 64 per step.
column2: 四条边里只有两条挨着别的屏，另两条是大屏墙的外沿。每条共享边 32 个字，一步 64 个。

column1: Open the Warp River of the starter. Each load of A touches many lines, because lane l reads row l and the rows are N words apart. Count the transactions per load.
column2: 打开起始方案的 Warp River。每次读 A 都碰到很多条线，因为车道 l 读第 l 行，行与行相隔 N 个字。数一数每次读取的事务数。

column1: Open the memory view after a run. Most of the time is spent waiting on LDO, not computing.
column2: 运行后打开内存视图。时间大多花在等 LDO 上，而不是计算。

column1: Open the memory view at the first LD. Which words do lanes 0, 1 and 2 read, and which line is each one in?
column2: 在第一条 LD 处打开内存视图。车道 0、1、2 各读哪个字？各在哪一条行里？

column1: Open the memory view. Lines are filled, thrown out after one word, and filled again. That waste is the clue.
column2: 打开内存视图。整行被取进来，只用了一个字就被挤出去，然后又被取回来。这种浪费就是线索。

column1: Open the result card: it says the run stopped with every SM waiting on RECV. Look at the last instruction each SM ran.
column2: 打开结果卡：它说整个运行停在了所有 SM 都在等 RECV。看每个 SM 执行的最后一条指令。

column1: Open the result card: link 1 to 0 is busy the whole run while 3 to 0 is idle for a long stretch.
column2: 打开结果卡：1 到 0 的链路整个运行都忙，3 到 0 有很长一段空着。

column2: 顺序来自算术

column2: 溢出到本地

column1: Overflow
column2: 溢出

column2: 中间结果溢出

column1: PAN THE VIEWER
column2: 平移观片窗

column1: PEER SM
column2: 对端 SM

column1: PICK A BATCH
column2: 挑一批

column1: PICK A DAY
column2: 挑一天

column1: PICK A PREFIX LENGTH
column2: 挑一个前缀长度

column2: 挑一袋邮件

column2: 占满

column1: Packed path: LDS the word, SHL by 24 - 8c, SHR by 24, CVT.H.I, MMA; multiply the FP32 sum by the channel scale after the K loop, then ReLU. Argmax: FMAX butterfly, then the lowest class equal to the maximum.
column2: 打包路径：LDS 取字，SHL 24 - 8c，SHR 24，CVT.H.I，MMA；K 循环结束后把 FP32 和乘该通道的缩放，再做 ReLU。argmax：FMAX 蝶形，再取等于最大值的最小类号。

column1: Parallel codes compare the surface to volume ratio of the blocks they cut a domain into, and pick the shape that keeps it small.
column2: 并行程序会比较切出来的块的表面积与体积之比，挑出让它最小的形状。

column1: Parallel reductions on GPUs use tree sums partly for speed and partly because they lose less than a running total. Kahan summation attacks the same loss.
column2: GPU 上的并行归约用树形求和，一半为了速度，一半因为它比滚动累加丢得少。Kahan 求和对付的是同一种损失。

column1: Parallel time is the slowest worker's time. Cut the biggest job into pieces until no piece is the biggest.
column2: 并行的时间就是最慢那位工人的时间。把最大的活儿切成小块，直到没有哪一块特别大。

column1: Particle culling, ray sorting and sparse solvers all begin with a compaction: scan the flags, scatter the survivors, process the dense list.
column2: 粒子剔除、光线分组、稀疏求解器都从压缩开始：扫描标志、散布幸存者、再处理紧凑的列表。

column1: Pass the T local maxima round the ring in three steps: send what you hold, receive from the left, fold it into your running max, and forward it.
column2: 把 T 个局部 max 沿环传三步：发出手里的，从左边收一份，并进自己的 max，再原样转发。

column1: Pay the delay once
column2: 延迟只付一次

column1: Per lane: three loads (offset 0, 16, 32 inside the problem's 48 words), CVT.H.I for A and B, CVT.F.I for C, MMA, CVT.I.F, ST [lane].
column2: 每个车道：三次读取（在该问题 48 个字里偏移 0、16、32），A 和 B 用 CVT.H.I，C 用 CVT.F.I，然后 MMA、CVT.I.F、ST [lane]。

column1: Per step along K the thread reads 4 values of A and 4 of B, 8 reads, and does 4x4 = 16 multiply-adds with them. That is 0.5 reads per multiply-add instead of 2.
column2: 沿 K 方向每走一步，线程读 4 个 A 值和 4 个 B 值，共 8 次读取，用它们做 4x4 = 16 次乘加。每次乘加平均 0.5 次读取，而不是 2 次。

column1: Per step: embed, q·k·v, store the new K and V row, score against rows 0..t, softmax, mix V, apply Wo, take the argmax with a butterfly MAX over (logit, id).
column2: 每一步：取嵌入，算 q、k、v，存新的 K、V 行，对 0..t 行打分，softmax，混合 V，乘 Wo，用蝶形 MAX 在 (logit, 编号) 上取 argmax。

column1: Per warp: four loads (two rows, two lines each), add the pairs, then fold the 32 lane sums. SHFL d, v, partner with partner = lane XOR k for k = 16, 8, 4, 2, 1 leaves the full sum in every lane.
column2: 每个 warp：四次读（两行，每行两条线），成对相加，再折叠 32 个车道的和。SHFL d, v, partner，其中 partner = lane XOR k，k 取 16、8、4、2、1，做完每条车道都持有完整的和。

column1: Perspective-Correct
column2: 透视校正

column1: Perspective-correct interpolation
column2: 透视校正插值

column1: Phase: SUB frame, AND 15, ADD 2. Fade: SHR 1, ADD 18. Issue both LDs back to back, then MUL, then one SHR by 13 (8 for the Q8 product, 5 for the colour), then PIX.
column2: 相位：减 frame，AND 15，加 2。衰减：SHR 1，加 18。两个 LD 紧挨着发，然后 MUL，再一次 SHR 13（8 位给 Q8 乘积，5 位给颜色），最后 PIX。

column1: Piles 0 and 1 come first and fill count0 + count1 cells, so pile 2 starts right after them. Each start is the sum of the counts before it, an exclusive scan of the four counts.
column2: 第 0、1 两堆排在前面，占 count0 + count1 个位置，第 2 堆紧跟其后。每一堆的起点就是它前面各堆个数之和，也就是四个个数的一次独占扫描。

column1: Pipeline parallelism
column2: 流水线并行

column1: Pixel centres
column2: 像素中心

column1: Pixel x covers x to x+1, and its centre is x + ½. In texels: s = (2x+1)·T/64 − ½. The starter has s = x·T/32.
column2: 像素 x 覆盖 x 到 x+1，中心在 x + ½。换成纹素：s = (2x+1)·T/64 − ½。初始方案里是 s = x·T/32。

column1: Plain weights e_i / (e0 + e1 + e2) assume the corners are equally deep. On a slope the pixel owns e_i / w_i of the corner i, so use those as the weights and divide by their sum.
column2: 普通权重 e_i / (e0 + e1 + e2) 假定三个角一样深。在斜面上，角 i 在像素里占的是 e_i / w_i，用它们当权重，再除以它们的和。

column1: Power-of-two strides in matrix code are a famous slowdown. The usual cures are padding rows by one line or reordering loops so a row is finished in one visit.
column2: 矩阵代码里 2 的幂次步长是出了名的变慢原因。常见的解法是每行多垫一个缓存行，或者调整循环顺序，让一行一次用完。

column1: Prefill and decode
column2: 预填与解码

column1: Prism does one 16.16 reciprocal per vertex and one per pixel with rounding; real hardware keeps floating-point attributes and a dedicated interpolator.
column2: Prism 对每个顶点和每个像素各做一次 16.16 倒数并有舍入误差；真实硬件使用浮点属性和专用的插值器。

column1: Prism only marks a whole vertex as not drawn. Real clipping keeps the part of the triangle in front of the eye.
column2: Prism 只是把整个顶点标成不画。真实的裁剪会保留三角形在眼睛前方的那一部分。

column1: Production GEMM libraries pad, predicate or pick a different kernel for the edge tiles. Reading past a buffer is undefined in real hardware: it may return garbage, fault, or silently work.
column2: 生产级的 GEMM 库会对边缘块补齐、加谓词，或换一个内核。真实硬件上读越界是未定义行为：可能读到垃圾、可能出错，也可能碰巧没事。

column1: Profilers such as Nsight Compute show whether a kernel is limited by memory, compute or latency. Optimising anything but the real limit gains almost nothing.
column2: Nsight Compute 之类的剖析器会告诉你内核受限于内存、计算还是延迟。优化真正瓶颈之外的东西几乎没有收益。

column1: Program memory is full. This machine holds at most
column2: 程序存储已满。这台机器最多容纳指令条数：

column1: Programmers microbenchmark real GPUs for exactly this: cache sizes, bank widths and latencies are often undocumented or change between generations.
column2: 程序员真的会对 GPU 做微基准测试，量的正是这些：缓存大小、bank 宽度、延迟，文档里常常没有，换一代还会变。

column1: Public cases pass, hidden ones fail. What do the public matrices have in common? A symmetric matrix equals its transpose.
column2: 公开用例过了，隐藏用例不过。公开的矩阵有什么共同点？对称阵等于它的转置。

column1: Put BAR between computing a block and sending it: it waits for the earlier SENDs to finish, which also means the buffer you computed into two blocks ago is free again. SM 1 must cut the stream into the same messages.
column2: 把 BAR 放在算完一块和发这一块之间：它会等先前的 SEND 发完，也就保证两块之前用过的缓冲已经空了。SM 1 要按同样的方式把数据流切成消息。

column1: Put SEND before RECV on every SM: SEND returns at once, so nobody waits for the other. Alternatively even SMs send first and odd SMs receive first.
column2: 每个 SM 都把 SEND 放在 RECV 前面：SEND 立刻返回，谁也不用等对方。或者让偶数号 SM 先发、奇数号先收。

column1: Putting it together
column2: 全部合在一起

column1: Q8 × Q8 = Q16. One right shift by 8 turns it back into Q8.
column2: Q8 × Q8 = Q16。右移 8 位就变回 Q8。

column1: Quantize on the way in, accumulate in a wide integer, rescale once on the way out.
column2: 进来时量化，用宽整数累加，出去时缩放一次。

column1: Quantize with 127 / max (HRCP, then HMUL by 127). Undo it on the INT32 sum with max / 127 before the rom[16] scale. A scale made wide to be safe turns ±0.05 data into zeros.
column2: 用 127 / max 量化（HRCP，再 HMUL 乘 127）。在乘 rom[16] 之前，用 max / 127 还原 INT32 和。为安全而写得很宽的缩放，会把 ±0.05 的数据变成零。

column1: RAISE THE WATER
column2: 抬高水位

column1: RCP d, a — d = 65536 / a, a Q16 reciprocal. A value of 0 gives a huge number.
column2: RCP d, a —— d = 65536 / a，Q16 倒数。输入 0 会得到一个极大的数。

column1: RCP gives 65536 / w, so shift it left by 4 before use: that keeps the denominator large enough to survive the final reciprocal. The numerator and the denominator LERPs both need three consecutive registers on each side; start the loads and reciprocals first, because they take longest.
column2: RCP 给出 65536 / w，用之前先左移 4 位：这样分母足够大，经得起最后一次倒数。分子和分母的 LERP 两边都要三个连续寄存器；先发出 LD 和 RCP，因为它们最慢。

column1: RCP gives r = 65536 / den, a little too small. q = (num · r) >> 16 undershoots; add the same estimate of what is left: rem = num − q · den, then q += (rem · r) >> 16. With den = 0 the numerator is 0, so the answer comes out 0.
column2: RCP 给出 r = 65536 / den，略微偏小。q = (num · r) >> 16 会偏低；再对剩下的部分做同样的估计：rem = num − q · den，然后 q += (rem · r) >> 16。den = 0 时分子为 0，所以结果自然是 0。

column1: RECV peer, buf, n — wait for the next message from that SM and store it at buf.
column2: RECV peer, buf, n —— 等那个 SM 的下一条消息,存进 buf。

column1: Radix Pass
column2: 基数一趟

column1: Ragged Edges
column2: 毛边

column1: Read from A and write to B, GSYNC, then swap the roles. Keep one base register and flip it with XOR 4096 each step; the other buffer is base XOR 4096. Stay within 8 registers. An even number of steps ends in A.
column2: 从 A 读、往 B 写，GSYNC，然后对调角色。用一个基址寄存器，每步用 XOR 4096 翻转；另一块缓冲就是基址 XOR 4096。寄存器不要超过 8 个。步数是偶数，所以最后落在 A。

column1: Read side by side, count in a fast place, merge once. Which pieces to use depends on the data, and the data decides how long the queues are.
column2: 并肩去读，在快的地方数，最后合并一次。用哪几块要看数据，队有多长也是数据说了算。

column1: Read the Regs number on the result card, then divide 256 by it. That is how many warps an SM keeps; 32 is the ceiling.
column2: 看结果卡上的 Regs，再用 256 去除。得数就是 SM 能留住的 warp 数，32 是上限。

column1: Read the busy bar of link 0 to 1 on the result card: it is full of tiny messages. Each one pays the same fixed cost on the link.
column2: 看结果卡上 0 到 1 的链路忙闲条：全是细小的消息，每条都要付同样的固定开销。

column1: Read the grid transposed when H < W: treat column j as a row (padded address 32 + i * 1 + j * (W + 2) instead of 32 + i * (W + 2) + j). The stencil does not care about the direction, only the load and the final store do.
column2: H < W 时把网格转置着读：把第 j 列当成一行（补边后的地址是 32 + i + j * (W + 2)，而不是 32 + i * (W + 2) + j）。模板不在乎方向，只有读入和最后写出要换。

column1: Read the picture from global memory once into shared memory (that is all the global reads you need). The row pass can write back in place if each warp owns its row and parks the result in a small buffer first; a BAR then separates the passes.
column2: 把图从全局内存只读一遍，放进共享内存（全局读取只需要这么多）。如果每个 warp 管一行、先把结果放进一个小缓冲区，横向这一遍可以就地写回；两遍之间用 BAR 隔开。

column1: Reading all four neighbours from the map costs 5 global reads per cell. Load the 16 × 16 patch and a one-cell rim into an 18 × 18 tile in shared memory, BAR, then read the neighbours from the tile. Issue all the global loads before the first STS so their waits overlap, and check the Analyzer: how much of the time is spent waiting on memory?
column2: 直接从图里读四个邻居，每格要 5 次全局读取。把 16 × 16 的块和一圈边载入共享内存的 18 × 18 小块，BAR，再从小块里读邻居。先把全局读取全部发出去再做第一个 STS，等待就能重叠；也看看分析器：多少时间花在等内存上？

column1: Reading the prompt fills the cache; only then does each new word cost one step.
column2: 读提示是在填缓存；之后每个新字才只花一步。

column1: Reads hit in L1 already. What is left is nine first-touch waits, taken one per round: the next line is only requested when the round needs it.
column2: 读取本身已经命中 L1。剩下的是九次第一次接触的等待，一轮一个：下一行要到那一轮用到时才被请求。

column1: Reads of different lanes cancel each other
column2: 不同车道的读取互相抵消

column1: Reads that missed L1 and went to memory, worst test case.
column2: 未命中 L1、要去全局内存取数的读取次数，取最差测试用例。

column1: Real GPU cache lines are 128 bytes and CPUs use 64. Software prefetch instructions exist for exactly this reason.
column2: 真实 GPU 的缓存行是 128 字节，CPU 常见 64 字节。软件预取指令就是为这件事设计的。

column1: Real GPUs favour block sizes that are multiples of the warp size, usually 128 to 256, so that the resident-block limit, register and shared memory use, and the number of blocks per SM all stay balanced. Occupancy calculators exist because the answer depends on the kernel.
column2: 真实的 GPU 偏爱 warp 大小的整数倍，通常是 128 到 256，让常驻块数上限、寄存器和共享内存用量、每个 SM 上的块数都保持平衡。之所以有占用率计算器，是因为答案取决于内核。

column1: Real GPUs have no seed knob; the order shifts with clocks, load and driver. Here the knob makes it repeatable.
column2: 真实 GPU 没有种子旋钮；顺序随时钟、负载和驱动而变。这里的旋钮让它可以重现。

column1: Real GPUs let you choose which winding is front and whether to cull front, back or neither; Prism fixes positive area as front and always culls the back.
column2: 真实 GPU 可以选择哪种绕向算正面，以及剔除正面、背面还是都不剔；Prism 固定有向面积为正的是正面，总是剔除背面。

column1: Real GPUs spill to local memory that lives in the global memory system (cached in L1 and L2). Compilers report spill counts, and shaving live values is a standard way to recover performance.
column2: 真实的 GPU 会把值溢出到本地内存，它实际位于全局内存系统里（经过 L1 与 L2 缓存）。编译器会报告溢出数，减少活跃值是找回性能的标准手段。

column1: Real atomics on one address are pipelined by the L2 cache and are faster than this machine's 2 cycles; the queue is still real.
column2: 真实硬件里，同一地址的原子操作由 L2 缓存流水处理，比这台机器的 2 个周期快；但排队依然存在。

column1: Real caches have conflict and capacity misses mixed together, and the compiler picks tile sizes; here the arithmetic is 8 rows plus one line.
column2: 真实缓存里冲突缺失和容量缺失混在一起，分块大小由编译器去选；这里只要算：8 行加一行。

column1: Real caches have more sets, more ways and a prefetcher that may rescue a stride; Vault's L1 has none of that.
column2: 真实的缓存有更多的组和路，还有硬件预取器可能救回规则的步长；Vault 的 L1 都没有。

column1: Real chips have float hardware. Q8 is the same idea made visible: you decide where the point sits.
column2: 真实的芯片有浮点硬件。Q8 是同一个想法的显形：小数点放在哪里，由你决定。

column1: Real chips offer widening multiplies and saturating arithmetic. Prism's MUL keeps only the low 32 bits, silently.
column2: 真实的芯片有加宽乘法和饱和运算。Prism 的 MUL 只留低 32 位，而且悄无声息。

column1: Real chips overlap memory and arithmetic across thousands of threads; Vault has 16 warps and one wait you can see.
column2: 真实芯片靠成千上万个线程让访存和运算重叠；Vault 只有 16 个 warp，和一次看得见的等待。

column1: Real chips overlap the exchange with the next matrix product; here it waits until the products are done.
column2: 真实的芯片会让这次交换和下一个矩阵乘重叠；这里等乘法全做完才交换。

column1: Real engines also run a frontier across blocks. Here the rim always fits one block of 128 threads, so a single block does it.
column2: 真实的引擎也会让前沿跨块运行。这里水边总是能放进一个 128 线程的块，所以一个块就够了。

column1: Real hardware also blends between two levels (trilinear) and uses the pixel footprint to choose one; here the level is fixed.
column2: 真实硬件还会在两层之间混合（三线性），并根据像素覆盖范围选层；这里层数是固定的。

column1: Real hardware does the blend in floating point, once per attribute; Prism uses weights in 16.16 fixed point and a single shared reciprocal.
column2: 真实硬件用浮点数、对每个属性各做一次混合；Prism 用 16.16 定点权重和一个共用的倒数。

column1: Real histogram and scatter kernels combine all of this: coalesced loads, per-block counters in shared memory, a final merge to global memory.
column2: 真实的直方图和散射内核把这些全用上：合并的读、每个块在共享内存里的计数、最后合并到全局内存。

column1: Real kernels also overlap loads with compute and tile at several levels. This level keeps one tile level and uses DMA for the staging.
column2: 真实内核还会让搬运与计算重叠，并在多个层级上分块。这一关只保留一层分块，搬运交给 DMA。

column1: Real kernels also sort, scale or compensate; here only the order changes.
column2: 真实的内核还会排序、缩放或做补偿；这里只改变顺序。

column1: Real kernels also tune tile shapes per GPU and double-buffer the tiles; here one fixed 16x16 tile is enough.
column2: 真实内核还会按 GPU 调整块的形状，并对块做双缓冲；这里一个固定的 16x16 块就够了。

column1: Real kernels are tuned the same way: check register use against occupancy (the compiler's -maxrregcount or launch bounds), overlap copies with compute, and put a fence between data and flag. Which of them pays depends on whether the kernel is bound by issue, by memory latency or by waiting.
column2: 真实的内核也是这样调的：对照占用率检查寄存器用量（编译器的 -maxrregcount 或 launch bounds），让搬运与计算重叠，在数据与标志之间加栅栏。哪一项划算，取决于内核卡在发射、内存延迟还是等待上。

column1: Real kernels pick the strategy per matrix from its row-length statistics.
column2: 真实的核会根据矩阵的行长统计，为每个矩阵挑选策略。

column1: Real kernels split the ledger over many warps and combine with atomics or shared memory; Vault has no tool for that yet in this chapter.
column2: 真实的内核会把台账分给很多个 warp，再用原子操作或共享内存合并；这一章里 Vault 还没有这样的工具。

column1: Real latencies also move with caches and contention. Prism keeps them fixed so you can plan to the beat.
column2: 真实延迟还会随缓存和争用而变化。Prism 把它们固定下来，让你能精确到拍去规划。

column1: Real links retry per packet in hardware; here the kernel checks the whole result and repeats the transfer.
column2: 真实的链路在硬件里按包重发；这里由内核核对整个结果再重做整次传输。

column1: Real out-of-range reads rarely return a neat constant. Here the guard zone is a fixed 77 so the damage is easy to follow.
column2: 真实的越界读很少恰好读到整齐的常数。这里的守卫区固定是 77，便于追踪破坏是怎么来的。

column1: Real pipelines also run the backward pass and balance stage times; here the four stages cost the same.
column2: 真实的流水线还要跑反向传播并平衡各级耗时；这里四级的耗时相同。

column1: Real pipelines differ the same way: an integer add takes a few cycles, a multiply a few more, a memory load far more. Compilers keep a latency table per instruction class.
column2: 真实的流水线也是这样：整数加法几个周期，乘法多几个，访存多得多。编译器为每类指令都维护一张延迟表。

column1: Real rings split into many small chunks and overlap steps; here each chunk is one message.
column2: 真实的环会切成许多小块并让各步重叠；这里一块就是一条消息。

column1: Real schedulers weigh registers and shared memory when admitting warps; Vault simply lets you pick up to 16.
column2: 真实的调度器要按寄存器和共享内存的用量决定能放几个 warp；Vault 只让你在 1 到 16 里选。

column1: Real sorts keep per-block histograms and merge them across blocks; one block keeps the idea visible.
column2: 真实的排序会为每个块保存直方图再跨块合并；这里用一个块，让思路一目了然。

column1: Real stencils tile into shared memory or registers; Vault lets one wide load stand in for prefetching.
column2: 真实的模板计算会分块放进共享内存或寄存器；Vault 里用一条宽读取代替预取。

column1: Real tensor cores work on fragments with documented layouts (for example 16x8x16 tiles on recent GPUs). Loading a fragment in the wrong order is a classic bug that symmetric test data hides.
column2: 真实的张量核处理有明确布局的片段（例如新款 GPU 上的 16x8x16 块）。片段装载顺序错是个经典 bug，对称的测试数据会把它藏起来。

column1: Real units take normalised coordinates 0..1 and handle wrap and clamp modes in hardware. Here the scaling is yours.
column2: 真实的纹理单元接收 0..1 的归一化坐标，并在硬件里处理回绕和钳位。这里缩放要你自己做。

column1: Reduce in tiers
column2: 分层归约

column1: Register Tiles
column2: 寄存器分块

column1: Registers are the fastest memory
column2: 寄存器是最快的内存

column1: Registers decide who can stay
column2: 寄存器决定谁能留下

column1: Registers the kernel touches: the highest register used, plus one.
column2: 内核用到的寄存器数：用到的最大编号加一。

column1: Replace the two ANDs of each axis: the left index with MAX against 0, the right index (x0 + 1) with MIN against T−1. The weights stay as they are.
column2: 把每个轴上的两个 AND 换掉：左下标用 MAX 对 0，右下标（x0 + 1）用 MIN 对 T−1。权重不用动。

column1: Request all nine lines before the loop starts. One LD with a different address in every lane can start many lines at once, into a single register.
column2: 在循环开始之前，把九行都请求出来。一条 LD，让每条车道的地址不同，就能同时启动许多行，只占一个寄存器。

column1: Resetting an accumulator inside a K loop is one of the commonest silent bugs in hand-written GEMM. The result has the right shape and plausible values, only smaller, so it slips past quick checks.
column2: 在 K 循环里重置累加器，是手写 GEMM 里最常见的静默 bug 之一。结果形状对、数值看着合理，只是偏小，快速检查很容易漏过。

column1: Ring all-reduce
column2: 环形 all-reduce

column1: Roofline models plot exactly this: operations per byte against a chip's compute and bandwidth ceilings. Kernel fusion in GPU compilers exists to raise that ratio.
column2: Roofline 模型画的就是这个：每字节的运算次数，对着芯片的算力与带宽上限。GPU 编译器做内核融合，就是为了抬高这个比值。

column1: Row i only needs keys 0..i. Guard the loops with j ≤ i instead of computing a score and masking it.
column2: 第 i 行只需要第 0..i 个键。用 j ≤ i 把循环拦住，别算完分数再去掩。

column1: Row r starts at word 64r, a multiple of 32. Lanes 0..31 reading rom[64r + lane] share one line; rom[64r + 32 + lane] is the next line.
column2: 第 r 行从第 64r 个字开始，是 32 的倍数。车道 0..31 读 rom[64r + lane] 共用一条行；rom[64r + 32 + lane] 是下一条。

column1: Rows and columns are separate: x comes from bx, bdx, tx and y from by, bdy, ty. tid cannot give you y, because blocks are numbered one after another.
column2: 行和列是分开的：x 来自 bx、bdx、tx，y 来自 by、bdy、ty。tid 给不出 y，因为块是一个接一个编号的。

column1: Rows are 32 words apart, so the address is (texel row << 5) + texel column. The two rows a thread paints are 16 rows apart: y = warp and y = warp + 16.
column2: 行与行相隔 32 个字，所以地址是 (纹素行 << 5) + 纹素列。一个线程画的两行相隔 16 行：y = warp 与 y = warp + 16。

column1: Rows go in at tile[r * 33 + lane]; round c reads tile[lane * 33 + c]. For the third star, spend no spare words at all: keep 32 per row and move element (r, c) to column c XOR r.
column2: 行按 tile[r * 33 + lane] 存进去；第 c 圈读 tile[lane * 33 + c]。要拿第三颗星，一个多余的字都不要花：每行仍是 32 个，把元素 (r, c) 挪到第 c XOR r 列。

column1: Run it and open the Pipeline tab. The red read is the ADD right after MUL: it came three beats after, and MUL now needs four.
column2: 运行一次，打开“流水线”页。红格是 MUL 后面那条 ADD：它在三拍后读，而 MUL 现在要四拍。

column1: Run it with both seeds and compare. Which cells differ, and whose cells are they: the writer's own or a neighbour's?
column2: 用两个种子各跑一遍再比较。哪些格子不同？它们是写入者自己的，还是邻居的？

column1: Run the starter and watch the memory view: one warp, sixteen waits in a row, the other fifteen warp slots empty.
column2: 运行初始程序看内存视图：一个 warp，连着十六次等待，其余十五个 warp 的位置是空的。

column1: Run the starter twice on the very same mask, with two different scheduling seeds. The two lists will be:
column2: 用同一份掩码、两个不同的调度种子，把起始程序跑两遍。两份清单将会：

column1: Run the starter: every output is 256 times too big. Rounding the gain 0.75 to 0 or 1 would lose everything, so it has to stay 192.
column2: 运行 starter：每个输出都大了 256 倍。把增益 0.75 取整成 0 或 1 会丢掉一切，所以它必须保持 192。

column1: Run the third public case and look at the idle bars: three SMs stop early and wait for the one with the heavy quarter.
column2: 跑第三个公开用例，看空闲条：三个 SM 早早停了，等拿到重活的那一个。

column1: SEND peer, buf, n — queue n shared words for the neighbouring SM. The link reads them later; BAR waits for it.
column2: SEND peer, buf, n —— 把共享内存里 n 个字排进发往相邻 SM 的队列。链路稍后才读缓冲;BAR 会等它发完。

column1: SET THE GLARE
column2: 调亮度

column1: SHR both readings by 8 first: Q16 becomes Q8, and Q8 × Q8 is Q16 again, needing at most 17 bits. No shift after. Q4 would round the small readings to 0.
column2: 先把两个读数各 SHR 8：Q16 变成 Q8，而 Q8 × Q8 又是 Q16，最多只要 17 位，之后不用再移。改成 Q4 会让小读数被舍成 0。

column1: SM 0 holds all the heavy jobs, so it finishes last while the others wait. The total time is the slowest SM's time, not the average.
column2: 重活全在 SM 0 手里，它最晚做完，其他 SM 只能干等。总耗时是最慢那个 SM 的时间，不是平均值。

column1: SM 0 produces a stream of blocks of 256 words, and SM 1 writes them to out. Word i of the stream is 5 * i + seed. rom[0] is the number of blocks (1 to 13), rom[1] the spin units that stand for real work on each block (32 cycles each), rom[2] the seed, and rom[3] the number of words in the last block (the others are full).\nThis link is slower than the default: 14 cycles per message plus 2 words per cycle, and 40 cycles of delay. Shared memory holds more than one block. The old kernel computes a block, sends it and waits until it has gone before it starts the next. Keep the link busy while the next block is being computed. SEND reads your buffer when the message starts, not when it is queued.
column2: SM 0 产出一串每块 256 个字的数据块，SM 1 把它们写进 out。数据流的第 i 个字是 5 * i + seed。rom[0] 是块数（1 到 13），rom[1] 是代表每块真实工作量的空转单位数（每单位 32 拍），rom[2] 是 seed，rom[3] 是最后一块的字数（其余块是满的）。\n这条链路比默认的慢：每条消息 14 拍，再按每拍 2 个字传输，延迟 40 拍。共享内存放得下不止一块。旧内核算完一块、发出去、等它走完才开始下一块。请在算下一块的时候让链路一直忙着。SEND 是在消息开始传输时读缓冲，不是在入队时。

column1: SM 1 forwards SM 2's n words to SM 0 on top of its own n. How many words does link 1 to 0 carry, and link 3 to 0?
column2: SM 1 在自己的 n 个字之外，还替 SM 2 把 n 个字转给 SM 0。链路 1 到 0 和 3 到 0 各载多少字？

column1: SM 1, 2 and 3 each hold n words (n up to 512) that SM 0 must write to out in source order: out[0..n] from SM 1, then SM 2, then SM 3. Word j of SM s is 7 j + 1000 s + seed. rom[0] is n, rom[1] is 1 when SM 1 has data (else its slot stays 0), rom[2] is the seed. SM 2 is not next to SM 0, so its words must pass through SM 1 or SM 3.\nThe links are slow here: 1 word per cycle. Juye's kernel is correct but late. Run it and find the link that carries the most.
column2: SM 1、2、3 各有 n 个字（n 最多 512），SM 0 要按来源顺序写进 out：out 先放 SM 1 的，再 SM 2 的，再 SM 3 的。SM s 的第 j 个字是 7 j + 1000 s + seed。rom[0] 是 n，rom[1] 为 1 表示 SM 1 有数据（否则它那一段保持 0），rom[2] 是 seed。SM 2 和 SM 0 不相邻，它的字要经 SM 1 或 SM 3 转发。\n这里链路很慢：每拍 1 个字。橘爷的内核结果对，但太晚。跑一遍，找出载得最多的那条链路。

column1: SM 3 writes out instead of sending. A message takes ovh + 32/bw cycles on the wire, far less than one layer, so the wire is never the bottleneck.
column2: SM 3 写 out 而不是发送。一条消息占线 ovh + 32/bw 个周期，远小于算一层的时间，线路不会成为瓶颈。

column1: STL [addr], v — write this thread's local memory.
column2: STL [addr], v —— 写本线程的本地内存。

column1: STS [addr], v — write shared memory.
column2: STS [addr], v —— 写共享内存。

column1: Same arithmetic, clearly fewer cycles
column2: 运算量不变，周期明显下降

column1: Same diffusion as before (rom as in Swap the Edges: H, W, T, then the grid with a zero border), but now the grid can be wide as well as tall: H and W are multiples of 4, at most 64, and the shorter side is at most 32. The four SMs each take a quarter of the longer side. Whichever way you cut, what crosses a link every step is one edge of the strip. The old kernel always cuts into rows.\nThe hard limit is on the words sent over the links, over the worst case.
column2: 扩散与上一关相同（rom 的格式同「交换边界」：H、W、T，再是带 0 边框的网格），但网格这回可能宽也可能高：H 和 W 都是 4 的倍数、不超过 64，且较短的一边不超过 32。四个 SM 各取较长边的四分之一。不管怎么切，每步过链路的都是一条边。旧内核总是按行切。\n硬性限制是最坏用例里链路上发送的字数。

column1: Same gallery, smoother brush. Stretch the texture over the 32×32 output again, but blend instead of picking: pixel x samples the texture at s = (2x+1)·T/64 − ½ texels, where texel centres are the whole numbers. That is usually between four centres.\nLERP the four neighbours by distance: left and right by the fraction of s across, then top and bottom by the fraction down. Outside the picture the edge texel repeats (clamp). Layout as in the last level; each result may be off by at most 1.\nLERP d, a, b gives (a0·b0 + a1·b1 + a2·b2) >> 16 over r[a..a+2] and r[b..b+2]. Use Q16 weights that add up to 65536 and keep the third weight at zero.
column2: 同一间画廊，换更柔和的笔。再把纹理铺满 32×32 的输出，这次不挑最近的，而是混合：像素 x 在纹理上的取样位置是 s = (2x+1)·T/64 − ½ 个纹素，纹素中心是整数位置，所以它通常落在四个中心之间。\n按距离对四个邻居做 LERP：先按横向的小数部分混合左右，再按纵向的小数部分混合上下。图外的部分重复边缘纹素（钳位）。布局与上一关相同；每个结果允许差 1。\nLERP d, a, b 得到 (a0·b0 + a1·b1 + a2·b2) >> 16，其中 a0..a2 取自 r[a..a+2]，b0..b2 取自 r[b..b+2]。权重用 Q16，两项相加为 65536，第三个权重保持为零。

column1: Same job as before, C = A·B, but the shapes now vary. rom[0..3] are M, N, K. A (M x K, row-major) starts at rom[32]. B arrives packed in 32-column panels right after A: panel p holds columns 32p..32p+31 of all K rows, 32 words per row, panels one after another. N is a multiple of 32, M a multiple of 16. C goes row-major to out[i·N + j].\nA block is 8x4 threads (one warp) and owns one 16x32 tile of C, so each thread owns 4x4 outputs. DMA brings the A strip (16 rows) and the B panel into shared memory in two instructions. The starter computes its 16 outputs one after another and reads shared memory twice for every multiply-add. Keep a 4x4 accumulator block in registers instead. This machine gives you 32 registers per thread.
column2: 活儿还是 C = A·B，但形状会变。rom[0..3] 是 M、N、K。A（M x K，行主序）从 rom[32] 开始。B 紧跟在 A 后面，按 32 列一条打包：第 p 条放着所有 K 行的第 32p..32p+31 列，每行 32 个字，各条首尾相接。N 是 32 的倍数，M 是 16 的倍数。C 按行主序写到 out[i·N + j]。\n一个块是 8x4 个线程（刚好一个 warp），负责 C 的一个 16x32 方块，所以每个线程负责 4x4 个输出。DMA 两条指令就把 A 条带（16 行）和 B 条块送进共享内存。起始方案把 16 个输出一个接一个地算，每次乘加都读两次共享内存。改成把一个 4x4 的累加块留在寄存器里。这台机器每个线程有 32 个寄存器。

column1: Same ring, same all-reduce as 16-1, with vectors of n ≤ 128 words (n = rom[0], SM k's vector at rom[32 + 256·k + i]); every SM writes the element-wise sum of all four vectors to out[256·k + i]. The links are not perfect: the core may flip one bit of one word in a long message, once. A message sent again is not flipped again, and messages shorter than 16 words arrive intact.\nThe starter is the 16-1 ring with no checks. Its answers look reasonable, yet some entries are off by a little. Run it, find the word that changed, then make the program notice and repair it.
column2: 同一个环，同一个 all-reduce，每个 SM 的向量至多 128 个字（n = rom[0]，SM k 的向量在 rom[32 + 256·k + i]）；每个 SM 把四个向量的逐项和写到 out[256·k + i]。链路并不完美：核心可能把一条长消息里某个字的一位翻转，只翻一次。重发的消息不会再翻，不足 16 字的短消息完好无损。\n初始代码是没有任何校验的 16-1 的环。它的答案看着合理，却有几项差了一点。跑一遍，找到变了的那个字，再让程序自己发现并修好。

column1: Sampling straight from global memory takes 4 reads per pixel. The viewport only touches a 66×66 patch, starting one texel up-left of the pan: copy it into shared words (clamp the coordinates while copying), and the sampling needs no clamp at all. Mind where the LUT lives.
column2: 直接从全局内存取样，每像素要读 4 次。视口只碰到一块 66×66 的区域，起点是平移位置的左上再偏一个纹素：把它抄进共享字（抄的时候钳位坐标），取样时就完全不用钳位了。留意 LUT 放在哪里。

column1: Scale only at the ends: q = CVT.B.F(CVT.F.H(v) · 1/s) on the way in; at the end CVT.F.I the integer sum, FMUL by rom[2], CVT.I.F.
column2: 只在两端做缩放：进来时 q = CVT.B.F(CVT.F.H(v) · 1/s)；最后把整数和 CVT.F.I，乘 rom[2]，再 CVT.I.F。

column1: Score = dot of two rows: multiply lane by lane, add across the lanes with a butterfly of SHFL. Subtract the max, HEXP, add up, multiply by HRCP of the sum.
column2: 分数 = 两行的点积：逐 lane 相乘，再用 SHFL 蝶形跨 lane 相加。减去最大值，HEXP，求和，再乘上和的 HRCP。

column1: Score every earlier token, turn the scores into weights, and take that mix of their values.

column1: Shared memory serves one word per bank per pass. Lanes that want different words of one bank queue; a column of a 32-wide table is all one bank.
column2: 共享内存每个 bank 每趟只服务一个字。想要同一个 bank 里不同字的车道要排队；32 宽的表，一整列都在同一个 bank。

column1: Shifting after the multiply is too late. Make room before it: shrink both operands, then multiply.
column2: 乘完再右移已经晚了。要在乘之前腾出空间：先缩小两个操作数，再相乘。

column1: Shifting every score by the same number leaves softmax unchanged, and keeps exp in range.
column2: 把所有分数平移同一个数，softmax 不变，exp 也不会越界。

column1: Shrink by halves: a layer of 2×2 averages is a 32×32 picture, then 16×16, then 8×8. Keep each layer in shared memory (picture at 0, layer 1 at 4096, layer 2 at 5120) so the picture is read from global memory only once.
column2: 一半一半地缩：一层 2×2 平均得到 32×32，再是 16×16，再是 8×8。每一层放在共享内存里（原图在 0，第 1 层在 4096，第 2 层在 5120），这样原图只从全局内存读一次。

column1: Shrinking by picking pixels throws information away and shimmers; averaging first, one halving at a time, keeps the picture honest.
column2: 靠挑像素来缩小会丢信息、还会闪烁；先平均、一次缩一半，画面才诚实。

column1: Six steps (three to scatter, three to gather), each moving a quarter of the vector: 6 · n/4 = 1.5 n. Passing whole vectors costs 3 n.
column2: 六步（三步归约、三步收集），每步传四分之一向量：6 · n/4 = 1.5 n。整条向量传一圈要 3 n。

column1: Sixteen accumulators r0..r15. Per K step: load 4 values of A (rows 4·ty..4·ty+3) and 4 of B (columns 4·tx..4·tx+3) into registers, then multiply every A by every B: 16 MUL and 16 ADD.
column2: 十六个累加器 r0..r15。每个 K 步：把 A 的 4 个值（第 4·ty..4·ty+3 行）和 B 的 4 个值（第 4·tx..4·tx+3 列）读进寄存器，再让每个 A 和每个 B 相乘：16 条 MUL 和 16 条 ADD。

column1: Slot = the number of active cells before this one. That is an exclusive scan of the mask: scan inside each warp, scan the 16 warp totals, write each block's total to scratch, GSYNC, and add the totals of the blocks before yours.
column2: 位次 = 排在它前面的活跃格个数，也就是掩码的一次独占扫描：先在每个 warp 内扫描，再扫描 16 个 warp 的总数，把每个块的总数写进草稿区，GSYNC，再加上排在你前面的那些块的总数。

column1: Small blocks pay the per-block cost (the BAR and the ATOM) many times. Huge blocks leave whole SMs with less to do when the number of blocks does not divide evenly among the four SMs.
column2: 小块要把每块的固定开销（BAR 和 ATOM）付很多次。大块则会在块数无法均分给四个 SM 时，让有的 SM 分到的活少得多。

column1: Smaller messages do not help: the same words still cross 1 to 0, and each message adds its own overhead. Change the route instead.
column2: 把消息切小没用：同样多的字还是要过 1 到 0，每条消息还多一份开销。要改的是路线。

column1: Smem on the result card is what each block reserves, not what it touches. Blocks per SM = 8192 divided by that, rounded down.
column2: 结果卡上的 Smem 是每块预订的量，不是实际碰到的量。每个 SM 的块数 = 8192 除以它，向下取整。

column1: Social graphs and web graphs have a few hub nodes with millions of edges. Graph engines split them across warps or blocks and merge the partial sums with atomics.
column2: 社交图和网页图里总有几个拥有百万条边的大节点。图计算引擎会把它们拆给多个 warp 或块，再用原子操作合并部分和。

column2: 总得有人先开口

column2: 更早

column2: 空间局部性

column1: Speeding up the SMs that already finish early changes nothing. Move work off SM 2: SM k scores v = k * ceil(V / 4) + lane for lane < ceil(V / 4), v < V.
column2: 把早到的 SM 写得更快没有用。把活从 SM 2 身上移走：SM k 给 v = k * ceil(V / 4) + lane 打分，条件 lane < ceil(V / 4) 且 v < V。

column1: Split the big job
column2: 拆开大的那一件

column1: Split the field, swap only the seams, and the machine works as four. What is left is the wait for the messages.
column2: 把场切开，只交换缝，机器就当四台用。剩下的只是等消息的那段时间。

column1: Split the work first: 16 blocks each take 4 regions, one after another (a block has 256 threads, a region has 256 cells). The other two blocks only stitch. Do not let all eight warps of a stitching block poll; one warp is enough and the rest only crowd the SM.
column2: 先分工：16 个块各管 4 个区域，一个接一个（块有 256 个线程，区域有 256 格）。另外两个块只负责拼总览。拼总览的块不必八个 warp 全去轮询，一个 warp 就够，其余的只会挤占 SM。

column1: Start from the structure of the last level: DMA the weights once, then per position embed, project, append to the cache, attend, take the argmax.
column2: 沿用上一关的结构：先用 DMA 把权重搬一次，每个位置再做嵌入、投影、追加缓存、注意力、取 argmax。

column1: Start the MUL as early as its two loads allow, then issue the loads for c and d while it works. NOP only where nothing else is ready.
column2: 两个加载一到位就发出 MUL，然后趁它工作的时候发 c 和 d 的加载。只有实在没有别的可做时才放 NOP。

column1: Start with the plain kernel: one ATOM on out[key] per letter, key = class * 32 + destination. It is correct. Run the skewed bag and see where the cycles go.
column2: 先写朴素的内核：每封信对 out[key] 做一次 ATOM，key = 重量级 * 32 + 目的地。它是对的。跑一遍偏斜的邮袋，看周期花在哪。

column1: Stencil and convolution kernels on GPUs live on this: neighbouring outputs share inputs, and the cache or shared memory supplies the repeats.
column2: GPU 上的模板和卷积核全靠这个：相邻的输出共用输入，重复的读取由缓存或共享内存来供给。

column1: Stencil and filter kernels load a tile with a halo into shared memory, call __syncthreads(), then compute from the tile. Clamped edges make the halo a copy of the border.
column2: 模板和滤波内核会把带光环的一块图装进共享内存，调用 __syncthreads()，再从块里算。边缘夹住时，光环只是边框像素的副本。

column1: Steps 0–2 add the arriving chunk to your own; steps 3–5 just overwrite with it. Same loop, one mask: AND the old value with 0 or −1.

column1: Take q_i = RCP(w_i) once per vertex. Then both sums are LERPs with the raw edges as one operand: Σ e_i·q_i for the denominator and Σ e_i·(c_i·q_i) for the numerator. One more RCP of the denominator and a MUL finish the division.

column1: The caravan wants a sand chart for 64 regions of the desert, and a small overview of all of them. Region r has a wind direction d = rom[r] (0..3), a speed s = rom[64 + r], and a 16 x 16 terrain grid t at rom[128 + 256r + 16y + x] (values 0..15). Each cell carries q sand: d0: t*s + 3; d1: ((t ^ s) << 1) + 1; d2: t*t + s; d3: t > s ? t*3 : t + (s << 1). Then each cell of the region chart is the sum of q over its 3 x 3 neighbourhood, with cells outside the region counted as 0. Write the chart of region r to out[256r + 16y + x].\nThe overview is stitched by other blocks once a region is done: out[16384 + r] must hold the chart cell (8, 8) of region r, and the producer of region r sets out[16448 + r] = 1 after its chart is written. The launch is fixed: 18 blocks of 256 threads, and how you split the work between them is yours. Hidden days have another mix of winds and another weather for the stores. There is no starter; Yinpo is waiting.
column2: 驼队想要沙漠 64 个区域的沙风图，外加一张总览。区域 r 有风向 d = rom[r]（0..3）、风速 s = rom[64 + r]，以及位于 rom[128 + 256r + 16y + x] 的 16 × 16 地形 t（值 0..15）。每格带的沙量 q：d0：t*s + 3；d1：((t ^ s) << 1) + 1；d2：t*t + s；d3：t > s ? t*3 : t + (s << 1)。区域图的每一格，是它 3 × 3 邻域里 q 的总和，区域外的格子按 0 计。区域 r 的图写到 out[256r + 16y + x]。\n总览由别的块在区域完成后拼入：out[16384 + r] 要放区域 r 图的 (8, 8) 格，区域 r 的生产者在写完图之后，置 out[16448 + r] = 1。启动是固定的：18 个块、每块 256 个线程，工作怎么在块之间分，由你决定。隐藏的几天风向分布不同，写入的天气也不同。没有初始方案，银婆在等。

column1: The cell lives at y · W + x. Check x < W and y < H separately; one check alone lets the other edge spill into the next row or the guard.
column2: 格子在 y · W + x 处。x < W 和 y < H 要分别检查；只查一个，另一条边就会溢到下一行或守卫格里。

column1: The correct position for pixel x is x/2 + 1/4 − 1/2 = x/2 − 1/4 texels; the edge version gives x/2. Every pixel samples a quarter texel further right and lower, so it shows what lies there, and the picture slides up and left.
column2: 像素 x 的正确位置是 x/2 + 1/4 − 1/2 = x/2 − 1/4 个纹素；边缘版本给出 x/2。每个像素都往右、往下多取了 1/4 个纹素，显示的是那里的内容，于是画面向左上滑。

column1: The edge test is happy with a back-facing triangle: it covers pixels, and being drawn later it hides the front one. Work out each triangle's signed area first and keep the pixel only if the area is positive.
column2: 边测试并不嫌弃背面三角形：它一样盖住像素，又因为后画，会把正面的盖掉。先算每个三角形的有向面积，面积为正才留下这个像素。

column1: The far corner B
column2: 远处的角 B

column1: The fast SMs' time
column2: 快的那些 SM 的时间

column1: The first read brought the whole line into L1. The next 31 words of that line cost only the L1 latency, 4 cycles. Only the first touch of a line pays 400.
column2: 第一次读把整行都带进了 L1。这一行里其余 31 个字只付 L1 的延迟，4 周期。只有一行的第一次接触要付 400。

column1: The flood has run for 30 steps. How many cells can newly turn wet in the next step?
column2: 洪水已经流了 30 步。下一步最多有多少格会新变湿？

column1: The four neighbours and the cell itself: five. Not nine, because this stencil ignores the diagonals. Neighbouring threads read most of the same values again.
column2: 四个邻居加上它自己：五个。不是九个，因为这个模板不看对角。相邻线程会把大部分相同的值再读一遍。

column1: The grid covers 64 × 32 cells at once. Run every step twice: the second pass is 32 rows lower, 2048 cells further on.
column2: 网格一次只盖住 64 × 32 个格子。每一步做两遍：第二遍往下 32 行，也就是往后 2048 个格子。

column1: The grid-stride loop
column2: 网格步长循环

column1: The grid-stride loop is the standard CUDA idiom for any n: `for (i = tid; i < n; i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x)`. One launch shape then fits every input size.
column2: 网格步长循环是 CUDA 处理任意 n 的标准写法：`for (i = tid; i < n; i += gridDim.x * blockDim.x)`。同一种发射形状适用于所有输入大小。

column1: The hub needs more than one warp. The idle warps are already launched: warp w can work on row w >> 4, segment w AND 15.
column2: 大节点需要不止一个 warp。空闲的 warp 其实已经启动了：第 w 个 warp 可以去做第 w >> 4 行的第 w AND 15 段。

column1: The image is 40 wide and 24 high, and blocks are 16 × 16. How big must the grid be, in blocks across × blocks down?
column2: 图宽 40、高 24，块是 16 × 16。网格要多大？（横向块数 × 纵向块数）

column1: The lanes march together. Short rows finish early and sit masked until the longest row is done, so the warp pays for the maximum, not the average.
column2: 车道们同步前进。短的行早早做完，只能被屏蔽着干等，直到最长的那一行结束，所以 warp 付的是最大值，不是平均值。

column1: The lanes still queue on one counter, but the shared queue is served about twice as fast as the global atomic unit. Counting there and writing out 256 cells once costs less than it saves.
column2: 车道还是在同一个计数器上排队，但共享内存里的队比全局原子单元服务得快一倍左右。在那里数、最后只写一遍 256 格，花的比省的少。

column1: The largest 32-bit number
column2: 最大的 32 位数

column1: The largest of the four
column2: 四个里最大的那一个

column1: The last SM
column2: 最后一个 SM

column1:
The last layer of the Grid carries a sorting network, and Cenli wants proof that it runs safely on the replica. It reads a picture of an alien glyph, 8 x 8 pixels of 0..255, and names one of 10 classes. rom[64i .. 64i + 64] is picture i, 64 pictures per batch, written to out[i] as the class number.
The network has no biases: hidden[j] = max(0, sum over k of W1[k][j] · x[k]) for 32 hidden units, then logit[c] = sum over j of W2[j][c] · hidden[j] for 10 classes. out[i] is the class with the largest logit, the lowest number on a tie. The answer must match the exact network on every picture, including the all-255 white frames.
The weights sit in rom twice, cut into 4 x 4 tiles for the tensor unit, r = row and c = column inside a tile. FP16: W1[4kt + r][4nt + c] is rom[5024 + 16 · (16nt + kt) + 4r + c], and W2[4kt + r][4ct + c] is rom[4096 + 16 · (3kt + ct) + 4r + c] (columns 10 and 11 are zero). INT8: rom[4480 + 4 · (16nt + kt) + r] holds four signed bytes, byte c = W1[4kt + r][4nt + c] / s[4nt + c] rounded; the FP32 scale s[j] is rom[4992 + j]. W2 has no INT8 form.
No starter. The post office is waiting. Fewer cycles earn the second star; fewer words read from the depot earn the third.
column2:
栅纹的末层带着一个分拣网络，岑理要先证明它在复刻机上跑得安全。它读入一张外星字符的图，8 × 8 像素，值 0..255，报出 10 类中的一类。rom[64i .. 64i + 64] 是第 i 张图，每批 64 张，类号写到 out[i]。
网络没有偏置：32 个隐藏单元，hidden[j] = max(0, 对 k 求和 W1[k][j] · x[k])；再对 10 类 logit[c] = 对 j 求和 W2[j][c] · hidden[j]。out[i] 是 logit 最大的类，并列取号小的。每一张都要和精确网络的答案一致，全白（全 255）的图也一样。
权重在 rom 里存了两份，都切成 4 × 4 的块给张量单元用，r 为块内行、c 为块内列。FP16：W1[4kt + r][4nt + c] 在 rom[5024 + 16 · (16nt + kt) + 4r + c]，W2[4kt + r][4ct + c] 在 rom[4096 + 16 · (3kt + ct) + 4r + c]（第 10、11 列为 0）。INT8：rom[4480 + 4 · (16nt + kt) + r] 装四个有符号字节，第 c 个字节 = W1[4kt + r][4nt + c] / s[4nt + c] 取整；FP32 缩放 s[j] 在 rom[4992 + j]。W2 没有 INT8 形式。
没有初始方案，邮局在等。周期少拿第二颗星，从仓库读的字少拿第三颗。

column1: The lower-numbered SM goes first
column2: 编号小的先走

column1: The machine flags a clear of an MMA accumulator. Real hardware says nothing and you find it by comparing with a reference.
column2: 这台机器会标出对 MMA 累加器的清零。真实硬件什么都不说，只能靠和参考结果对比才能发现。

column1: The machine has one global memory with a fixed line cost and no cache hierarchy beyond a small L1.
column2: 这台机器只有一个全局内存，每条线的代价固定，除一个小 L1 外没有更多层级。

column1: The mapping follows the running total of pixels. Those 21 grey levels hold nine tenths of it, so they get nine tenths of the output range, about 230 levels instead of 21.
column2: 映射跟着像素的累计数走。这 21 个灰度占了九成像素，于是它们分到九成的输出范围，大约 230 级，而不是 21 级。

column1: The near corner A
column2: 近处的角 A

column1: The nearest of the four
column2: 离得最近的那一个

column1: The number of lanes that pile onto one bank depends on how many banks a pitch reaches: pitch p reaches 32 / gcd(p, 32) of them. Only an odd pitch reaches all 32.
column2: 多少条车道挤在同一个 bank，取决于行距能碰到几个 bank：行距 p 能碰到 32 / gcd(p, 32) 个。只有奇数行距能碰到全部 32 个。

column1: The old kernel makes neighbouring lanes read addresses 32 apart, so each lane needs its own cache line. Every element gets processed exactly once whichever thread takes it.
column2: 旧内核让相邻车道读相隔 32 的地址，所以每个车道都要自己的一条缓存行。不管哪个线程来处理，每个元素都只处理一次。

column1: The order makes no difference
column2: 顺序没有区别

column1: The original PlayStation interpolated textures linearly in screen space and had no per-pixel divide, so floors and walls swam and bent as the camera moved. Every GPU since divides once per pixel, and it is one of the reasons the reciprocal unit exists.
column2: 初代 PlayStation 在屏幕空间里线性插值纹理，没有逐像素除法，镜头一动，地面和墙壁就扭曲摇摆。此后的每一块 GPU 都对每个像素做一次除法，倒数单元的存在也有这个原因。

column1: The pixel is a neighbour of the 8 around it and of itself: 9 outputs read it. Fetching it 9 times from global memory pays for the same line 9 times.
column2: 它是周围 8 个像素的邻居，也是自己的邻居：9 个输出都要读它。从全局内存取 9 次，就是同一条行付了 9 次。

column1: The plain way is fine: one thread per cell, two copies of the map in scratch, and a GSYNC after every step. It works, but 96 sweeps read 4096 cells five times each, and it earns two stars at best.
column2: 朴素的做法没问题：每格一个线程，草稿区里放两份地图，每一步之后 GSYNC。它能行，但 96 次扫描要把 4096 格各读五遍，最多拿到两颗星。

column1: The prefix tokens come from rom[2 + t] for t up to rom[1]; after that the token is the model's own previous choice. out[t - rom[1]] gets the choice made at step t.
column2: t 不超过 rom[1] 时，字来自 rom[2 + t]；之后用模型自己上一步的选择。第 t 步的选择写到 out[t - rom[1]]。

column1: The program is limited to 120 instructions, so keep the K loop as one body (LOOP 2 around LOOP 48, skipping steps past K) and write the 16 results with one running address.
column2: 程序最多 120 条指令，所以 K 循环只写一个循环体（LOOP 2 套 LOOP 48，超过 K 的步数跳过），16 个结果用一个不断移动的地址写出。

column1: The program reads 1024 words, but the L1 holds only 16 of the 32 lines. Which order of reading do you expect to keep the number of misses lowest?
column2: 程序要读 1024 个字，而 L1 只装得下 32 行里的 16 行。哪一种读的顺序，缺失次数最少？

column1: The prompt is the start token plus 9 characters (10 tokens) and ORI says 6 more. How many rows does the KV cache hold when the last word is chosen?
column2: 提示是起始符加 9 个字（10 个字符位），ORI 再说 6 个。选出最后一个字时，KV 缓存里有多少行？

column1: The ring of border cells has no full set of neighbours. Decide per cell whether it is inner; border cells copy themselves.
column2: 边界一圈没有完整的邻居。逐格判断它是不是内部格；边界格复制自己。

column1: The rows above and below belong to other warps: that is what shared memory is for. The pixels left and right are in your own warp: SHFL reaches them. At the edges, clamp the row or lane with MAX and MIN.
column2: 上下两行属于别的 warp：这正是共享内存的用处。左右的像素就在你自己的 warp 里：SHFL 够得着。到了图边，用 MAX 和 MIN 夹住行号或车道号。

column1: The same
column2: 一样多

column1: The same as for w = 4
column2: 和 w = 4 时一样

column1: The same kernel runs on the busiest day (12000 readings) with blocks of 32, 128 or 512 threads. Which is fastest?
column2: 同一个内核在最忙的一天（12000 个读数）分别用 32、128、512 线程的块来跑。哪个最快？

column1: The same number at every pixel
column2: 每个像素都是同一个数

column1: The same number of cycles
column2: 一样多的周期

column1: The same product as before, C = A·B with FP16 inputs from rom (rom[0..3] = M, N, K, A at rom[32], B behind it), but M = N = 32 and K comes with each case. One warp still owns a 16x16 block of C, and each half warp keeps eight 4x4 accumulators in registers.\nCenli's numbers come out small. The starter's C is right in shape and wrong in size: it matches the product of only the last four columns of A with the last four rows of B. Find the moment an accumulator that already holds a partial sum is wiped, then fix it.
column2: 同样的乘法，C = A·B，FP16 输入来自 rom（rom[0..3] = M、N、K，A 在 rom[32]，B 在其后），但 M = N = 32，K 由每个用例给出。一个 warp 仍负责 C 的一块 16x16，每个半 warp 在寄存器里持有八个 4x4 累加器。\n岑理的数字偏小。起始方案的 C 形状对、大小不对：它只等于 A 的最后四列乘 B 的最后四行。找出一个已经含有部分和的累加器被清零的那一刻，然后修好它。

column1: The same sparse matrix as before (same layout: rowptr, x, col, val), but one row is a hub: three to four thousand entries, while the others have about eight.\nThe tower now wakes 2048 warps. Warp w can be row w >> 4, segment w AND 15 (segments are 256 entries long). The starter uses only the first warp of each row (w AND 15 = 0), and is correct; but while every other warp has long gone home, one warp walks the hub alone.\nCompute y = A x into out[0..128] again, but make the hub fast. out starts at 0, so ATOM can add into it.
column2: 还是那个稀疏矩阵（布局相同：rowptr、x、col、val），但其中有一行是大节点：三四千个条目，而其他行只有八个左右。\n风塔现在唤醒了 2048 个 warp。第 w 个 warp 可以当作第 w >> 4 行的第 w AND 15 段（每段 256 个条目）。起始程序只用每行的第一个 warp（w AND 15 = 0），结果是对的；但当别的 warp 早已收工回家，却只剩一个 warp 在独自走完大节点。\n仍然把 y = A x 写进 out[0..128]，但要让大节点变快。out 初始为 0，所以可以用 ATOM 往里加。

column1: The same table as before: 32 by 32 at rom[0..1024], out[c * 32 + r] = in[r * 32 + c], one warp, staged through shared memory.\nThe translator's note on the machine says "shared memory has 4 banks", so the kernel was laid out for that, rows padded to 48 words. The answers are right, and the kernel is still slow: the column reads queue up.\nFind the first read that waits in a queue, measure the machine yourself (CLOCK before and after one column read, for a few row pitches), and fix the kernel. Finish within 3650 cycles.
column2: 还是那张表：32×32，在 rom[0..1024]，out[c * 32 + r] = in[r * 32 + c]，一个 warp，经共享内存中转。\n这台机器的译注写着“共享内存有 4 个 bank”，所以内核就照这个排版，每行补到 48 个字。答案是对的，可内核还是慢：按列读时在排队。\n找出第一次要排队的读；自己去量这台机器（用 CLOCK 包住一次按列读，换几种行距各量一次）；然后把内核修好。在 3650 个周期内完成。

column1: The sample point is exactly in the middle of four texel centres. What does the blend give?
column2: 取样点正好落在四个纹素中心的正中间。混合的结果是什么？

column1: The scheduling seed shows two orders; the real hardware has far more, and the one you tested is rarely the one that breaks.
column2: 调度种子只展示了两种顺序；真实硬件有多得多的顺序，而你测过的那个往往不是出错的那个。

column1: The scoreboard: ask early, wait once
column2: 计分板：早问，只等一次

column1: The second copy puts each x next to the next x. Read x and vx from there, one word per lane, neighbours on neighbours.
column2: 第二份把每个 x 紧挨着下一个 x 放。从那里读 x 和 vx，每条车道一个字，相邻车道读相邻的字。

column1: The segment size is fixed at 256 here; real engines pick it from the degree distribution.
column2: 这里的段长固定为 256；真实的引擎会根据度数分布来选择。

column1: The sign survives the division: 65536 / -4 = -16384. The corner behind you is drawn as a ghost on the opposite side of the picture.
column2: 符号会留在结果里：65536 / -4 = -16384。身后的那个角，被画成了画面另一侧的一个幽灵。

column1: The slow SM's time
column2: 慢的那个 SM 的时间

column1: The starter clamps the running sum back into INT8 after every add. One product is already as big as 16129.
column2: 初始代码每加一次就把累加和钳回 INT8。单个乘积就已经有 16129 那么大。

column1: The starter copies rom[i] to out[i]: it never scales. Run it and look at where the output stops looking like the texture.
column2: 初始方案把 rom[i] 原样抄到 out[i]，完全没有缩放。运行一下，看输出从哪里开始不像纹理了。

column1: The starter copies the picture. Stretching between the darkest and the brightest pixel is not the answer either: one bright speck would set the scale.
column2: 初始方案原样抄图。按最暗和最亮的像素线性拉伸也不对：一粒亮点就会决定整个比例。

column1: The starter is right but slow: look at the busiest link. How many words has it carried by the end?
column2: 初始代码是对的但慢：看最忙的那条链路，结束时它一共传了多少字？

column1: The starter just copies the picture. Doing 81 taps per pixel is out of reach: the machine gives up long before it finishes. Split the kernel.
column2: 初始方案只是原样抄图。每个像素做 81 个抽头根本做不完：机器还没算完就放弃了。把核拆开。

column1: The starter keeps eight addresses and four loaded values alive at once. A single running address that you step by the stride needs far fewer registers.
column2: 旧内核同时留着八个地址和四个读到的值。只留一个地址、每次加一个 stride 往前走，要的寄存器少得多。

column1: The starter keeps its running sum in FP16. Once the sum is large, small terms fall below half a step and vanish; every lane drifts.
column2: 初始代码把累加和留在 FP16 里。和一大，小项就不到半格，被舍掉；每条车道都在漂。

column1: The starter picks one pixel per 8×8 block. On stripes it gets one solid colour, on noise one random pixel. Run it and compare with the expected grid.
column2: 初始方案每个 8×8 的块只挑一个像素。遇到条纹得到纯色，遇到噪声得到随机一个点。运行它，和期望的网格比一比。

column1: The starter reads K and V from global memory again for every row. DMA Q, K and V into shared memory once.
column2: 初始代码每一行都再从全局内存读一遍 K 和 V。用 DMA 把 Q、K、V 一次搬进共享内存。

column1: The starter reduces the indices with AND (T−1). That wraps: −1 becomes T−1 and T becomes 0. Which instruction keeps an index from going below 0, and which one from going above T−1?
column2: 初始方案用 AND (T−1) 来约束下标。那是回绕：−1 变成 T−1，T 变成 0。哪条指令能防止下标小于 0，哪条能防止大于 T−1？

column1: The starter runs SM 0 alone through all four panels. Which part of the work does not depend on the other panels?
column2: 初始代码让 SM 0 一个人把四份权重轮流算完。哪一部分的活不依赖其它几份？

column1: The starter treats the 16 bits as one fixed-point number. Pull the three fields apart first: SHR, then AND.
column2: 初始代码把 16 位当成一个定点数。先把三个字段拆开：SHR，再 AND。

column1: The stripes are still there
column2: 条纹仍在

column1: The tensor unit gets twice the multiply-add rate. What happens to the cycles of a matrix-times-vector?
column2: 把张量单元的乘加速度翻倍，矩阵乘向量的周期会怎样？

column1: The tensor unit multiplies a whole small matrix at once, and each lane holds one piece of it.
column2: 张量单元一次乘一整个小矩阵，每个车道持有其中一小块。

column1: The three corner triangles a pixel cuts out always tile the whole triangle, so their areas, the edge values, always add up to the same total. That is why one reciprocal serves every pixel.
column2: 一个像素把三角形切成三个小三角形，它们总能拼回整个三角形，所以面积（也就是边的值）之和永远是同一个总数。这就是一个倒数可以供所有像素使用的原因。

column1: The tile kernel from the last level now meets real shapes. rom[0..3] are M, N, K. A (M x K) starts at rom[32], B (K x N) follows it, and right behind B sits a guard zone of 4096 dirty words (all 77). C goes row-major to out[i·N + j], and every other cell must stay 0. A block is 16x16 threads and the grid is ceil(N/16) by ceil(M/16) blocks.\nThe starter assumes every size is a multiple of 16. On Cenli's 50x50x50 it loads dirty words into its tiles and writes outside C. Make the edges safe: load zero where the row, column or K index is out of range, and store only inside C. Inputs cannot be padded.
column2: 上一关的分块内核现在碰上了真实的形状。rom[0..3] 是 M、N、K。A（M x K）从 rom[32] 开始，B（K x N）紧随其后，B 后面紧跟一片 4096 个脏值（全是 77）的守卫区。C 按行主序写到 out[i·N + j]，其余格子必须保持 0。一个块是 16x16 个线程，网格是 ceil(N/16) x ceil(M/16) 个块。\n起始方案默认所有尺寸都是 16 的倍数。碰上岑理的 50x50x50，它把脏值装进了分块，还写到了 C 的外面。把边缘处理好：行、列或 K 下标越界时装 0，只在 C 的范围内写。输入不能补零。

column1: The total comes out wrong
column2: 总数会出错

column1: The tower keeps twelve gale planes. rom[0] is n, rom[1] the stride between the planes, and plane k, position i is at rom[32 + k·stride + i]. For each position i < n, out[i] is the sum over the twelve planes of x·x + x.\nOn this machine a thread may use at most 8 registers (a program that needs more is refused). Extra values can be parked in the thread's own local memory with STL and fetched back with LDL, but a local read takes 80 cycles.\nThe old kernel is right, yet Yinpo's tower crawls. Blocks of 64 threads. Find where the time goes, then keep everything in registers.
column2: 塔上有十二层风压板。rom[0] 是 n，rom[1] 是层间间隔，第 k 层第 i 个位置在 rom[32 + k·stride + i]。对每个位置 i < n，out[i] 是十二层上 x·x + x 的总和。\n这台机器上每个线程最多只能用 8 个寄存器（需要更多的程序会被拒绝）。多出来的值可以用 STL 放进线程自己的本地内存，再用 LDL 取回，但读一次本地内存要 80 拍。\n旧内核结果是对的，银婆的塔却慢得像在爬。每块 64 个线程。找出时间花在哪里，然后把一切都留在寄存器里。

column1: The two blocks run side by side with no ordering. If the neighbour has already stored its new value the read sees that; if not, the old one. The next seed may decide differently.
column2: 两个块并排运行，没有先后。邻居若已经存下新值，读到的就是新值；否则是旧值。换一个种子可能就是另一个结果。

column1: The wait is per trip, not per read. Take two slabs of records per round (all six reads first, then the arithmetic) and you pay half as many 400s.
column2: 等待是按趟算的，不是按读算的。每一轮取两批病历（六次读先发出去，再做运算），400 周期就只付一半的次数。

column1: The weights, so every SM sees all columns
column2: 权重，让每个 SM 看到所有列

column1: The whole stencil loop
column2: 完整的模板循环

column1: The wind tower smooths its 512 readings: out[i] = in[i-1] + 2·in[i] + in[i+1], where anything past either end counts as 0.\nEight blocks of 64 threads share the work, and each block owns 64 consecutive cells. This sketch is nearly done, but the answers change from run to run when the blocks start in a different order. Find out why.
column2: 风塔要把 512 个读数抹平：out[i] = in[i-1] + 2·in[i] + in[i+1]，两端之外的按 0 算。\n八个块、每块 64 个线程分担这件事，每个块负责连续的 64 个格子。这份草稿几乎写完了，可块的启动顺序一变，答案就跟着变。查查为什么。

column1: The wind tower's pressure map is 64 × 64 and settles by Jacobi steps: each inner cell becomes the average of its four neighbours, (n + s + e + w) >> 2, rounded down, while the border ring stays put. Four steps are wanted. The map is rom, and it also sits in the out buffer as map A (cells 0..4095); cells 4096..8191 are an empty copy, map B. Only A is judged at the end.\nThe grid is 16 blocks of 16 × 16 threads, one cell per thread, 128 warps in all. GSYNC (a barrier for the whole grid) only works while every block is on the machine at once, and the four SMs hold 32 warps each only if your kernel uses at most 8 registers; with more, the barrier never completes.\nThis sketch updates A in place and syncs after each step, yet the answers change with the block start order. Find out why.
column2: 风塔的压力图是 64 × 64，靠雅可比迭代落定：每个内部格变成四个邻居的平均，(北 + 南 + 东 + 西) >> 2，向下取整，边界一圈不动。要迭代四步。图在 rom 里，也放在 out 缓冲里作为图 A（格子 0..4095）；格子 4096..8191 是一份空白的副本，图 B。最后只判 A。\n网格是 16 个 16 × 16 线程的块，每个线程一个格子，一共 128 个 warp。GSYNC（全网格栅栏）只有在所有块同时驻留在机器上时才管用，而四个 SM 各能容纳 32 个 warp 的前提是内核最多用 8 个寄存器；寄存器更多，栅栏就永远等不齐。\n这份草稿原地更新 A，每步之后都同步，可答案还是随块的启动顺序变化。查查为什么。

column1: The wind tower's pressure plate is an image: rom[0] is its width W, rom[1] its height H, and the W·H cells follow row by row from rom[2].\nFor every cell, out[y·W + x] = (in[y][x] + x·y) AND 255.\nThe kernel is launched as 16 × 16 blocks in a two-dimensional grid. W and H need not be multiples of 16, and the guard cells behind the image must stay as they are.
column2: 风塔的压力板是一幅图：rom[0] 是宽 W，rom[1] 是高 H，从 rom[2] 起按行排着 W·H 个格子。\n对每个格子：out[y·W + x] = (in[y][x] + x·y) AND 255。\n内核按 16 × 16 的块、二维网格来发射。W 和 H 不一定是 16 的倍数，图后面的守卫格必须保持原样。

column1: The wrong C is not noise, it is a smaller product. Something throws the partial sums away on every step.
column2: 错的 C 不是噪声，而是一个更小的乘积。有什么东西在每一步都把部分和扔掉了。

column1: The wrong lanes are the big ones. A Q16 × Q16 product is Q32: for values near 1.0 it is near 2³², far too big for a 32-bit register.
column2: 出错的都是大数的车道。Q16 × Q16 的乘积是 Q32：值接近 1.0 时它接近 2³²，32 位寄存器远远装不下。

column1: The ×1 case is already right and the others are not, so the blend is fine. Compare a single bright dot with where it should be.
column2: ×1 的用例已经是对的，其他的不对，所以混合本身没问题。拿单个亮点和它应该在的位置比一比。

column1: There are n = 130 readings and each block has 64 threads. How many blocks are needed to cover them?
column2: n = 130 个读数，每块 64 个线程。要开几个块才够覆盖？

column1: There is no division here, so rows come straight from by, bdy and ty. Real hardware has the same idea, with a cheaper index.
column2: 这里没有除法，所以行号直接由 by、bdy、ty 得到。真实硬件是同样的思路。

column1: They are spread far apart
column2: 被拉开

column1: They are squeezed together
column2: 被压缩

column1: They hardly change
column2: 基本不变

column1: They issue their own reads or do other work
column2: 发出自己的读请求，或者做别的运算

column1: They may only run after the read returns
column2: 必须等读回来才能运行

column1: They queue up; the work is nearly serial
column2: 排队，几乎变成串行

column1: They wait too, the whole chip stalls
column2: 一起等，整块芯片都停住

column1: Thirty-Two Pigeonholes
column2: 三十二个格口

column1: Thirty-two

This is Freivalds' algorithm. With a vector the adversary cannot predict, a wrong product slips through with small probability, and each independent vector shrinks it further. Reused or published vectors give an adversary the chance to cancel the error.
column2: 这就是 Freivalds 算法。用对手猜不到的向量，错误的乘积只有很小的概率漏过去，每多一个独立的向量，概率再小一截。向量被重复使用或被公开，对手就有机会把错误抵消掉。

column1: This is the CSR-vector kernel behind sparse solvers and graph analytics, and the reason sparse formats come in several flavours.
column2: 这就是稀疏求解器和图分析背后的 CSR-vector 核，也是稀疏格式有好几种的原因。

column1: This line was fetched whole, used for one word, then thrown out.
column2: 这一行被整行取进来，只用了一个字，就被挤出去了。

column1: This line was fetched, evicted by its set-mates and fetched again.
column2: 这一行被取进来，被同组的别的行挤走，然后又取了一遍。

column1: This machine reads fragments straight from global memory. Real kernels stage them through shared memory and overlap the loads with the MMAs.
column2: 这台机器直接从全局内存读片段。真实内核会经共享内存中转，并让读取与 MMA 重叠。

column1: Threads 0 and 63 of each block also write a cell of the neighbouring block, with a guess that lacks the far neighbour. The owner writes the right value, and whoever lands last wins.
column2: 每块的 0 号和 63 号线程还会往邻块的格子里写一个缺了远邻的猜测值。主人写的是对的，谁落在最后谁说了算。

column1: Three edge values divided by their sum are three weights that add up to one. They say how much of a pixel each corner owns, and they blend anything: colour, depth, texture coordinates.
column2: 三条边的值除以它们的和，就是加起来为 1 的三个权重。它们说明每个角占这个像素的多少，什么都能混合：颜色、深度、纹理坐标。

column1: Three matrix-vector products cost 3 · 64² = 12,288 multiply-adds. Recomputing A·B costs 64³ = 262,144. If C is wrong, the vector test notices unless the error happens to cancel against the vector.
column2: 三个矩阵乘向量一共 3 · 64² = 12288 次乘加。重算 A·B 要 64³ = 262144 次。如果 C 是错的，向量检验会发现，除非错误恰好和这个向量抵消。

column1: Three steps with a BAR between each: every thread ATOMS 8 pixels into 256 shared counters; one lane walks the counters keeping a running total and the first non-zero total; then every thread looks its pixels up.
column2: 三步，每步之间一个 BAR：每个线程把 8 个像素用 ATOMS 计入 256 个共享计数器；一个车道走过计数器，记下累计值和第一个非零的累计值；最后每个线程查自己的像素。

column1: Tile b swaps a column with SM b ^ 1 and a row with SM b ^ 3; both are ring neighbours. Which side faces which depends on the tile: write the side as data (a column and a ghost column), not as four copies of the code.
column2: 第 b 块和 SM b ^ 1 换一列，和 SM b ^ 3 换一行，两者都是环上的邻居。哪一边朝哪一边取决于是哪块：把边写成数据（一列和一列幽灵格），不要抄四份代码。

column1: Tile, then sample
column2: 分块，再取样

column1: Tiled matrix multiply is the textbook case: blocks of the matrices are sized to fit cache or shared memory, so each element is fetched once per block instead of once per use.
column2: 分块矩阵乘法是教科书式的例子：矩阵的块按缓存或共享内存的容量来定大小，每个元素每块只取一次，而不是每次用都取。

column1: Tiles and barriers
column2: 分块与栅栏

column1: Tiling
column2: 分块

column1: Tiling with a halo is the classic optimisation for stencils, convolutions and PDE solvers. The edge of the tile does extra work because it needs cells it does not own.
column2: 带光环的分块是模板、卷积和偏微分方程求解器的经典优化。分块的边缘要多做一点工作，因为它需要不属于自己的格子。

column1: Time is spent where the warps wait. When they wait on memory, the cure is the access pattern, not fewer instructions.
column2: 时间花在 warp 等待的地方。等内存时，药方是访问模式，而不是更少的指令。

column1: Time the same program with .block 32, 128 and 512 and compare the Cycles on the busiest day. Then look at the Warp River of a small block size: how many warps are doing nothing but waiting at BAR or for the atomic unit?
column2: 同一个程序分别用 .block 32、128、512 跑一遍，比较最忙那天的拍数。再看小块的 Warp River：有多少 warp 除了在 BAR 或原子单元前等着，什么也没做？

column1: To test C = A·B for 64x64 matrices you multiply A, B and C by one vector and compare. About how many multiply-adds is that, next to recomputing A·B?
column2: 要检验 64x64 矩阵的 C = A·B，可以把 A、B、C 各乘一个向量再比较。这大约是多少次乘加？和重算 A·B 比如何？

column1: Too many registers per thread. This machine gives at most
column2: 每线程寄存器太多。这台机器最多给：

column1: Training jobs lose a large share of their time to stragglers: one slow GPU, one late batch, and every other device waits at the all-reduce.
column2: 训练任务有相当一部分时间耗在掉队者身上：一块慢的 GPU，一批晚到的数据，其余设备都在 all-reduce 处空等。

column1: Triangle setup computes exactly this determinant. Back-face culling throws away about half the triangles of a closed mesh before rasterisation, and the same determinant normalises the edge functions.
column2: 三角形设置阶段算的正是这个行列式。背面剔除能在光栅化之前丢掉封闭网格里大约一半的三角形，同一个行列式还用来归一化边函数。

column1: Try 64, 128 and 256 as well. The best size for the 12000 day is the one that hands every SM the same number of blocks while keeping the per-block costs small.
column2: 也试试 64、128 和 256。12000 那天的最佳大小，是让每个 SM 分到同样多的块，同时让每块的固定开销保持很小的那个。

column1: Tune for the machine you have
column2: 为手上的机器调优

column1: Two Dimensions
column2: 二维网格

column1: Two Passes
column2: 拆成两遍

column1: Two Q16 readings of 1.0 (65536 each) are multiplied as 32-bit whole numbers. What does the result hold?
column2: 两个 Q16 的 1.0（各是 65536）按 32 位整数相乘。结果里是什么？

column1: Two SMs each RECV from the other first and only then SEND. What happens?
column2: 两个 SM 都先 RECV 对方，之后才 SEND。会怎样？

column1: Two SMs must swap n words (n up to 64) and each writes out[64 s + i] = own[i] + other[i], where s is its own SM number and own[i] = rom[32 + 64 s + i]. The pair is in rom[1] and rom[2]; rom[0] is n. When rom[3] is 1, all four SMs form a ring instead: each sends to its right neighbour and receives from its left, and adds the word it received to its own.\nJuye's kernel hangs. Run it, find where the SMs stopped, and fix the order. SEND returns at once; RECV waits.
column2: 两个 SM 要互换 n 个字（n 最多 64），各写 out[64 s + i] = 己方[i] + 对方[i]，其中 s 是自己的 SM 号，己方[i] = rom[32 + 64 s + i]。是哪一对在 rom[1] 和 rom[2]；rom[0] 是 n。rom[3] 为 1 时，四个 SM 改成环：每个向右邻居发、从左邻居收，把收到的字加到自己的字上。\n橘爷的内核卡住了。跑一遍，找到各个 SM 停在哪里，再把顺序改对。SEND 立刻返回；RECV 要等。

column1: Two blocks cover 128, two short. Three cover 192, which is 62 more than needed. The grid is rounded up, so the last block is only partly useful.
column2: 两块只覆盖 128 个，差 2 个。三块覆盖 192 个，多出 62 个。网格是向上取整的，所以最后一块只有一部分有用。

column1: Two copies of the map: read this step's from one, write the next into the other, GSYNC, swap the bases. Rock and wells are never written, and both copies start identical, so they stay right in both.
column2: 两份地图：这一步从一份读，把下一步写进另一份，GSYNC，再对调基址。岩层和井口从不被写，两份一开始又一样，所以在两份里都是对的。

column1: Two multiply chains are independent. Issue their instructions interleaved, and the whole kernel takes…
column2: 两条乘法链互不依赖。把它们的指令交错发射，整个内核需要……

column1: Two rows of 64 are 128 words out of 1024: one eighth. The rest of the block is only read by its own SM.
column2: 两行各 64 字，共 128 字，整块 1024 字：八分之一。块的其余部分只有本 SM 自己会读。

column1: Two table reads feed the final multiply: W by phase, D by distance. How should they be issued?
column2: 两次查表喂给最后的乘法：按相位查 W，按距离查 D。该怎么发出？

column1: Two-dimensional grids
column2: 二维网格

column1: Uneven rows punish a thread per row; a warp per row reads them side by side and loses only the tail.
column2: 长短不一的行会惩罚“一线程一行”；“一行一个 warp”让相邻车道并排读取，只损失尾巴。

column1: Unrelated
column2: 毫无关系

column1: Unroll
column2: 展开

column1: Unrolling
column2: 循环展开

column1: Up and to the left
column2: 向左上

column1: Use two buffers in shared memory: block k goes into buffer k AND 1. SEND does not wait, so the next block can be computed while the last one is on its way.
column2: 在共享内存里开两块缓冲：第 k 块放进 k AND 1 号缓冲。SEND 不会等，所以上一块在路上时就可以算下一块。

column1: Use two buffers of 128 words. While the warps compute tile k from one, a DMA fetches tile k + 1 into the other. BAR waits for every copy in flight, so issue the next DMA after the BAR, not before it.
column2: 用两个 128 字的缓冲。warp 从一个缓冲里算第 k 块的时候，DMA 把第 k + 1 块取进另一个缓冲。BAR 会等所有在途的搬运，所以下一次 DMA 要放在 BAR 之后，而不是之前。

column1: VLIW and DSP compilers do exactly this with software pipelining. Out-of-order CPUs do it in hardware, picking whichever instruction is ready.
column2: VLIW 和 DSP 的编译器用软件流水做的就是这件事；乱序 CPU 则在硬件里做，哪条指令就绪就发哪条。

column1: Values in [1024, 2048) have exponent 10, so the last mantissa bit is worth 2^(10-10) = 1. Past 2048 the gap is 2 and odd integers are gone.
column2: [1024, 2048) 里的数指数是 10，尾数最低位的权重是 2^(10-10) = 1。过了 2048，间隔变成 2，奇数就没有了。

column1: Values that do not fit in registers are spilled to local memory, which is slow, and every spill is also a lost chance to keep loads in flight.
column2: 放不进寄存器的值会溢出到本地内存，那里很慢；每一次溢出也让你少了一次让读取并行在途的机会。

column1: Vault has one cache level, 32-word lines and a flat 400-cycle miss; real chips have several levels and varying latency.
column2: Vault 只有一级缓存、32 字的行和固定的 400 周期缺失；真实芯片有多级缓存，延迟各不相同。

column1: Vault's L1 is 4 sets of 4 ways with a plain mod-4 index; real caches hash more and have more ways.
column2: Vault 的 L1 是 4 组、每组 4 路，只用简单的对 4 取余；真实缓存会做更多哈希，路数也更多。

column1: Visibility is not order
column2: 可见性不等于顺序

column1: WARPS
column2: 启动 warp 数

column1: WORDS
column2: 字数

column1: Waiting a few cycles before the flag may work for the weather you tried and fail on a seed with a longer delay. A BAR does not help either: it lines the warps up, but it does not make their stores visible.
column2: 在置标志前多等几拍，也许对你试过的天气有效，换成延迟更长的种子又会失败。BAR 也没用：它让各个 warp 对齐，却不会让它们的写入变得可见。

column1: Waiting on Each Other
column2: 互等

column1: Watch the Warp River: SM 1 starts only after SM 0 has computed every sample. What must SM 0 do earlier?
column2: 看 Warp River：SM 1 要等 SM 0 把所有样本都算完才开始。SM 0 该早点做什么？

column1: Watch the bank column in the memory view while the columns are read back. Which bank does each lane land in?
column2: 按列读回来的时候，看内存视图的 bank 列。每条车道落在哪个 bank？

column1: Watch the warps in the Warp River: during each copy they all sit at BAR with nothing to do, and during each compute the copy engine is idle. The two never overlap.
column2: 在 Warp River 里看 warp：每次搬运的时候它们都停在 BAR 前无事可做，每次计算的时候搬运引擎又闲着。两者从不重叠。

column1: Water in old demos was often a table lookup on distance, exactly like this: a wave table indexed by d − time, a fade table indexed by d.
column2: 老式演示程序里的水波常常就是按距离查表：用 d − 时间 去查波形表，用 d 去查衰减表。

column1: Weather and fluid codes are built this way: domain decomposition, halo exchange, and overlap of communication with the interior computation.
column2: 天气和流体程序都是这样搭的：区域分解、边界交换，再让通信和内部计算重叠。

column1: Weights survive eight bits. Sums and activations need their range and a wide accumulator.
column2: 权重撑得住八位。求和与激活需要量程和宽累加器。

column1: What a warp reads together should sit together. Same-kind fields stored side by side coalesce; the fields of one record, interleaved, stride.
column2: 一个 warp 一起读的东西，该放在一起。同类字段挨着放，能合并；一条记录的几个字段交错放，读起来就是跨步。

column1: What crosses a link is an edge, not the area. Cut so that the edges are the shorter side of the grid: when H is smaller than W, cut the columns.
column2: 过链路的是边，不是面积。要让边是网格较短的那一边：H 比 W 小的时候，按列切。

column1: What does HEXP return for the half-precision input 12? (e^12 is about 162755; the largest half is 65504.)
column2: 对半精度输入 12，HEXP 返回什么？（e^12 约为 162755；最大的半精度数是 65504。）

column1: When a job is memory-bound, count trips to memory, not instructions. Take all you need from a line in one visit, and put as many independent requests in flight as you can.
column2: 任务受内存限制时，要数的是去内存的趟数，不是指令条数。一行一次造访就拿齐要用的，同时让尽量多的独立请求在路上。

column1: When every cell needs its neighbours' old values, read from one buffer and write to another, then swap. A barrier alone cannot fix an in-place update.
column2: 每个格子都需要邻居的旧值时，就从一块缓冲读、往另一块写，然后对调。只靠栅栏救不了原地更新。

column1: When every loaded value is used once, the time is the time to load. Faster arithmetic cannot help.
column2: 每个读来的值只用一次时，时间就是读数据的时间，算得再快也没用。

column1: When little changes per step, keep a list of what changed. A rim of a few dozen cells beats a sweep of four thousand.
column2: 每一步变化很少时，就记下变了什么。几十格的水边，比四千格的整片扫描划算。

column1: When loading the A tile, the element is real only if row < M and the K index < K. For the B tile, only if the K index < K and column < N. Otherwise keep the zero you started with.
column2: 装 A 块时，只有行 < M 且 K 下标 < K，元素才是真的。装 B 块时，只有 K 下标 < K 且列 < N 才是真的。否则保持开头的 0。

column1: When sending is asynchronous, the time of a pipeline is the slower of compute and transfer, plus one block, instead of their sum.
column2: 发送是异步的，流水的总时间是计算与传输中较慢的那个，再加一块，而不是两者之和。

column1: When the 2048 comes first, every later 1.0 is added to a sum that is already too big to notice it. Order matters.
column2: 2048 排在最前时，后面每个 1.0 都是加到一个大得看不见它的和上。顺序有影响。

column1: When the grid is smaller than the data, each thread walks the array in jumps of the whole grid, so neighbouring threads always touch neighbouring elements.
column2: 网格比数据小时，每个线程以整个网格为步长走过数组，这样相邻线程总是碰相邻的元素。

column1: When the model produces its 16th token, how much more K and V work does the starter do than a cache would?
column2: 模型产生第 16 个字时，初始代码比有缓存的做法多算几倍的 K、V？

column1: When the order matters, compute each item's place from its index. Never let arrival order decide.
column2: 顺序重要时，用下标算出每一项的位置，绝不能让到达顺序说了算。

column1: When the registers run out

column1: When the work is sparse, do not ask every lane whether to work. Pack the work first, then spend full warps on it.
column2: 工作稀疏时，不要让每条车道都问一遍要不要干活。先把活儿打包，再用满员的 warp 去做。

column1: Which way a triangle winds on screen says whether it faces you. One signed area per triangle tells you, before a single pixel is touched.
column2: 三角形在屏幕上朝哪个方向绕，就说明它是否朝向你。每个三角形算一次有向面积，不必碰任何像素就能知道。

column1: While one chain waits for its MUL, an instruction of the other chain issues in the gap. The waits overlap instead of adding up.
column2: 一条链在等乘法的时候，另一条链的指令就在空档里发出。等待是重叠的，而不是叠加的。

column1: White frames push the hidden sums past 65504. Multiply each pixel by 1/256 (HMUL by 7168) right after CVT.H.I: ReLU is homogeneous, so the winner does not change.
column2: 白图会把隐藏层的和推过 65504。CVT.H.I 之后立刻把每个像素乘 1/256（HMUL 乘 7168）：ReLU 是齐次的，赢家不会变。

column2: 谁是邻居
