column2: 清零

column1: With 16384 pixels the denominator can be 16000, and RCP gives only 4: one correction no longer reaches ±1. When den ≥ 4096, take RCP of den >> 2 and shift 2 less afterwards; the product stays under 2^31.
column2: 有 16384 个像素时分母可达 16000，RCP 只给出 4：修正一次已经够不到 ±1。当 den ≥ 4096 时，对 den >> 2 取 RCP，之后少移 2 位；乘积仍在 2^31 以内。

column1: With 32 there are about a hundred blocks, each with its own BAR and its own ATOM, and the atomic unit queues them. With 512 there are only six blocks for four SMs, so two SMs seat two blocks while the others seat one, and the busiest SM sets the time. 128 has enough blocks to spread evenly and few enough to keep the overhead small.
column2: 用 32 时大约有一百个块，每块各有一次 BAR 和一次 ATOM，原子单元要排队处理。用 512 时只有六个块要分给四个 SM，两个 SM 各摆两块、另外两个只摆一块，最忙的那个 SM 决定总时间。128 的块数足够均匀分摊，又少到开销不大。

column1: With a row pitch of 32 words, a whole column of the table sits in one bank. Give each row a pitch of 33 instead: the 32 words of a column then fall into 32 different banks.
column2: 行距是 32 个字时，表的一整列都在同一个 bank 里。把每行的行距改成 33：一列的 32 个字就落进 32 个不同的 bank。

column1: With count0, count1, count2 and count3 keys in the four piles, pile 2 starts at out position:
column2: 四堆里分别有 count0、count1、count2、count3 个键，第 2 堆从 out 的哪个位置开始？

column1: With rows padded to 48 words, the 32 lanes read a column: words 48 * lane + c. How many different banks do they land in?
column2: 行距补到 48 个字，32 条车道按列读：第 48 * lane + c 个字。它们落在几个不同的 bank？

column1: Without a cache all 16 rows are computed again; with one, only the new row. At step n the ratio is n, so the total work grows with the square of the length.
column2: 没有缓存时 16 行全部重算，有缓存只算新的那一行。第 n 步的比例就是 n，总工作量随长度的平方增长。

column1: Without shared memory, how many global values does one inner cell read to compute its new value?
column2: 不用共享内存时，一个内部格算出新值要读几个全局数值？

column1: Words carried by the busiest single link, worst test case.
column2: 最忙的那一条链路传过的字数，取最差测试用例。

column1: Words sent over all links, worst test case.
column2: 所有链路上发送的字数，取最差测试用例。

column1: Work in Q16: s = ((2x+1) << (10 + log2T)) − 32768. The top bits (>> 16) are the texel number, the low 16 bits are the fraction.
Work queues and persistent kernels on real GPUs pull jobs from a global atomic counter for exactly this reason. The finer the grab, the better the balance and the more atomics.
column2: 真实 GPU 上的工作队列和常驻内核正是为此从全局原子计数器里取活。取得越细越均衡，原子操作也越多。

column1: Work where the water is
column2: 只在有水的地方干活

column1: Working set and tiling
column2: 工作集与分块

column1: Wrap four loads and their sum in LOOP 2, advancing one address register with ADD r0, r0, stride after each LD. Do not go down to one load per trip: with too few loads in flight the wait is no longer hidden.
column2: 把四次 LD 和求和放进 LOOP 2，每次 LD 之后用 ADD r0, r0, stride 推进同一个地址寄存器。别缩到每趟只读一次：在途的读取太少，等待就盖不住了。

column1: Wrap the pile in LOOP 4. Block scan = warp scan with SHFL, lane 31 stores its total in shared memory, BAR, warp 0 scans the 16 totals, BAR, everyone adds its warp's offset. Put a BAR at the loop's end so no warp reads last round's shared words after they are overwritten.
column2: 把一堆的处理放进 LOOP 4。块扫描 = 用 SHFL 做 warp 扫描，31 号车道把总数存进共享内存，BAR，0 号 warp 扫描这 16 个总数，BAR，每个线程再加上自己 warp 的偏移。循环末尾放一个 BAR，防止有 warp 还在读上一轮的共享字时它们就被覆盖了。

column1: Write .smem 272, store the tile at tx (and the 2R extra words at 256 + tx), BAR, then walk 2R + 1 words from tx with LDS.
column2: 写 .smem 272，把读数放在 tx 位置（多出的 2R 个放在 256 + tx），BAR，然后从 tx 起用 LDS 走 2R + 1 个字。

column1: Write the eight loads out one after another. While one is in flight, issue the next address sum or the next load, and add what has already landed.
column2: 把八次读取一个接一个写出来。一次读取在途的时候，发下一个地址计算或下一次读取，再把已经落地的数加起来。

column1: XOR r7, lane, r6 / SHFL r8, r2, r7 / ADD r2, r2, r8, in a LOOP 5 that halves r6 each turn. Then every lane may ST the same sum to out[2 * warp].
column2: XOR r7, lane, r6 / SHFL r8, r2, r7 / ADD r2, r2, r8，放进 LOOP 5，每圈把 r6 减半。之后每条车道都可以把同一个和 ST 到 out[2 * warp]。

column1: Yes: each store reaches other blocks after its own delay
column2: 能：每次写入各自过一段延迟才到达别的块

column1: Yinpo is simulating a flash flood from the wind tower. The map is 64 x 64 cells, cell i = y * 64 + x. rom[0] is the water source cell, rom[1] the water level L, and rom[32 + i] the height of cell i.\nThe source is wet from the start, whatever its height. Each step, every wet cell wets its four neighbours (left, right, up, down), but only those whose height is at most L. Run exactly 96 steps. Then out[i] = 1 for every wet cell and 0 for the rest (out[0..4096]).\nout[4096..] is free scratch, 8712 cells. The tower wakes 8 blocks of 512 threads, so one thread per cell is on offer. There is no starter. The sweep is yours to design, and the frame budget is tight.
column2: 银婆在风塔上模拟一场山洪。地图是 64 x 64 的格子，第 i 格是 y * 64 + x。rom[0] 是水源格，rom[1] 是水位线 L，rom[32 + i] 是第 i 格的高度。\n水源一开始就是湿的，不管它多高。每一步，每个湿格都会淹到它的四个邻格（左、右、上、下），但只淹高度不超过 L 的格。恰好走 96 步。然后每个湿格的 out[i] = 1，其余为 0（out[0..4096]）。\nout[4096..] 是可随意使用的草稿区，共 8712 格。风塔唤醒了 8 个块、每块 512 个线程，所以每格一个线程是现成的选择。这一关没有起始程序。怎么扫由你设计，而帧预算很紧。

column1:
Yinpo is sinking a well and laying down rock, and wants the water pressure map after 40 steps. The map is 64 × 64 and sits in rom; it is also in the out buffer as map A (cells 0..4095), with an identical copy as map B (4096..8191). Only A is judged at the end.
Codes: a value below 1000 is open ground holding that pressure; exactly 1000 is a well, held at 1000 for ever; 9999 is rock, which never changes. The outer edge of the map is rock.
Each step, every open cell becomes c + ((n + s + e + w - 4c) >> 3), where a neighbour that is rock counts as c itself (nothing seeps in). Wells and rock keep their value.
The grid is 8 blocks of 16 × 16 threads, 64 warps, all resident, so GSYNC is safe. It covers half the map at a time. No starter: you choose the layout. Budget: 300000 cycles. Star 2 asks for 190000 cycles, star 3 for at most 400000 global loads.
column2:
银婆在井边钻井、放岩层，想看 40 步之后的水压图。图是 64 × 64，放在 rom 里；out 缓冲里也有一份，作为图 A（格子 0..4095），后面是一模一样的副本，图 B（4096..8191）。最后只判 A。
编码：小于 1000 的值是可渗透的土地，数值就是水压；恰好 1000 是井口，永远保持 1000；9999 是岩层，永不改变。地图最外一圈是岩层。
每一步，每个可渗透格变为 c + ((北 + 南 + 东 + 西 - 4c) >> 3)，其中读到岩层的邻居按 c 自己计（水渗不进去）。井口和岩层保持原值。
网格是 8 个 16 × 16 的线程块，共 64 个 warp，全部驻留，所以 GSYNC 是安全的。一次只能盖住半张图。没有初始方案：布局由你定。预算：300000 周期。★2 要求 190000 周期以内，★3 要求全局读取不超过 400000 次。

column1: Yinpo keeps her well readings on a stone tablet: rom[0] is how many there are, n, and the readings follow in rom[1..=n].\nTriple each one and add 1: out[i] = in[i]·3 + 1.\nThe kernel is launched as blocks of 64 threads, ⌈n/64⌉ of them, so there may be threads left over past the end. Behind the answers lies a strip of guard cells. Anything written there is a mistake.
column2: 银婆把井水读数刻在一块石板上：rom[0] 是个数 n，读数依次放在 rom[1..=n]。\n把每个读数乘 3 再加 1：out[i] = in[i]·3 + 1。\n内核按每块 64 个线程来发射，共 ⌈n/64⌉ 块，所以末尾可能多出几个线程。答案后面还有一段守卫格，写进去就是错。

column1: Yinpo keeps the gale readings in the depot far below the tower. rom[0] is n, rom[1] is w, and the n readings follow from rom[32]. For every reading x, run 6·w rounds of: x = x·5 + 3, then x = x XOR (x >> 3). out[i] is the result for reading i; cells past n stay 0.\nBlocks have 128 threads. Block b takes the 1024 readings from 1024·b on, as eight tiles of 128, one reading per thread. DMA dst, src, count copies count words from the depot, starting at rom[src], into the block's shared memory at dst. It runs in the background and lands about 400 cycles later; BAR waits until the block's copies have landed, and reading the words earlier gives old data.\nThe old kernel copies a tile, waits, computes it, waits, then fetches the next one. It is correct, but it spends the whole day waiting. Keep the copy engine busy while the warps compute.
column2: 银婆把风压读数存在塔下很深的仓库里。rom[0] 是 n，rom[1] 是 w，n 个读数从 rom[32] 开始。对每个读数 x，做 6·w 轮：x = x·5 + 3，然后 x = x XOR (x >> 3)。out[i] 是第 i 个读数的结果；n 之后的格子保持 0。\n每块 128 个线程。第 b 块负责从 1024·b 开始的 1024 个读数，分成八个 128 个的小块，每个线程管一个。DMA dst, src, count 把仓库里从 rom[src] 起的 count 个字搬进本块共享内存的 dst 处。它在后台进行，约 400 拍后到货；BAR 会等到本块的搬运都到货，更早去读这些字只会读到旧数据。\n旧内核搬一块、等、算、再等，然后才去取下一块。结果是对的，可它一整天都在等。让搬运引擎一直有活干，同时让 warp 去计算。

column1: Yinpo sends a message down the well in two parts: first 256 words of readings, then a flag that says the readings are ready. Block 0 of the kernel writes out[t] = 7t + 3 for t < 256, and then one thread sets out[256] = 1. Block 1 polls out[256] with LDO (64 tries, one read each), and when it sees 1 it copies the 256 words into out[320 + t].\nOn this machine a store reaches the other block's view only after a delay that depends on the day's weather (the seed), and a store with a few lanes is not necessarily seen in the order it was issued. The old kernel writes the words and then the flag, and still block 1 copies zeros. Find out why, and make the copy correct on every seed.
column2: 银婆把消息分两部分送下井去：先是 256 个字的读数，然后是一个说明读数已备好的标志。内核里的 0 号块写 out[t] = 7t + 3（t < 256），然后由一个线程写 out[256] = 1。1 号块用 LDO 轮询 out[256]（最多 64 次，每次读一遍），一旦看到 1，就把这 256 个字拷进 out[320 + t]。\n在这台机器上，一次写入要过一段由当天天气（种子）决定的延迟，才会进入另一个块的视野，而且先发出的写入未必先被看见。旧内核先写字、再写标志，可 1 号块拷出来的却是零。找出原因，让拷贝在每一个种子下都正确。

column1: Yinpo wants the day's total wind pressure from the tower. rom[0] is n and the n readings follow from rom[32]. Add them all and leave the sum in out[0]; the other cells stay 0.\nThe kernel below is correct: each thread sums four readings, each warp folds its sum with SHFL, the warps of a block meet in shared memory, and one ATOM per block adds the block's sum to out[0]. The program starts with .block 32. This level lets you choose the block size with a .block line (32 to 512, a multiple of 32); the machine launches just enough blocks of that size to cover all the threads. Find the size that makes the tower fastest on every day.
column2: 银婆想知道塔上一天的风压总和。rom[0] 是 n，n 个读数从 rom[32] 开始。把它们全部加起来，和放进 out[0]，其余格子保持 0。\n下面这个内核是对的：每个线程加四个读数，每个 warp 用 SHFL 折叠自己的和，块里的各个 warp 在共享内存里碰头，每块用一次 ATOM 把本块的和加进 out[0]。程序一开始写着 .block 32。这一关让你用一行 .block（32 到 512，32 的倍数）自己选块大小；机器会按这个大小发出刚好够用的块。找出能让塔在每一天都最快的大小。

column1: Yinpo wants the wind smoothed. rom[0] is n, rom[1] is the radius R (4 or 8), and the n gale readings follow from rom[32]. Anything outside the list counts as 0.\nFor every position i < n, out[i] is the sum of the readings from i - R to i + R. Blocks have 256 threads; cells past n must stay 0.\nThe old kernel stages each block's readings in shared memory, and the answers are right, but it reserves a huge slab per block. The SM can only seat the blocks whose slabs fit in its 8192 words.
column2: 银婆想把风读数磨平。rom[0] 是 n，rom[1] 是半径 R（4 或 8），n 个风读数从 rom[32] 开始。列表之外的位置按 0 算。\n对每个位置 i < n，out[i] 是从 i - R 到 i + R 的读数之和。每块 256 个线程；n 之后的格子必须保持 0。\n旧内核把每块的读数先放进共享内存，答案是对的，可每块都预订了一大块地方。SM 只能安排下“地方加起来不超过 8192 个字”的那些块。

column1: Yinpo's gauge kernel gives the right answers, but it is slow and she cannot say why. rom[0] is the count n (a multiple of 1024) and the readings start at rom[32]. For every reading, out[i] = (in[i]·5 + 3) AND 255.\nThe old kernel launches one thread per reading, 256 threads per block, and every warp is busy. rom[1] only tells the old kernel how far apart it reads; your answer does not need it.\nThe cycle budget is a third of what the old kernel takes. Open the Analyzer and see where the time goes.
column2: 银婆的水位内核答案是对的，但是很慢，她说不出为什么。rom[0] 是个数 n（1024 的倍数），读数从 rom[32] 开始。对每个读数：out[i] = (in[i]·5 + 3) AND 255。\n旧内核每个读数一个线程，每块 256 个线程，所有 warp 都满负荷。rom[1] 只告诉旧内核每次隔多远去读；你的答案用不着它。\n周期预算是旧内核用时的三分之一。打开分析器，看看时间花在哪里。

column1: Yinpo's tablet has grown: up to 2048 readings, n in rom[0] and the readings from rom[1].\nThe machine now launches a fixed grid of 4 blocks of 64 threads, 256 threads in all, whatever n is.\nDouble each reading and add 5: out[i] = in[i]·2 + 5. Every element must be handled exactly once, and the guard strip behind the answers must stay as it is.
column2: 银婆的石板变长了：最多 2048 个读数，n 在 rom[0]，读数从 rom[1] 起。\n机器现在固定发射 4 块、每块 64 个线程，一共 256 个线程，不管 n 是多少。\n把每个读数乘 2 再加 5：out[i] = in[i]·2 + 5。每个元素都要恰好处理一次，答案后面的守卫格必须保持原样。

column1: Yinpo's tower stores a sparse 128-row matrix A in compressed rows: row i owns the entries rowptr[i]..rowptr[i+1] (rom[0..=128]). Entry k has a column col[k] (rom[288 + k]) and a value val[k] (rom[8480 + k]). The vector x is rom[160..288].\nCompute y = A x: out[i] = sum of val[k] * x[col[k]] over row i. Empty rows give 0.\nThe tower gives one warp per row (8 blocks of 512 threads: warp i owns row i). The starter gives each row to one thread; it is correct, and slow.
column2: 银婆的塔里用压缩行格式存着一个 128 行的稀疏矩阵 A：第 i 行拥有 rowptr[i]..rowptr[i+1] 这段条目（rom[0..=128]）。第 k 个条目有列号 col[k]（rom[288 + k]）和数值 val[k]（rom[8480 + k]）。向量 x 是 rom[160..288]。\n计算 y = A x：out[i] = 第 i 行所有 val[k] * x[col[k]] 之和。空行得 0。\n风塔给每一行一个 warp（8 个块、每块 512 线程：第 i 个 warp 管第 i 行）。起始程序让一个线程独自管一行，结果对，却很慢。

column1: Yinpo's well has a ring of gauges: rom[0..n] holds n inflow readings, n up to 4096. Anything past the end reads as 0.\nAdd them all up into out[0].\nThe tower gives you 8 blocks of 512 threads. Sending every thread to the same counter is correct, but the counter serves one lane at a time: at most 16 lanes may use ATOM.
column2: 银婆的井边围了一圈水位计：rom[0..n] 是 n 个涨水读数，n 最多 4096，越过末尾的读数为 0。\n把它们全部加起来，写进 out[0]。\n风塔给你 8 个块、每块 512 个线程。让每个线程都去加同一个计数器，结果没错，但计数器一次只服务一条车道：全程最多只允许 16 条车道使用 ATOM。

column1: Yinpo's well water spreads sideways. The field is W × H cells: rom[0] = W, rom[1] = H, the cells from rom[2], row by row.\nOne step of seeping gives each inner cell out = (4·c + north + south + east + west) >> 3, with c the cell's own value. The ring of border cells is copied unchanged.\nBlocks are 16 × 16. Every inner cell needs its four neighbours, and neighbours at a block's edge belong to the next block. Fewer global reads earn the last star.
column2: 银婆的井水会向四周渗开。场是 W × H 个格子：rom[0] = W，rom[1] = H，格子从 rom[2] 起按行排列。\n渗一步，每个内部格得到 out = (4·c + 北 + 南 + 东 + 西) >> 3，c 是它自己的值。最外一圈边界格原样复制。\n块是 16 × 16。每个内部格都要读四个邻居，而块边缘的邻居属于相邻的块。全局读取越少，越能拿到最后一颗星。

column1: Yinpo's wind tower reads the gale on eight stacked pressure planes. rom[0] is n, rom[1] is the stride between the planes, and the readings start at rom[32]: plane k, position i lives at rom[32 + i + k·stride].\nFor every position i < n, out[i] is the sum of its eight readings, one from each plane.\nThe old kernel is right, but each thread hoards registers and the SM can keep only a few warps in flight. Make it fit more of them. Launched as blocks of 64 threads.
column2: 银婆的风塔把风压读在八层叠起的压力板上。rom[0] 是 n，rom[1] 是层与层之间的间隔 stride，读数从 rom[32] 开始：第 k 层第 i 个位置在 rom[32 + i + k·stride]。\n对每个位置 i < n，out[i] 是它八层读数之和。\n旧内核结果是对的，可每个线程都囤着寄存器，一个 SM 里同时能留住的 warp 很少。让它能容下更多。按每块 64 个线程发射。

column1: Yinpo's wind tower watches a field of 4096 cells. rom[0..4096] is a mask: 1 marks a wet cell, 0 a dry one. rom[4096..8192] holds the cell values.\nWet cells need the update f: twenty-four rounds of v = (v * 5 + 3) AND 1023. Dry cells are copied unchanged. Write every result to out[i].\nThe starter skips dry cells with an IF and is correct, but too slow: a warp pays for f if even one of its 32 cells is wet.
column2: 银婆的风塔守着一片 4096 格的田地。rom[0..4096] 是掩码：1 表示湿格，0 表示干格；rom[4096..8192] 是各格的数值。\n湿格要做更新 f：二十四轮 v = (v * 5 + 3) AND 1023；干格原样拷贝。把每格的结果写进 out[i]。\n起始程序用 IF 跳过干格，结果没错，却太慢：只要一个 warp 的 32 格里有一格是湿的，整个 warp 就要付 f 的钱。

column1: You cannot move the data, but you can change when it is used. Take everything you need from a row in one visit, so it never has to come back.

column1: rom[0..4096] marks which of the tower's cells are active (about one in five). Yinpo reads her list top-down, so out[0..k] must hold the indices of the active cells in ascending order, and out[4096] the count k. Unused list cells keep their -1. out[4097..4105] is free scratch.\nThe starter hands out slots with an atomic counter. The count is right, but the order is whoever arrived first, and the scheduling seed changes who that is.

column1: rom[0] is n (at most 512); rom[1..=n] are 16-bit keys. Sort them by their low two bits only, and keep the original order among keys that share the same two bits (a stable pass). Write the sorted keys to out[0..n]; the rest of out stays -1.\nOne block of 512 threads is enough: a thread per key. Yinpo wants four piles: bits 00, 01, 10, 11, in that order.
column2: rom[0] 是 n（最多 512）；rom[1..=n] 是 16 位的键。只按低两位排序，低两位相同的键保持原来的先后次序（稳定的一趟）。把排好的键写进 out[0..n]；out 的其余部分保持 -1。\n一个 512 线程的块就够了：一个线程管一个键。银婆要四堆：低两位 00、01、10、11，按这个顺序。

column1: row = warp >> 4; seg256 = (warp AND 15) << 8. Wrap everything in IF s0 < end. Loop 8 rounds of 32 entries with an IF k < s1 inside. Short rows only ever use segment 0; empty rows never pass the outer IF, so their y stays 0.
column2: row = warp >> 4；seg256 = (warp AND 15) << 8。把全部内容包进 IF s0 < end。循环 8 轮、每轮 32 个条目，里面再放一个 IF k < s1。短行永远只会用到第 0 段；空行过不了外层 IF，所以它们的 y 保持为 0。

column1: row = warp. start = LD [row], end = LD [row + 1]. In the loop: col = LD [288 + k], xv = LD [160 + col], v = LD [8480 + k], acc += v * xv. After the butterfly, lane 0 does ST [row], acc; an empty row simply stores 0.
column2: row = warp。start = LD [row]，end = LD [row + 1]。循环里：col = LD [288 + k]，xv = LD [160 + col]，v = LD [8480 + k]，acc += v * xv。蝶形之后，0 号车道做 ST [row], acc；空行自然就存 0。
